    function styleCircularButton(b, diameter)
    -- CYBER HUD v8: круглая кнопка в едином Grab Gun стиле — тёмный корпус,
    -- неоновое кольцо с градиентом, гало, орбита палочек, вращение обводки.
    -- Ховер остался (светлеет), звук и нажатие даёт общий noirNovaButton.
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25)
    b.BackgroundTransparency = .16
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.ClipsDescendants = false
    b.ZIndex = 20
    corner(b, 999)
    pcall(function() noirNovaButton(b, { round = true }) end)
        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.15), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 36, 44) }):Play()
    end)
        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.2), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25) }):Play()
    end)
    return b
end
    function topButton(txt, x, color, fontSize)
    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = header, Position = UDim2.new(1, x, 0, 26), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44),
    BackgroundColor3 = color or C.btn, Text = txt, TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = fontSize or 22, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold })
    return styleCircularButton(b, 44)
end
-- ===== NOVA CRYSTAL: единый премиум-конструктор плавающих кнопок =====
-- Один вызов превращает плоскую кнопку в полный NovaUI-дизайн: стеклянный
-- корпус с градиентом, световая грань, вращающийся металлический двойной
-- контур, HUD-уголки, ripple-волна и пружинное нажатие.
local novaPressInfo = TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local novaReleaseInfo = TweenInfo.new(.30, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
local novaMetal = ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(10, 46, 56)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22, Color3.fromRGB(56, 210, 240)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.48, Color3.fromRGB(18, 90, 106)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.72, Color3.fromRGB(150, 244, 252)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 38, 46)),
})
-- ===== NOIR CYBER HUD v6: 9-slice фреймы кнопок (срезанные углы, неоновая кромка) =====
-- Запечены оффлайн в стиле фото-референса; грузятся через writefile + getcustomasset,
-- при их отсутствии используется векторный фолбэк (кольцо + гало + HUD-уголки).
local novaSliceCenter = Rect.new(32, 32, 224, 72)
local novaFrameIdleB64 = ""
local novaFrameActiveB64 = ""
local novaFrameIdle, novaFrameActive = "", ""
local novaRoundIdle, novaRoundActive = "", ""
local novaRoundIdleB64 = ""
local novaRoundActiveB64 = ""
do
local customAsset = (type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset) or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if type(writefile) == "function" and customAsset then
    if type(makefolder) == "function" then pcall(makefolder, ASSETS_FOLDER) end
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local function decode64(data)
            return (data:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", ""):gsub(".", function(x)
            if x == "=" then return "" end
            local r, f = "", alphabet:find(x, 1, true) - 1
            for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0") end
            return r
        end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
            if #x ~= 8 then return "" end
            local c = 0
            for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
            return string.char(c)
        end))
    end
        local function loadFrame(data, name)
            local ok, asset = pcall(function()
            local path = ASSETS_FOLDER .. "/" .. name
            writefile(path, decode64(data))
            return customAsset(path)
        end)
        if ok and type(asset) == "string" then return asset end
        return ""
    end
    novaFrameIdle = loadFrame(novaFrameIdleB64, "NOIR_HUD_FRAME_IDLE.png")
    novaFrameActive = loadFrame(novaFrameActiveB64, "NOIR_HUD_FRAME_ACTIVE.png")
    novaRoundIdle = loadFrame(novaRoundIdleB64, "NOIR_HUD_ROUND_IDLE.png")
    novaRoundActive = loadFrame(novaRoundActiveB64, "NOIR_HUD_ROUND_ACTIVE.png")
end
end
    local function noirNovaButtonImpl(b, cfg)
    -- NOIR CYBER HUD v6: дизайн с фото-референса — чёрный корпус, неоновый cyan-контур
    -- с мягким гало, срезанные углы (9-slice) и верхний блик. Круглые кнопки
    -- (cfg.round) рисуются векторным кольцом, прямоугольные получают 9-slice корпус
    -- (если экзекутор поддерживает getcustomasset), иначе векторный фолбэк.
    -- API сохранён: колбэки пишут novaFx.outer.Color = ColorSequence (прокси состояния).
    cfg = cfg or {}
    local z = b.ZIndex or 5
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    local useRound = cfg.round == true
    corner(b, useRound and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12))
    local outer = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.accent, Thickness = cfg.thickness or 2, Transparency = .08, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local outerGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = outer, Rotation = 35, Color = cfg.gradient or novaMetal })
    local halo = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.accent, Thickness = 6, Transparency = .87, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Color = C.border, Thickness = 1, Transparency = .55, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local sheen = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirSheen", Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, .42, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = .82, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 4 })
    New("UICorner", { Parent = sheen, CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, useRound and 999 or (cfg.radius or 12)) })
    New("UIGradient", { Parent = sheen, Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .4), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6, .8), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
    -- CYBER HUD v8: круглая форма — ретикл-тики на вращающейся орбите
    local tickOrbit
        if useRound then
        tickOrbit = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirTickOrbit", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Rotation = 0, ZIndex = z + 3 })
            for _, c in ipairs({ { 1, 0, 45 }, { 0, 0, -45 }, { 1, 1, -45 }, { 0, 1, 45 } }) do
            New("Frame", { Parent = tickOrbit, Name = "NoirTick", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(c[1], c[2]),
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(c[1], c[2]), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 1.6),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BackgroundTransparency = .3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Rotation = c[3], ZIndex = z + 3 })
        end
        local orbit = New("UIStroke", { Parent = b, Name = "NoirOrbitStroke", Color = C.border, Thickness = 1,
        Transparency = .35, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        New("UIGradient", { Parent = orbit, Rotation = 180, Color = novaMetal })
    end
    local brackets
    if cfg.brackets and not useRound then pcall(function() brackets = hudBrackets(b, cfg.bracketLen or 8, 1.4, C.accent2, .3, z + 2) end) end
    -- 9-slice корпус: срезанные углы как на референсе
    local bodyImage, roundBody = false, false
        if novaFrameIdle ~= "" and not useRound and b:IsA("ImageButton") then
        bodyImage = true
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.Image = novaFrameIdle
        b.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice
        b.SliceCenter = novaSliceCenter
        pcall(function() b.SliceScale = 1 end)
        outer.Transparency = 1
        halo.Transparency = 1
        if brackets then for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do f.Visible = false end end
    elseif useRound and novaRoundIdle ~= "" and b:IsA("ImageButton") then
        roundBody = true
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.Image = novaRoundIdle
        b.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        outer.Transparency = 1
        halo.Transparency = 1
            for _, nm in ipairs({ "NoirOrbitStroke" }) do
            local stale = b:FindFirstChild(nm)
                if stale then
                -- UIStroke/UIGradient are UIComponent: no .Visible member (crashed the whole build)
                if stale:IsA("GuiObject") then stale.Visible = false else stale.Enabled = false end
            end
        end
    end
        local function seqLum(seq)
        local r, g, bl, n = 0, 0, 0, 0
        for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do r += kp.Value.R; g += kp.Value.G; bl += kp.Value.B; n += 1 end
        if n == 0 then return 0 end
        return (r + g + bl) / (3 * n)
    end
    -- прокси состояния: прежние колбэки пишут bindOuterGradient.Color = seq
    local stateProxy = setmetatable({}, {
        __newindex = function(_, key, value)
        if key ~= "Color" or typeof(value) ~= "ColorSequence" then return end
            task.spawn(function()
            local bright = seqLum(value) > .45
                if bodyImage then
                pcall(function() b.Image = bright and novaFrameActive or novaFrameIdle end)
                return
            end
                if roundBody then
                pcall(function() b.Image = bright and novaRoundActive or novaRoundIdle end)
                return
            end
            pcall(function() outerGradient.Color = value end)
                pcall(function()
                TweenService:Create(halo, TweenInfo.new(.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = bright and .72 or .87, Thickness = bright and 9 or 6 }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(outer, TweenInfo.new(.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = bright and 0 or .14 }):Play()
            end)
        end)
    end,
    })
        pcall(function()
        if NoirCyberHUD and NoirCyberHUD._register then NoirCyberHUD._register(b, outerGradient, tickOrbit) end
    end)
    local pressScale = New("UIScale", { Parent = b, Scale = 1 })
        local function ripple()
        local r = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Name = "NovaRipple", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(.35, .35), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z + 1 })
        corner(r, 999)
        local ring = New("UIStroke", { Parent = r, Color = C.accent2, Thickness = 2, Transparency = .2, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        local grow = TweenService:Create(r, TweenInfo.new(.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
        local fade = TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = 1 })
        grow:Play(); fade:Play()
        grow.Completed:Connect(function() r:Destroy() end)
    end
    local sound
        if cfg.sound ~= false then
        sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "NoirButtonSound"; sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://3868133279"; sound.Volume = .3; sound.Parent = b
    end
        if cfg.press ~= false then
            b.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                if sound then sound:Play() end
                ripple()
                TweenService:Create(pressScale, novaPressInfo, { Scale = cfg.pressScale or 1.06 }):Play()
            end
        end)
            b.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                TweenService:Create(pressScale, novaReleaseInfo, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            end
        end)
    end
    return { outer = stateProxy, inner = nil, scale = pressScale, ripple = ripple, sound = sound, ring = outer, halo = halo }
end
-- SAFETY NET v7.1: одна сломанная кнопка больше НЕ убивает сборку всего модуля.
-- Любая ошибка стилизации изолируется pcall и возвращает безопасный заглушечный fx.
    function noirNovaButton(b, cfg)
    local ok, fx = pcall(noirNovaButtonImpl, b, cfg)
    if ok and type(fx) == "table" then return fx end
        pcall(function()
        warn("[Noir] button decoration failed safely: " .. tostring(fx))
            if typeof(b) == "Instance" then
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
        end
    end)
    local fallbackProxy = setmetatable({}, { __newindex = function() end })
    return { outer = fallbackProxy, inner = nil, scale = nil, ripple = function() end, sound = nil, ring = nil, halo = nil }
end
local miniArrowImage = ""
do
local customAsset = (type(getcustomasset) == "function" and getcustomasset) or (type(getsynasset) == "function" and getsynasset)
    if type(writefile) == "function" and customAsset then
    local encodedArrow = ""
    local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local decodedArrow = encodedArrow:gsub("[^" .. alphabet .. "=]", ""):gsub(".", function(x)
        if x == "=" then return "" end
        local r, f = "", alphabet:find(x, 1, true) - 1
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0") end
        return r
    end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return "" end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0) end
        return string.char(c)
    end)
    local arrowPath = ASSETS_FOLDER .. "/NOIR_MINIMIZE_ARROW.png"
    local wrote = pcall(writefile, arrowPath, decodedArrow)
        if wrote then
        local ok, asset = pcall(customAsset, arrowPath)
        if ok and type(asset) == "string" then miniArrowImage = asset end
    end
end
end

-- ---- Emotes page: убрать чёрный оттенок (GAME EMOTES + кнопки) ----
do
__R1.LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(32, 27, 22)
    local function isDark(obj)
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
        if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
        local bg = obj.BackgroundColor3
        return (bg.R + bg.G + bg.B) / 3 < 0.09 and obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.6
    end)
    return ok and res == true
end
    local function lighten(root)
    if not (root and root.Parent) then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if isDark(obj) then
                pcall(function()
                obj.BackgroundColor3 = __R1.LIGHT
                if obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.2 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = 0.32 end
            end)
        end
            if obj:IsA("UIGradient") then
                local okg, darkGrad = pcall(function()
                local seq = obj.Color
                local r, g, b, n = 0, 0, 0, 0
                    for _, kp in ipairs(seq.Keypoints) do
                    r = r + kp.Value.R; g = g + kp.Value.G; b = b + kp.Value.B; n = n + 1
                end
                return n > 0 and (r + g + b) / (3 * n) < 0.12
            end)
            if okg and darkGrad then pcall(function() obj.Enabled = false end) end
        end
            if (obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton")) and not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") then
                pcall(function()
                local st = Instance.new("UIStroke")
                st.Color = C.border
                st.Thickness = 1
                st.Transparency = 0.4
                st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                st.Parent = obj
            end)
        end
    end
end
__R1.pending = false
    local function schedule()
    if __R1.pending then return end
    __R1.pending = true
        task.delay(0.25, function()
        __R1.pending = false
        lighten(emotesContent)
    end)
end
    if emotesGameCol then
        pcall(function()
        emotesGameCol.BackgroundColor3 = C.panel
        emotesGameCol.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
    end)
end
    if emotesContent then
    emotesContent.DescendantAdded:Connect(schedule)
    emotesContent.ChildAdded:Connect(schedule)
    task.defer(function() lighten(emotesContent) end)
    task.delay(1, function() lighten(emotesContent) end)
    task.delay(3, function() lighten(emotesContent) end)
end
end

__R1.pageBasePosition = __R1.content.Position

    local function basePositionFor(object)
    if object == emotesContent then return __R1.emotesBasePosition end
    return __R1.pageBasePosition
end
__R1.pageTransitionId = 0
    local function pageScaleFor(object)
    local scaler = object:FindFirstChild("NoirPageScale")
    if not scaler then scaler = New("UIScale", { Name = "NoirPageScale", Scale = 1, Parent = object }) end
    return scaler
end
    function selectPage(page)
    if not __R1.pageObjects[page] then page = "home" end
        if NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns["Noir::LastPage"] ~= page then
        NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns["Noir::LastPage"] = page
        NoirPersistence.Save()
    end
    __R1.pageTransitionId += 1
    local transitionId = __R1.pageTransitionId
    local oldPage = __R1.activePage
    local oldObject = __R1.pageObjects[oldPage]
    local newObject = __R1.pageObjects[page]
    __R1.activePage = page
    NoirGenv().__NoirState.active = page
        for _, object in pairs(__R1.pageObjects) do
            if object ~= oldObject and object ~= newObject then
            object.Visible = false
            object.Position = basePositionFor(object)
            pageScaleFor(object).Scale = 1
        end
    end
        if oldObject and oldObject ~= newObject and oldObject.Visible then
        local oldScale = pageScaleFor(oldObject)
        oldObject.Position = basePositionFor(oldObject)
        TweenService:Create(oldScale, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = .96 }):Play()
            task.delay(.18, function()
                if transitionId == __R1.pageTransitionId and oldObject ~= __R1.pageObjects[__R1.activePage] then
                oldObject.Visible = false
                oldObject.Position = basePositionFor(oldObject)
                oldScale.Scale = 1
            end
        end)
    end
        if newObject then
        local newScale = pageScaleFor(newObject)
        newObject.Position = basePositionFor(newObject)
            if newObject:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            newObject.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, newObject.CanvasPosition.Y)
        end
        newScale.Scale = .94
        newObject.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(newScale, TweenInfo.new(.62, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    end
    if emotesTabBar then emotesTabBar.Visible = (page == "emotes") end
    configContent.Visible = false
        for name, b in pairs(navButtons) do
        local active = name == page
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = C.off, BackgroundTransparency = active and .04 or 1 }):Play()
        local data = navIcons[name]
            if data then
            TweenService:Create(data.icon, TweenInfo.new(.2), { ImageColor3 = active and C.accent2 or C.dim }):Play()
                if data.glyphs then
                for _, glyph in ipairs(data.glyphs) do TweenService:Create(glyph, TweenInfo.new(.2), { BackgroundColor3 = active and C.accent2 or C.dim }):Play() end
            end
                if data.rings then
                for _, ring in ipairs(data.rings) do TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(.2), { Color = active and C.accent or C.dim }):Play() end
            end
            TweenService:Create(data.label, TweenInfo.new(.2), { TextColor3 = active and C.accent2 or C.dim }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(data.bar, TweenInfo.new(.2), { BackgroundTransparency = active and 0 or 1 }):Play()
        end
    end
end
end

    end)
end

    function refreshCanvas()
    if __R1.sectionPanels.__canvasQueued then return end
    __R1.sectionPanels.__canvasQueued = true
        task.defer(function()
        __R1.sectionPanels.__canvasQueued = false
            for _, page in ipairs({ __R1.content, configContent, visualContent, mainContent, worldContent, emotesContent, miscContent, settingsContent }) do
            if page and page.Parent then page.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) end
        end
    end)
end
    search:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    __R1.sectionPanels.__searchToken = (__R1.sectionPanels.__searchToken or 0) + 1
    local token = __R1.sectionPanels.__searchToken
        task.delay(0.12, function()
        if token ~= __R1.sectionPanels.__searchToken then return end
        local q = string.lower(search.Text or "")
        local counts = { main = 0, aim = 0, world = 0, visual = 0, emotes = 0, misc = 0, map = 0, farm = 0 }
        local firstPage, firstSub
            for _, entry in ipairs(__R1.sectionPanels) do
            local hay = entry.name
                for _, d in ipairs(entry.panel:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then hay = hay .. " " .. string.lower(d.Text or "") end
            end
            local match = q == "" or string.find(hay, q, 1, true) ~= nil
            entry.panel.Visible = match
                if match then
                counts[entry.page] = (counts[entry.page] or 0) + 1
                if q ~= "" and not firstPage then firstPage, firstSub = entry.page, entry.sub end
            end
        end
            if q ~= "" and firstPage then
                if __R1.activePage == "home" or __R1.activePage == "skins" or __R1.activePage ~= firstPage then
                selectPage(firstPage)
            end
            local shower = NoirGenv().__NoirSubShow and NoirGenv().__NoirSubShow[firstPage]
            if type(shower) == "function" and firstSub then pcall(shower, firstSub) end
        elseif q == "" then
            local cur = NoirGenv().__NoirSubCurrent and NoirGenv().__NoirSubCurrent[__R1.activePage]
            local shower = NoirGenv().__NoirSubShow and NoirGenv().__NoirSubShow[__R1.activePage]
            if type(shower) == "function" and cur then pcall(shower, cur) end
        end
        refreshCanvas()
    end)

    local function trimNotifications()
        while #__R1.activeNotifications > 3 do
        local oldest = table.remove(__R1.activeNotifications, 1)
        if oldest and oldest.Parent then oldest:Destroy() end
    end
end

    local life = math.max(1.5, tonumber(duration) or 3)

    BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1001 })

    TweenService:Create(progress, TweenInfo.new(life, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }):Play()
        task.delay(life, function()
            for i = #__R1.activeNotifications, 1, -1 do
            if __R1.activeNotifications[i] == card then table.remove(__R1.activeNotifications, i) break end
        end
            if card.Parent then
            local out = TweenService:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Position = UDim2.new(1, 24, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            })
            out:Play(); out.Completed:Connect(function() if card.Parent then card:Destroy() end end)
        end
    end)
end
    function host.CreateTab()
    local buildOps = 0
        local function yieldDuringBuild()
        buildOps += 1
        if buildOps % 16 ~= 0 then return end
        local waitFn = type(task) == "table" and task.wait or nil
            if type(waitFn) == "function" then waitFn()
        elseif type(wait) == "function" then wait() end
    end
    local tab = {}
        function tab:AddSection(name, description)
        yieldDuringBuild()
        local isVisual = name == "Visuals" or name == "Object ESP" or string.find(name, "VISUAL", 1, true) == 1
        local isMain = string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "MAIN "
        local function hasTag(p) return string.find(name, p, 1, true) ~= nil end
        local isFling = hasTag("Fling") or hasTag("⚡") or hasTag("🤖") or hasTag("📋") or hasTag("⚙") or hasTag("🔘") or hasTag("🔑")
        local isWorld = string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "WORLD " or name == "Bomb Jump+" or name == "Gold Bomb Jump+" or isFling
        local isEmotes = string.sub(name, 1, 7) == "EMOTES " or name == "FE Animations" or name == "About"
        local isGameEmotes = isEmotes and string.find(name, "GAME EMOTES", 1, true) ~= nil
        local isMisc = string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "MISC " or name == "Inventory Unlimiter V5" or name == "Pm-WallHop"
        local isTroll = string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "TROLL " or name == "Backshots"
        local isMap = string.sub(name, 1, 4) == "MAP "
        local isFarm = string.sub(name, 1, 5) == "FARM "
        local isPlugin = string.sub(name, 1, 6) == "PLUGIN"
        local col, page = nil, "aim"
            if isPlugin then __R1.sectionCount += 1; col = cols[(__R1.sectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "aim"
        elseif isVisual then __R1.visualSectionCount += 1; col = visualCols[(__R1.visualSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "visual"
        elseif isMain then __R1.mainSectionCount += 1; col = mainCols[(__R1.mainSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "main"
        elseif isWorld then __R1.worldSectionCount += 1; col = worldCols[(__R1.worldSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "world"
        elseif isGameEmotes then col = emotesGameCol or emotesCols[1]; page = "emotes"
        elseif isEmotes then __R1.emotesSectionCount += 1; col = emotesCols[(__R1.emotesSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "emotes"
        elseif isMisc then __R1.miscSectionCount += 1; col = miscCols[(__R1.miscSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "misc"
        elseif isTroll then __R1.trollSectionCount += 1; col = trollCols[(__R1.trollSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "troll"
        elseif isMap then __R1.mapSectionCount += 1; col = mapCols[(__R1.mapSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "map"
        elseif isFarm then __R1.farmSectionCount += 1; col = farmCols[(__R1.farmSectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1]; page = "farm"
        else __R1.sectionCount += 1; col = cols[(__R1.sectionCount - 1) % 2 + 1] end
        local panel = New("Frame", { Parent = col, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BackgroundTransparency = .72, ClipsDescendants = true })
        corner(panel, 3); stroke(panel, C.border, .35)
        hudBrackets(panel, 10, 1.25, C.accent, .62, 5)
        hudBrackets(panel, 10, 1.25, C.accent, .62, 5)
        New("UIGradient", { Parent = panel, Rotation = 20, Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(13, 44, 50)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(5, 18, 24)) }),
        Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, .9) }) })
        hudBrackets(panel, 12, 1.5, C.accent, .55, 5)
        local sepY = (description and description ~= "") and 44 or 30
        local tick = New("Frame", { Parent = panel, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, sepY), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BackgroundTransparency = .62, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
        table.insert(__R1.sectionPanels, { panel = panel, page = page, name = string.lower(name .. " " .. (description or "")) })
        local shownName = name:gsub("^MAIN • ", ""):gsub("^AIM • ", ""):gsub("^WORLD • ", ""):gsub("^VISUAL • ", ""):gsub("^EMOTES • ", ""):gsub("^MISC • ", ""):gsub("^TROLL • ", ""):gsub("^MAP • ", ""):gsub("^FARM • ", "")
        kitiTitle(panel, shownName)
        if description and description ~= "" then kitiDesc(panel, description) end
        local holder = New("Frame", { Parent = panel, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, description ~= "" and 52 or 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
        New("UIListLayout", { Parent = holder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 7), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
        New("UIPadding", { Parent = holder, PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12) })
        holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(refreshCanvas); refreshCanvas()
        local api = { Name = name }
        local storagePrefix = name .. "::"
        -- при повторяющихся подписях внутри секции ключи не должны слипаться
        local usedStorageKeys = {}
            local function keyFor(label)
            local base = storagePrefix .. tostring(label)
            local n = (usedStorageKeys[base] or 0) + 1
            usedStorageKeys[base] = n
            if n == 1 then return base end
            return base .. "#" .. n
        end
            local function row(label, h)
            yieldDuringBuild()
            local r = New("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h or 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            local rowLabel = text(r, label, 14, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0))
            rowLabel.TextTransparency = .03
            rowLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -160, 0, h or 20)
            rowLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
            rowLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
            rowLabel.ClipsDescendants = true
                local hover = NoirFX.new(0, 20, 1, function(v)
                local c = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
                rowLabel.TextTransparency = .03 - .03 * c
                rowLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3 * c, 0)
            end)
            r.MouseEnter:Connect(function() hover:Set(1) end)
            r.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hover:Set(0) end)
            return r
        end
        local activeAppearancePopup = nil
        local activeAppearanceGear = nil
        local activeAppearanceInputConnection = nil
        local appearancePalette = {
        C.accent,
        Color3.fromRGB(90, 173, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(185, 124, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 184, 82),
        }
        local shapeRadii = { 0, 3, 9 }
        local sizeFactors = { .90, 1, 1.10 }
            local function appearanceGlyph(parent)
                for i = 1, 3 do
                New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5 + (i - 1) * 5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(13, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.dim, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 31 })
                New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7 + (i % 2) * 5, 4 + (i - 1) * 5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent2, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 32 })
            end
        end
            local function addAppearanceEditor(rowFrame, label, key, shapeTargets, scaleTarget, applyAccent)
            NoirPersistence.data.appearance = NoirPersistence.data.appearance or {}
            local saved = NoirPersistence.data.appearance[key]
            if typeof(saved) ~= "table" then saved = {}; NoirPersistence.data.appearance[key] = saved end
            local shapeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(saved.shape) or 2), 1, #shapeRadii)
            local colorIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(saved.color) or 1), 1, #appearancePalette)
            local sizeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(saved.size) or 2), 1, #sizeFactors)
            local gear = New("TextButton", { Parent = rowFrame, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, BackgroundTransparency = .18, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 25 })
            corner(gear, 4); stroke(gear, C.border, .28, 1)
            appearanceGlyph(gear)
            local scaleNode
                if scaleTarget then
                scaleNode = scaleTarget:FindFirstChild("NoirControlScale")
                if not scaleNode then scaleNode = New("UIScale", { Name = "NoirControlScale", Parent = scaleTarget, Scale = sizeFactors[sizeIndex] }) end
            end
                local function applyShape(index)
                shapeIndex = math.clamp(index, 1, #shapeRadii)
                for _, target in ipairs(shapeTargets or {}) do if target and target.Parent then corner(target, shapeRadii[shapeIndex]) end end
            end
                local function applySize(index)
                sizeIndex = math.clamp(index, 1, #sizeFactors)
                if scaleNode and scaleNode.Parent then scaleNode.Scale = sizeFactors[sizeIndex] end
            end
                local function applyColor(index)
                colorIndex = math.clamp(index, 1, #appearancePalette)
                if applyAccent then applyAccent(appearancePalette[colorIndex]) end
            end
            applyShape(shapeIndex); applySize(sizeIndex); applyColor(colorIndex)
                local function saveAppearance()
                NoirPersistence.data.appearance[key] = { shape = shapeIndex, color = colorIndex, size = sizeIndex }
                NoirPersistence.Save()
            end
                local function styleOption(button, selected, color)
                button.BackgroundColor3 = color or (selected and Color3.fromRGB(17, 67, 71) or C.surface)
                button.BackgroundTransparency = selected and .08 or .25
                local border = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if border then
                    border.Color = selected and C.accent2 or C.border
                    border.Transparency = selected and .04 or .45
                end
            end
                local function closePopup(p)
                if not p or not p.Parent then return end
                if activeAppearanceInputConnection then activeAppearanceInputConnection:Disconnect(); activeAppearanceInputConnection = nil end
                    if activeAppearancePopup == p then
                    activeAppearancePopup = nil
                    activeAppearanceGear = nil
                end
                local closeTween = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 138) })
                closeTween:Play(); closeTween.Completed:Connect(function() if p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end)
            end
                local function openPopup()
                if activeAppearancePopup then closePopup(activeAppearancePopup) end
                local h = 138
                local view = (Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)) / scale.Scale
                local w = math.min(226, math.max(180, view.X - 16))
                local px = gear.AbsolutePosition.X / scale.Scale + gear.AbsoluteSize.X / scale.Scale - w
                local py = (gear.AbsolutePosition.Y + gear.AbsoluteSize.Y) / scale.Scale + 6
                if px + w > view.X - 8 then px = view.X - w - 8 end
                px = math.clamp(px, 8, math.max(8, view.X - w - 8))
                if py + h > view.Y - 8 then py = gear.AbsolutePosition.Y / scale.Scale - h - 6 end
                py = math.clamp(py, 8, math.max(8, view.Y - h - 8))
                local p = New("Frame", { Parent = gui, Name = "NoirAppearancePopup", Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h), BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BackgroundTransparency = .04,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 80 })
                activeAppearancePopup = p
                activeAppearanceGear = gear
                corner(p, 7); stroke(p, C.accent, .22, 1.2)
                New("UIGradient", { Parent = p, Rotation = 16, Color = ColorSequence.new(C.surface, C.panel),
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .12), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, .02) }) })
                hudBrackets(p, 11, 1.3, C.accent2, .1, 84)
                New("TextLabel", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 7), Size = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 16),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "CONTROL DESIGN  /  " .. tostring(label), TextColor3 = C.accent2,
                TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 85 })
                local closeBtn = New("TextButton", { Parent = p, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -7, 0, 5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, Text = "×", TextColor3 = C.dim,
                TextSize = 16, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 86 })
                corner(closeBtn, 3); stroke(closeBtn, C.border, .5)
                closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(closeBtn, TweenInfo.new(.1), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
                closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(closeBtn, TweenInfo.new(.14), { BackgroundColor3 = C.surface }):Play() end)
                local formLabel = New("TextLabel", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 32), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "FORM", TextColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 85 })
                local formButtons = {}
                    for i, name in ipairs({ "CUT", "SOFT", "ROUND" }) do
                    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64 + (i - 1) * 51, 30),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 21), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, Text = name,
                    TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 85 })
                    corner(b, shapeRadii[i]); stroke(b, C.border, .4)
                    formButtons[i] = b
                        b.Activated:Connect(function()
                        applyShape(i); saveAppearance()
                        for j, option in ipairs(formButtons) do styleOption(option, j == shapeIndex) end
                    end)
                end
                local colorLabel = New("TextLabel", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 60), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "COLOR", TextColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 85 })
                local colorButtons = {}
                    for i, color in ipairs(appearancePalette) do
                    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(70 + (i - 1) * 34, 58),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 18), BackgroundColor3 = color, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 85 })
                    corner(b, 3); stroke(b, C.border, .35)
                    colorButtons[i] = b
                        b.Activated:Connect(function()
                        applyColor(i); saveAppearance()
                        for j, option in ipairs(colorButtons) do styleOption(option, j == colorIndex, appearancePalette[j]) end
                    end)
                end
                local sizeLabel = New("TextLabel", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 87), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 18),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "SIZE", TextColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = 85 })
                local sizeButtons = {}
                    for i, name in ipairs({ "S", "M", "L" }) do
                    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64 + (i - 1) * 51, 85),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 21), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, Text = name,
                    TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 85 })
                    corner(b, 3); stroke(b, C.border, .4)
                    sizeButtons[i] = b
                        b.Activated:Connect(function()
                        applySize(i); saveAppearance()
                        for j, option in ipairs(sizeButtons) do styleOption(option, j == sizeIndex) end
                    end)
                end
                local foot = New("TextLabel", { Parent = p, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 114), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 14),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Changes save automatically", TextColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 9,
                Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 85 })
                for i, b in ipairs(formButtons) do styleOption(b, i == shapeIndex) end
                for i, b in ipairs(colorButtons) do styleOption(b, i == colorIndex, appearancePalette[i]) end
                for i, b in ipairs(sizeButtons) do styleOption(b, i == sizeIndex) end
                closeBtn.Activated:Connect(function() closePopup(p) end)
                    activeAppearanceInputConnection = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if not isPrimaryPress(input) or not p.Parent then return end
                    local point = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
                    local p0, ps = p.AbsolutePosition, p.AbsoluteSize
                    local g0, gs = gear.AbsolutePosition, gear.AbsoluteSize
                    local insidePanel = point.X >= p0.X and point.X <= p0.X + ps.X and point.Y >= p0.Y and point.Y <= p0.Y + ps.Y
                    local insideGear = point.X >= g0.X and point.X <= g0.X + gs.X and point.Y >= g0.Y and point.Y <= g0.Y + gs.Y
                    if not insidePanel and not insideGear then closePopup(p) end
                end)
                TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h) }):Play()
            end
                gear.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(gear, TweenInfo.new(.14), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play()
            end)
                gear.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(gear, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = C.surface }):Play()
            end)
                gear.Activated:Connect(function()
                    if activeAppearancePopup and activeAppearanceGear == gear then
                    closePopup(activeAppearancePopup)
                else
                    openPopup()
                end
            end)
            return gear
        end
            function api:AddToggle(label, callback)
            local key = keyFor(label)
            local savedToggle = NoirPersistence.data.toggles[key]
                if savedToggle == nil and NoirPersistence.safeLegacy[label] then
                savedToggle = NoirPersistence.data.toggles[label]
                if savedToggle ~= nil then NoirPersistence.data.toggles[key] = savedToggle; NoirPersistence.Save() end
            end
            local state = savedToggle == true
            local r = row(label, 20)
            local pill = New("TextButton", { Parent = r, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 18),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.off, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
            corner(pill, 9)
            New("UIGradient", { Parent = pill, Rotation = 15, Color = ColorSequence.new(C.accent, C.off),
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, .78), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) })
            local pillStroke = stroke(pill, C.border, 0, 1.2)
            local pillGlow = New("UIStroke", { Parent = pill, Color = C.accent, Thickness = 2.5, Transparency = 1,
            ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
            local dot = New("Frame", { Parent = pill, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, .5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9), BackgroundColor3 = C.dim, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = 45 })
            local dotStroke = stroke(dot, C.accent2, .25, 1)
            local toggleAccent = C.accent
                local togSpring = NoirFX.new(state and 1 or 0, 24, .62, function(t)
                local c = math.clamp(t, 0, 1)
                local size = 9 + 1.5 * math.sin(c * math.pi)
                dot.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 + t * 18, .5, 0)
                dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
                pill.BackgroundColor3 = C.off:Lerp(toggleAccent, .22 * c)
                pillStroke.Color = C.border:Lerp(toggleAccent, c)
                pillGlow.Color = toggleAccent
                pillGlow.Transparency = 1 - .62 * c
                dot.BackgroundColor3 = C.dim:Lerp(toggleAccent, c)
                dotStroke.Color = toggleAccent:Lerp(C.accent2, .55)
            end)
                local function set(v, persist, animate)
                state = v == true
                if animate == false then togSpring:Snap(state and 1 or 0) else togSpring:Set(state and 1 or 0) end
                callback(state)
                if persist ~= false then NoirPersistence.data.toggles[key] = state; NoirPersistence.Save() end
            end
            local lastClick = 0
                local function toggleClick()
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - lastClick < .18 then return end
                lastClick = now
                set(not state, true)
            end
            pill.Activated:Connect(toggleClick)
                addAppearanceEditor(r, label, key, { pill, dot }, pill, function(color)
                toggleAccent = color
                togSpring:Snap(state and 1 or 0)
            end)
            pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 1)
            set(state, false, false)
            return function(v) set(v == nil and not state or v, true) end
        end
            function api:AddButton(label, callback)
            yieldDuringBuild()
            local key = keyFor(label)
            local actionRow = New("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            -- NOIR design v4: единая плоская кнопка (Material 3 state layer) —
            -- плотный корпус RGB(30,40,44), тонкая рамка, три состояния:
            -- покой / ховер светлее / нажатие темнее. Только акцент-бар и
            -- шеврон — без градиентов, скобок и шума; текст 14px (>= 4.5:1).
            local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = actionRow, Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 24, 30),
            BackgroundTransparency = 0, Text = NoirTr(label), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, AutoButtonColor = false })
            New("UIPadding", { Parent = b, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8) })
            corner(b, 6); local bRing = ringStroke(b, 1.3, .38)
            -- CYBER HUD v7: неоновая рамка + HUD-скобки по углам
            do
            local ringGrad = New("UIGradient", { Parent = bRing, Rotation = 35, Color = NoirCyberHUD.CYAN })
            pcall(function() NoirCyberHUD._register(b, ringGrad) end)
        end
        do
        local bks = hudBrackets(b, 9, 1.5, C.accent2, .35, 3)
        for _, f in ipairs(bks) do f.Name = "NoirBracket" end
    end
    local accentBar = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.accent2, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    corner(accentBar, 1.5)
    New("UIGradient", { Parent = accentBar, Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(C.accent, C.accent2) })
    local chev = New("TextLabel", { Parent = b, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, .5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "›", TextColor3 = C.accent, TextSize = 20, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold })
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(chev, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, .5, 0) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(chev, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, .5, 0) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 40, 50) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 24, 30) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 18, 23) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 40, 50) }):Play() end)
    local lastClick = 0
        local function fire()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastClick < .18 then return end
        lastClick = now
        callback()
    end
    b.Activated:Connect(fire)
        addAppearanceEditor(actionRow, label, key, { b }, b, function(color)
        bRing.Color = color
        accentBar.BackgroundColor3 = color
        chev.TextColor3 = color
    end)
    return b
end
    function api:AddSlider(label, min, max, default, callback)
    local key = keyFor(label)
    local savedSlider = NoirPersistence.data.sliders[key]
        if savedSlider == nil then
        savedSlider = NoirPersistence.data.sliders[label]
        if savedSlider ~= nil then NoirPersistence.data.sliders[key] = savedSlider; NoirPersistence.Save() end
    end
    default = tonumber(savedSlider) or default
    local r = row(label, 30)
    local value = New("TextBox", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 18), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface,
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = tostring(default), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
    local track = New("Frame", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 4), BackgroundColor3 = C.off, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    local fill = New("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromScale((default - min) / (max - min), 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    -- Flat rail end keeps the HUD slider crisp and technical.
    local fillGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = fill, Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(12, 120, 130)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.55, C.accent),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C.accent2) }) })
        for gi = 1, 15 do
        New("Frame", { Parent = track, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.new(gi / 16, 0, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 8), BackgroundColor3 = C.base, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3 })
    end
    local knob = New("Frame", { Parent = track, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = 45 })
    knob.ZIndex = 5; stroke(knob, C.accent2, .12, 1.4)
    do
        local function glow(parent)
        New("ImageLabel", { Parent = parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = "rbxassetid://112971167999062", ImageColor3 = C.accent, ImageTransparency = .68,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 15, 1, 15), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice,
        SliceCenter = Rect.new(Vector2.new(112, 112), Vector2.new(147, 147)), SliceScale = .6, ZIndex = 2 })
    end
    glow(fill); glow(knob)
end
local current = default
local halo = New("UIStroke", { Parent = knob, Color = C.accent2, Thickness = 4, Transparency = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
    local alphaSpring = NoirFX.new((default - min) / (max - min), 24, .78, function(a)
    local c = math.clamp(a, 0, 1)
    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(c, 1)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(c, 0, .5, 0)
end)
    local grabSpring = NoirFX.new(0, 26, .8, function(g)
    local c = math.clamp(g, 0, 1)
    local size = 11 + 2 * g
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    halo.Transparency = 1 - .7 * c
    value.TextSize = 14 + 2 * c
end)
    local function set(v, persist)
    current = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or current or default) + .5), min, max)
    alphaSpring:Set((current - min) / (max - min))
    value.Text = tostring(current)
    callback(current)
    if persist ~= false then NoirPersistence.data.sliders[key] = current; NoirPersistence.Save() end
end
    addAppearanceEditor(r, label, key, { track, knob }, track, function(color)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = color
    fillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(12, 120, 130), color:Lerp(C.accent2, .38))
        for _, root in ipairs({ fill, knob }) do
            for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("ImageLabel") then child.ImageColor3 = color end
        end
    end
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = color
    local knobStroke = knob:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if knobStroke then knobStroke.Color = color:Lerp(C.accent2, .5) end
    halo.Color = color:Lerp(C.accent2, .4)
end)
value.Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 0)
set(default, false)
alphaSpring:Snap((current - min) / (max - min))
value.FocusLost:Connect(function() set(value.Text) end)
local drag = false
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        drag = true; grabSpring:Set(1); set(min + (max - min) * math.clamp((i.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1))
    end
end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        set(min + (max - min) * math.clamp((i.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / track.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1))
    end
end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false; grabSpring:Set(0) end
end)
return { SetValue = function(_, v, persist) set(v, persist) end, GetValue = function() return current end }
end
    function api:AddDropdown(label, values, callback)
    local key = keyFor(label)
    local r = row(label, 46)
    local rowText = r:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
    if rowText then rowText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 18); rowText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top end
    local idx = table.find(values, NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns[key]) or 1
    local b = New("TextButton", { Parent = r, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44), Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 4 })
    corner(b, 8)
    local bStroke = stroke(b, C.border, .35)
    local dropdownAccent = C.accent
    local dropdownBar = New("Frame", { Parent = b, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16),
    BackgroundColor3 = dropdownAccent, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 })
    corner(dropdownBar, 1.5)
    local valueLabel = New("TextLabel", { Parent = b, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(9, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = tostring(values[idx] or "None"), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5 })
    -- NOIR fix: глиф "⌄" отсутствует в шрифтах Roblox на телефоне
    -- (рендерился пустым квадратом) — стрелка нарисована фреймами
    local arrow = New("Frame", { Parent = b, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, .5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 5 })
    local arrowColor = C.dim
    New("Frame", { Parent = arrow, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3.5, 4.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 2), Rotation = 45,
    BackgroundColor3 = arrowColor, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 })
    New("Frame", { Parent = arrow, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8.5, 4.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 2), Rotation = -45,
    BackgroundColor3 = arrowColor, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 5 })
    local function paintArrow() for _, seg in ipairs(arrow:GetChildren()) do seg.BackgroundColor3 = arrowColor end end
    local quart = TweenInfo.new(.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, quart, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, quart, { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(21, 28, 32) }):Play() end)
    b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
    local popup
        local function close()
        if popup then popup:Destroy(); popup = nil end
        TweenService:Create(arrow, quart, { Rotation = 0 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(bStroke, quart, { Color = dropdownAccent }):Play()
    end
        local function set(v, silent)
        local found = table.find(values, v)
        if found then idx = found end
        valueLabel.Text = tostring(values[idx] or "None")
            if values[idx] ~= nil then
            callback(values[idx])
                if not silent then
                NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns[key] = values[idx]
                NoirPersistence.Save()
            end
        end
    end
        local function open()
        close()
        local rowH = 30
        -- NOIR fix: весь список сразу (как в старом меню), высота упирается
        -- только в экран; у нижнего края раскрываемся вверх, по X прижимаем
        local view = (Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)) / scale.Scale
        local w = b.AbsoluteSize.X / scale.Scale
        local fullH = math.min(#values * rowH + 8, math.max(120, view.Y * 0.6))
        local px = b.AbsolutePosition.X / scale.Scale
        local py = (b.AbsolutePosition.Y + b.AbsoluteSize.Y + 4) / scale.Scale
        if py + fullH > view.Y - 8 then py = b.AbsolutePosition.Y / scale.Scale - fullH - 4 end
        px = math.clamp(px, 8, math.max(8, view.X - w - 8))
        py = math.clamp(py, 8, math.max(8, view.Y - fullH - 8))
        popup = New("ScrollingFrame", { Parent = gui, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 0), CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, #values * rowH + 8), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.accent, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 3000 })
        corner(popup, 7); stroke(popup, C.accent, .3)
        -- NOIR fix: декор-скобки больше НЕ кладём внутрь попапа:
        -- UIListLayout принимает их за пункты списка (~36px сверху),
        -- из-за этого при двух значениях был виден только один выбор
        New("UIPadding", { Parent = popup, PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 4), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 4) })
        New("UIListLayout", { Parent = popup, SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
            for i, v in ipairs(values) do
            local selected = i == idx
            local item = New("TextButton", { Parent = popup, LayoutOrder = i, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, rowH), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63),
            BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 1, Text = tostring(v), TextColor3 = selected and dropdownAccent:Lerp(C.accent2, .45) or C.text, TextSize = 14,
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 3001 })
            corner(item, 5)
            New("UIPadding", { Parent = item, PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10) })
            item.MouseEnter:Connect(function() if not selected then TweenService:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(.1), { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play() end end)
            item.MouseLeave:Connect(function() if not selected then TweenService:Create(item, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play() end end)
            item.Activated:Connect(function() set(v); close() end)
        end
        TweenService:Create(popup, quart, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, fullH) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(arrow, quart, { Rotation = 180 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(bStroke, quart, { Color = dropdownAccent }):Play()
    end
    local lastOpen = 0
        local function togglePopup()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastOpen < .18 then return end
        lastOpen = now
        if popup then close() else open() end
    end
    b.Activated:Connect(togglePopup)
        addAppearanceEditor(r, label, key, { b }, b, function(color)
        dropdownAccent = color
        dropdownBar.BackgroundColor3 = color
        bStroke.Color = color
        arrowColor = color; paintArrow()
            if popup then
            local popupStroke = popup:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if popupStroke then popupStroke.Color = color end
        end
    end)
        if NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns[key] ~= nil and values[idx] ~= nil then
        pcall(callback, values[idx])
    end
    local ctl = {}
    function ctl:SetValue(v) set(v) end
    function ctl:Select(v) set(v) end
    function ctl:Refresh(newValues, selected) values = newValues or {}; idx = 1; set(selected or values[1], true) end
    function ctl:ChangeItems(newValues) values = newValues or {}; idx = 1; set(values[1], true) end
    return ctl
end
    function api:AddTextBox(label, callback)
    local key = keyFor(label)
    local r = row(label, 24)
    local savedText = NoirPersistence.data.textboxes[key]
    local box = New("TextBox", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(1, -200, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.surface,
    Text = type(savedText) == "string" and savedText or "", PlaceholderText = NoirTr(label), TextColor3 = C.text, PlaceholderColor3 = C.dim, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
    corner(box, 6); local boxStroke = stroke(box, C.border, 0)
    -- NOIR: подсветка поля акцентом при фокусе (учитывает свой цвет)
    local boxAccent = C.accent
    box.Focused:Connect(function() boxStroke.Color = boxAccent end)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function() boxStroke.Color = C.border end)
        addAppearanceEditor(r, label, key, { box }, box, function(color)
        boxAccent = color
        boxStroke.Color = color
    end)
        if type(savedText) == "string" and savedText ~= "" then
        pcall(callback, savedText)
    end
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        NoirPersistence.data.textboxes[key] = box.Text
        NoirPersistence.Save()
        callback(box.Text)
    end)
    return { SetValue = function(_, v) box.Text = tostring(v); NoirPersistence.data.textboxes[key] = box.Text; NoirPersistence.Save() end }
end
    function api:AddLabel(label)
    local r = row(label, 18)
    local labelObject = r:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
    return { SetValue = function(_, value) if labelObject and labelObject.Parent then labelObject.Text = tostring(value) end end,
    GetValue = function() return labelObject and labelObject.Text or "" end,
    Instance = r }
end
    function api:AddParagraph(title, body)
    local r = row(tostring(title or ""), 76)
    -- NOIR fix: заголовок абзаца центрировался по всей высоте строки
    -- (76px) и налезал на первую строку описания — теперь он прижат к
    -- верху строки, описание начинается под ним
    local titleLab = r:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
        if titleLab then
        titleLab.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
        titleLab.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    end
        if body and tostring(body) ~= "" then
        local detail = text(r, tostring(body), 12, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24), true)
        detail.TextWrapped = true
        detail.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        detail.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        detail.ClipsDescendants = true
        detail.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
    end
    return r
end

    end

        NoirPersistence.data.colors[colorKey] = { colour.R, colour.G, colour.B }

        if colorDirty then colorDirty = false; NoirPersistence.Save() end
    end

        if typeof(value) ~= "Color3" then return end
        colour = value
        swatch.BackgroundColor3 = colour
        if callback then callback(colour) end
            if mode == "defer" then
            storeColor(); colorDirty = true
        elseif mode == true then
            storeColor(); NoirPersistence.Save()
        end
    end
        local function closePicker()
        commitColor()
        if inputChanged then inputChanged:Disconnect(); inputChanged = nil end
        if inputEnded then inputEnded:Disconnect(); inputEnded = nil end
        if popup then popup:Destroy(); popup = nil end
    end

        local spectrumKnob = New("Frame", { Parent = spectrum, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 17), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 76 })
        corner(spectrumKnob, 9); New("UIStroke", { Parent = spectrumKnob, Color = C.text, Thickness = 2 })
        local hueBar = New("Frame", { Parent = valueCard, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 223), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(328, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = 73 })
        local rainbowTrack = New("Frame", { Parent = hueBar, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 73 })
        corner(rainbowTrack, 8); stroke(rainbowTrack, C.border, .25)

        Color3.fromRGB(170, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(65, 255, 0), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 90), Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 180),
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 235, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 155, 255), Color3.fromRGB(0, 65, 255), Color3.fromRGB(75, 0, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 255), Color3.fromRGB(220, 0, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 190), Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 105),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 42), Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        }
            for index, rainbowColor in ipairs(rainbow) do
            New("Frame", { Parent = rainbowTrack, Position = UDim2.new((index - 1) / #rainbow, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1 / #rainbow, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = rainbowColor, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 74 })
        end
        local hueKnob = New("Frame", { Parent = hueBar, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 24), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 76 })

            corner(field, 8); stroke(field, channelColors[index], .5)
            channelInputs[index] = field
        end
            local function setHSV(nextHue, nextSaturation, nextValue, mode)
            hue = math.clamp(nextHue, 0, 1)
            saturation = math.clamp(nextSaturation, 0, 1)
            value = math.clamp(nextValue, 0, 1)
            local selected = Color3.fromHSV(hue, saturation, value)
            spectrum.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
            spectrumKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(saturation, 1 - value)
            hueKnob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(hue, .5)
            preview.BackgroundColor3 = selected
            local hex = string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(selected.R * 255 + .5), math.floor(selected.G * 255 + .5), math.floor(selected.B * 255 + .5))
            previewHex.Text = hex .. "  •  100%"
            hexInput.Text = hex
            channelInputs[1].Text = tostring(math.floor(selected.R * 255 + .5))
            channelInputs[2].Text = tostring(math.floor(selected.G * 255 + .5))
            channelInputs[3].Text = tostring(math.floor(selected.B * 255 + .5))
            hueReadout.Text = "Hue " .. tostring(math.floor(hue * 360 + .5)) .. "°"
            setColor(selected, mode)
        end
            local function setRGB(red, green, blue, mode)
            local selected = Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(red) or 0) + .5), 0, 255), math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(green) or 0) + .5), 0, 255), math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(blue) or 0) + .5), 0, 255))
            local nextHue, nextSaturation, nextValue = selected:ToHSV()
            setHSV(nextHue, nextSaturation, nextValue, mode)
        end
            local function updateSpectrum(position)
            local size, origin = spectrum.AbsoluteSize, spectrum.AbsolutePosition
            setHSV(hue, math.clamp((position.X - origin.X) / math.max(1, size.X), 0, 1), 1 - math.clamp((position.Y - origin.Y) / math.max(1, size.Y), 0, 1), "defer")
        end
            local function updateHue(position)
            local size, origin = hueBar.AbsoluteSize, hueBar.AbsolutePosition
            setHSV(math.clamp((position.X - origin.X) / math.max(1, size.X), 0, 1), saturation, value, "defer")
        end
        local dragMode = nil
        spectrum.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if isPrimaryPress(input) then dragMode = "spectrum"; updateSpectrum(input.Position) end end)
        hueBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) if isPrimaryPress(input) then dragMode = "hue"; updateHue(input.Position) end end)
            hexInput.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local raw = tostring(hexInput.Text or ""):gsub("%s", ""):gsub("#", "")
            local redHex, greenHex, blueHex = raw:match("^(%x%x)(%x%x)(%x%x)$")
            if redHex and greenHex and blueHex then setRGB(tonumber(redHex, 16), tonumber(greenHex, 16), tonumber(blueHex, 16), true) else setHSV(hue, saturation, value, false) end
        end)
            for _, field in ipairs(channelInputs) do
                field.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                setRGB(tonumber(channelInputs[1].Text) or math.floor(colour.R * 255 + .5), tonumber(channelInputs[2].Text) or math.floor(colour.G * 255 + .5), tonumber(channelInputs[3].Text) or math.floor(colour.B * 255 + .5), true)
            end)
        end
            inputChanged = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if dragMode and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
                if dragMode == "spectrum" then updateSpectrum(input.Position) else updateHue(input.Position) end
            end
        end)
            inputEnded = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if isPrimaryPress(input) then dragMode = nil; commitColor() end
        end)
        closeButton.Activated:Connect(closePicker)
        setHSV(hue, saturation, value, false)
    end
    swatch.Activated:Connect(openPicker)
    setColor(colour, false)
    return { SetRGBValue = function(_, value) setColor(value, true) end, GetValue = function() return colour end }
end
    function api:AddKeybind(label, default, callback)
    local key = keyFor(label)
    local savedKey = NoirPersistence.data.keybinds[key] or default
    local r = row(label, 20)
    local btn = New("TextButton", { Parent = r, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 1), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 18),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44), Text = tostring(savedKey), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, AutoButtonColor = false })
    corner(btn, 6)
    -- NOIR design v4: плоский чип, акцентная рамка в режиме записи
    local bindStroke = stroke(btn, C.border, .35, 1.2)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44) }):Play() end)
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(21, 28, 32) }):Play() end)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
        addAppearanceEditor(r, label, key, { btn }, btn, function(color)
        bindStroke.Color = color
    end)
    local listening, currentKey, conn = false, savedKey, nil
        if NoirPersistence.data.keybinds[key] ~= nil and currentKey ~= nil then
        pcall(callback, currentKey)
    end
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        listening = true; btn.Text = "Press a key..."; bindStroke.Color = C.accent2
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not listening then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                currentKey = input.KeyCode.Name; btn.Text = currentKey; listening = false; bindStroke.Color = C.border
                NoirPersistence.data.keybinds[key] = currentKey; NoirPersistence.Save()
                callback(currentKey); conn:Disconnect()
            elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                currentKey = "MouseButton1"; btn.Text = currentKey; listening = false; bindStroke.Color = C.border
                NoirPersistence.data.keybinds[key] = currentKey; NoirPersistence.Save()
                callback(currentKey); conn:Disconnect()
            end
        end)
    end)
    return { SetValue = function(_, v) currentKey = v; btn.Text = tostring(v) end, GetValue = function() return currentKey end }
end
return api
end
return tab
end
