    function validTarget(player)
    local character = player and player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
    return player ~= nil and player ~= LocalPlayer and character ~= nil and humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
function localCharacter() return LocalPlayer.Character end
    function localHumanoid()
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c ~= __R1.localHumChar or not __R1.localHumCache or not __R1.localHumCache.Parent then
        __R1.localHumChar = c
        __R1.localHumCache = c and c:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or nil
    end
    return __R1.localHumCache
end
    function localRoot()
    local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c ~= __R1.localRootChar or not __R1.localRootCache or not __R1.localRootCache.Parent then
        __R1.localRootChar = c
        __R1.localRootCache = c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")) or nil
    end
    return __R1.localRootCache
end
    function playerHasTool(player, toolName)
    local character = player and player.Character
    local backpack = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (character and character:FindFirstChild(toolName)) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName))
end
__R1.friendCache = {}
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) __R1.friendCache[p] = nil end)
    function isFriend(player)
    if not __R1.config.ignoreFriends or player == nil then return false end
    local cached = __R1.friendCache[player]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
    local ok, res = pcall(function() return player:IsFriendsWith(LocalPlayer.UserId) end)
    local value = (ok and res == true)
    __R1.friendCache[player] = value
    return value
end
    function distanceTo(player)
    local root = localRoot()
    local targetCharacter = entityCharacter(player)
    local t = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if root and t then return (t.Position - root.Position).Magnitude end
    return math.huge
end
    local function playerIsInLobby(player)
    if not player then return true end
    local teamName = player.Team and string.lower(tostring(player.Team.Name)) or ""
        if string.find(teamName, "lobby", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "spectat", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "observer", 1, true)
        or string.find(teamName, "waiting", 1, true) then
        return true
    end
    local containers = { player, player.Character }
        for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
            if container then
                for key, value in pairs(container:GetAttributes()) do
                local k = string.lower(tostring(key))
                    if (string.find(k, "inround", 1, true) or string.find(k, "ingame", 1, true)
                    or string.find(k, "isplaying", 1, true) or string.find(k, "alive", 1, true))
                    and value == false then
                    return true
                end
                    if string.find(k, "state", 1, true) or string.find(k, "status", 1, true)
                    or string.find(k, "location", 1, true) or string.find(k, "place", 1, true) then
                    local textValue = string.lower(tostring(value))
                        if string.find(textValue, "lobby", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "spectat", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "dead", 1, true)
                        or string.find(textValue, "waiting", 1, true) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
                for _, name in ipairs({ "InLobby", "Spectating", "Dead", "IsDead" }) do
                local flag = container:FindFirstChild(name)
                if flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue") and flag.Value then return true end
            end
                for _, name in ipairs({ "InRound", "InGame", "IsPlaying", "Alive", "IsAlive" }) do
                local flag = container:FindFirstChild(name)
                if flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue") and not flag.Value then return true end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
do -- Noir infection block: scope its locals (Luau 200-register limit)
-- ===== Infection mode: target NPC zombies + infected players =====
-- The first zombie of the round is a workspace NPC (not a Player), the rest
-- are infected players. Both must be valid silent-aim targets.
__R1.__infectionState = { npcs = {}, nextScan = 0, entity = nil, entityAt = 0, markerPlayers = {}, markersAt = 0 }
NoirGenv().__NoirInfectionRuntime = __R1.__infectionState
    function entityCharacter(entity)
    if typeof(entity) == "Instance" and entity:IsA("Model") then return entity end
    return (entity and entity.Character) or nil
end
    local function zombieWordIn(textValue)
    local lowered = string.lower(tostring(textValue or ""))
    return string.find(lowered, "zomb", 1, true) ~= nil
    or string.find(lowered, "infect", 1, true) ~= nil
    or string.find(lowered, "undead", 1, true) ~= nil
end
    local function modelRoot(model)
    return model and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart) or nil
end
    local function modelHasZombieMarker(model)
    if zombieWordIn(model.Name) then return true end
        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
            for key, value in pairs(model:GetAttributes()) do
            if zombieWordIn(key) or (type(value) == "string" and zombieWordIn(value)) then return true end
        end
            for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
            if (child:IsA("BoolValue") or child:IsA("StringValue")) and zombieWordIn(child.Name) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end)
    return ok and hit or false
end
    local function playerHasZombieMarker(player)
    if not player then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
        if now - __R1.__infectionState.markersAt >= 0.5 then
        table.clear(__R1.__infectionState.markerPlayers)
        __R1.__infectionState.markersAt = now
    end
    local cached = __R1.__infectionState.markerPlayers[player]
    if cached ~= nil then return cached end
        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
        if player.Team and zombieWordIn(player.Team.Name) then return true end
            for key, value in pairs(player:GetAttributes()) do
            if value == true and zombieWordIn(key) then return true end
        end
        local character = player.Character
            if character then
                for key, value in pairs(character:GetAttributes()) do
                if value == true and zombieWordIn(key) then return true end
            end
                for _, inst in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if inst:IsA("BoolValue") and inst.Value and zombieWordIn(inst.Name) then return true end
                    if (inst:IsA("StringValue") or inst:IsA("IntValue") or inst:IsA("ObjectValue"))
                and zombieWordIn(inst.Name) then return true end
            end
        end
        return false
    end)
    hit = ok and hit or false
    __R1.__infectionState.markerPlayers[player] = hit
    return hit
end
    local function localHasGun()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
    or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil) or false
end
    function scanZombieNPCs(force)
    local now = os.clock()
    if not force and now < __R1.__infectionState.nextScan then return __R1.__infectionState.npcs end
    __R1.__infectionState.nextScan = now + 1.2
    local strict, loose = {}, {}
        pcall(function()
            for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if model:IsA("Model") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model) then
                local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = modelRoot(model)
                    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
                        if modelHasZombieMarker(model) then
                        strict[#strict + 1] = model
                    else
                        loose[#loose + 1] = model
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
        if #strict > 0 then
        __R1.__infectionState.npcs = strict
    else
        -- heuristic fallback: the first zombie NPC may carry no marker; accept
        -- non-player humanoids while another infection signal exists
        local signal = localHasGun()
            if not signal then
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if player ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasZombieMarker(player) then
                    signal = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        __R1.__infectionState.npcs = signal and loose or {}
    end
    return __R1.__infectionState.npcs
end
    function nearestZombieEntity()
    if not __R1.config.infectionZombies then return nil end
    local now = os.clock()
        if __R1.__infectionState.entity and now - __R1.__infectionState.entityAt < 0.35 then
        local cached = __R1.__infectionState.entity
        local stillOk = false
            pcall(function()
                if typeof(cached) == "Instance" and cached.Parent then
                    if cached:IsA("Model") then
                    local humanoid = cached:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    stillOk = humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and modelRoot(cached) ~= nil
                else
                    stillOk = validTarget(cached) and cached.Character ~= nil
                end
            end
        end)
        if stillOk then return cached end
        __R1.__infectionState.entity = nil
    end
    local origin = localRoot()
    if not origin then return nil end
    local best, bestDistance
        local function consider(candidate, candidateRoot)
        if not candidateRoot then return end
        local d = (candidateRoot.Position - origin.Position).Magnitude
        if __R1.config.maxDistance > 0 and d > __R1.config.maxDistance then return end
            if __R1.config.fovSize > 0 then
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                if cam then
                local screen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(candidateRoot.Position)
                local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
                if screen.Z <= 0 or (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude > __R1.config.fovSize / 2 then return end
            end
        end
        if not bestDistance or d < bestDistance then best, bestDistance = candidate, d end
    end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and validTarget(player)
            and not playerIsInLobby(player) and playerHasZombieMarker(player) then
            local character = player.Character
            consider(player, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil)
        end
    end
    -- NOIR fix v2 (hub style): в режиме инфекции выжившие держат Gun,
    -- зомби — нет. Если поиск по маркерам никого не нашёл, целимся в
    -- ближайшего безоружного игрока в раунде (дистанция/FOV учитываются
    -- в consider), поэтому стрелять перестаёт "залипать" на одном зомби
        if not best then
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and validTarget(player)
                and not playerIsInLobby(player) and not isFriend(player)
                and not playerHasTool(player, "Gun") then
                local character = player.Character
                consider(player, character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil)
            end
        end
    end
        for _, model in ipairs(scanZombieNPCs()) do
        local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then consider(model, modelRoot(model)) end
    end
    __R1.__infectionState.entity = best
    __R1.__infectionState.entityAt = now
    return best
end
end -- /Noir infection block (locals freed: Luau 200-register limit)
    function setTarget(player)
    if not validTarget(player) then player = nil end
        if __R1.murderer ~= player then
        __R1.murderer = player
        if player then notify("Target: " .. player.Name, 2) end
    end
end
    function findByKnife()
        for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasTool(player, "Knife") then return player end
    end
end
    function findByGun()
        for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and playerHasTool(player, "Gun") then return player end
    end
end

local roleBus = { revision = 0, listeners = {} }
    function roleBus:Subscribe(callback)
    if type(callback) ~= "function" then return function() end end
    self.listeners[#self.listeners + 1] = callback
    local index = #self.listeners
    return function() self.listeners[index] = false end
end
    function roleBus:Emit()
    self.revision += 1
    for _, callback in ipairs(self.listeners) do if type(callback) == "function" then pcall(callback, self.revision) end end
end
NoirGenv().__NoirV4RoleBus = roleBus
end

    local function firstPart(inst)
    if not inst then return nil end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
        if inst:IsA("Model") then
        return inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
    end
    return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
    local function safeCFrame(cf)
    if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then return nil end
    local dest = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
    if typeof(dest) == "number" and cf.Position.Y < dest + 40 then return nil end
    return cf
end
    local function tpToCF(cf)
    cf = safeCFrame(cf)
    if not cf then notify("Небезопасная точка телепорта", 2); return false end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = localRoot()
    if not char or not root then notify("Нет персонажа", 2); return false end
        pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
        if not pcall(function() char:PivotTo(cf) end) then
        root.CFrame = cf
    end
        pcall(function()
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
    return true
end
    local function pickFrom(model)
    if not model then return nil end
    local named = model:FindFirstChild("Spawns") or model:FindFirstChild("Spawn") or model:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") or model:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpawns")
        if named then
        if named:IsA("BasePart") then return named.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
        local parts = {}
            for _, child in ipairs(named:GetChildren()) do
            local p = firstPart(child)
            if p then parts[#parts + 1] = p end
        end
        if #parts > 0 then return parts[math.random(1, #parts)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
        local p = firstPart(named)
        if p then return p.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
    end
    local sl = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
    if sl then return sl.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
    local ok, boxCF, size = pcall(function() return model:GetBoundingBox() end)
        if ok and typeof(boxCF) == "CFrame" then
        local lift = 8
        if typeof(size) == "Vector3" then lift = math.max(8, size.Y * 0.15) end
        return boxCF + Vector3.new(0, lift, 0)
    end
    local p = firstPart(model)
    if p then return p.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0) end
    return nil
end
    local function findMapModel()
        for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer") then return child end
    end
    local named = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if named then return named end
    return nil
end
    local function mapCFrame(map)
    if not map then return nil end
    local coins = map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
        if coins then
        local coin = coins:FindFirstChild("Coin_Server") or coins:FindFirstChild("CoinVisual") or coins:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if coin then
            if coin:IsA("BasePart") then return coin.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) end
            local p = firstPart(coin)
            if p then return p.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) end
        end
            for _, child in ipairs(coins:GetChildren()) do
            local p = firstPart(child)
            if p then return p.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0) end
        end
    end
    return pickFrom(map)
end
    local function lobbyCFrame()
    local map = findMapModel()
        local function fromSpawns(folder)
        if not folder then return nil end
        local parts = {}
            for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            local p = firstPart(child)
            if p then parts[#parts + 1] = p end
        end
            if #parts == 0 then
            local p = firstPart(folder)
            if p then parts[1] = p end
        end
        if #parts > 0 then return parts[math.random(1, #parts)].CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
    end
        local function fromInst(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        if map and (inst == map or inst:IsDescendantOf(map)) then return nil end
        local cf = fromSpawns(inst:FindFirstChild("Spawns") or inst:FindFirstChild("Spawn") or inst:FindFirstChild("SpawnLocation") or inst:FindFirstChild("PlayerSpawns"))
        if cf then return cf end
        local sl = inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation", true)
        if sl then return sl.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) end
            if inst:IsA("SpawnLocation") or inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            return inst.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
        end
            if inst:IsA("Model") then
            local ok, pivot = pcall(function() return inst:GetPivot() end)
            if ok and typeof(pivot) == "CFrame" then return pivot * CFrame.new(0, 6, 0) end
        end
    end
        local function isLobbyName(n)
        n = string.lower(tostring(n or ""))
        return n == "lobby" or string.find(n, "lobby", 1, true) ~= nil
        or n == "waiting" or n == "waitingroom" or n == "vote" or n == "voting" or n == "votingroom"
    end
        for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if isLobbyName(child.Name) then
            local cf = fromInst(child)
            if cf then return cf end
        end
    end
    local okDesc, descendants = pcall(function() return workspace:GetDescendants() end)
        if okDesc and descendants then
            for i = 1, #descendants do
            local inst = descendants[i]
            local n = inst.Name
                if (n == "Spawns" or n == "Spawn" or n == "PlayerSpawns") and inst.Parent and isLobbyName(inst.Parent.Name) then
                local cf = fromSpawns(inst)
                if cf then return cf end
            elseif isLobbyName(n) and (inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("Folder")) then
                local cf = fromInst(inst)
                if cf then return cf end
            end
        end
            for i = 1, #descendants do
            local inst = descendants[i]
                if inst:IsA("SpawnLocation") and not (map and inst:IsDescendantOf(map)) then
                return inst.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
            end
        end
            for i = 1, #descendants do
            local inst = descendants[i]
                if (inst.Name == "Spawns" or inst.Name == "Spawn") and not (map and inst:IsDescendantOf(map)) then
                local cf = fromSpawns(inst)
                if cf then return cf end
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
    local function tpToPlayer(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then notify("Некого телепортировать", 2); return end
    local char = player.Character
    local hrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
    if not hrp then notify(player.Name .. " без персонажа", 2); return end
        if tpToCF(hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 3.5)) then
        notify("TP → " .. player.Name, 2)
    end
end

        if __R1.roleCache[player.UserId] == "murderer" and validTarget(player) then return player end
    end
end
    local function currentSheriff()
    if validTarget(__R1.sheriff) then return __R1.sheriff end
    if validTarget(__R1.hero) then return __R1.hero end
    local byGun = findByGun()

        for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
        local role = __R1.roleCache[player.UserId]
        if (role == "sheriff" or role == "hero") and validTarget(player) then return player end
    end
end

        TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = state and C.accent or C.off }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

        BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 162)
        }):Play()
        callback(state)
        if not restoring then NoirPersistence.SetValue("toggles", key, state) end
    end
    local last = 0
        local function fire()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - last < .18 then return end
        last = now
        apply(not state)
    end
    pill.Activated:Connect(fire)
        if savedState == nil and startOn == true then
        apply(true)
    elseif state then
        apply(true, true)
    end
    return apply
end

b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 24, 30) }):Play() end)
b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(7, 18, 23) }):Play() end)
b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 40, 50) }):Play() end)
end
local last = 0
    local function fire2()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - last < .2 then return end
    last = now
    fn()
end
b.Activated:Connect(fire2)
return b
end
    local function farmSlider(parent, label, min, max, default, callback, storageKey)
    local key = "autofarm::" .. (storageKey or label)
    local savedValue = tonumber(NoirPersistence.GetValue("sliders", key, nil))
    if savedValue then default = math.clamp(savedValue, min, max) end
    local r = New("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    text(r, label, 16, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0))
    local box = New("TextBox", { Parent = r, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 30),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.surface, BackgroundTransparency = .12, Text = tostring(default), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 14, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ClearTextOnFocus = false })
    corner(box, 9); stroke(box, C.border, .4)
    local track = New("Frame", { Parent = r, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 42), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 6), BackgroundColor3 = C.off, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    corner(track, 3)
    local fill = New("Frame", { Parent = track, Size = UDim2.fromScale((default - min) / (max - min), 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    corner(fill, 3)
    local knob = New("Frame", { Parent = track, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, .5, 0),
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), BackgroundColor3 = C.text, BorderSizePixel = 0 })
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15); corner(knob, 8); stroke(knob, C.border, .3)
    local current = default
        local function set(v)
        current = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or current or default) + .5), min, max)
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale((current - min) / (max - min), 1)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new((current - min) / (max - min), 0, .5, 0)
        box.Text = tostring(current)
        callback(current)
        NoirPersistence.SetValue("sliders", key, current)
    end
    set(default)
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function() set(box.Text) end)
    local drag = false
        track.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            drag = true
            set(min + (max - min) * math.clamp((i.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1))
        end
    end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            set(min + (max - min) * math.clamp((i.Position.X - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1))
        end
    end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then drag = false end
    end)
    return r
end

    local function farm_hrp()
    local c = __R1.lp.Character

-- ===== knife kills for autofarm (SNPWARE style: equip the knife themselves) =====
    local function farm_knife_tool()
        local function find(parent)
        if not parent then return nil end
        local named = parent:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        if named and named:IsA("Tool") then return named end
            for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") and (child:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed", true) or child:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched", true)) then
                return child
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local character = __R1.lp.Character
    local equipped = find(character)
    if equipped then return equipped end
    local backpack = __R1.lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    local source = find(backpack)
    if not source and backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Toys") then source = find(backpack.Toys) end
        if source then
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(source) end) end
        return find(character) or source
    end
    return nil
end
    local function farm_stab(knife, hrp)
    if not knife or not hrp then return false end
    local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
    local stabbed = (events and events:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed")) or knife:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed", true)
    local touched = (events and events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")) or knife:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched", true)
    local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
        if handle and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
        pcall(firetouchinterest, hrp, handle, 0)
        pcall(firetouchinterest, hrp, handle, 1)
    end
    if touched and touched:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pcall(touched.FireServer, touched, hrp) end
    if stabbed and stabbed:IsA("RemoteEvent") then pcall(stabbed.FireServer, stabbed) end
    return true
end
    local function farm_kill_everyone()
    local knife = farm_knife_tool()
    if not knife then return 0 end
    local count = 0
        for _, plr in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= __R1.lp then
            local character = plr.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                farm_stab(knife, hrp)
                count += 1
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end
    local function farm_kill_sheriff()
    local knife = farm_knife_tool()
    if not knife then return false end
        for _, plr in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= __R1.lp then
            local character = plr.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local backpack = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
            local gun = (character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")) or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun"))
                if hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and gun then
                farm_stab(knife, hrp)
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
    local function farm_equip_gun()
    local character = __R1.lp.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil end
    local gun = character and character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    if gun then return gun end
    local backpack = __R1.lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    gun = backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    if gun then pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(gun) end) end
    return gun
end
    local function farm_tp_after()
    local keyword
    if __R1.tpAfterFarm_mode == "Map" then keyword = "spawn" end
    if __R1.tpAfterFarm_mode == "Lobby" then keyword = "lobby" end
    if __R1.tpAfterFarm_mode == "Secret" then keyword = "secret" end
    if not keyword then return false end
    local hrp = farm_hrp()
    if not hrp then return false end
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if (obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Model")) and string.find(string.lower(obj.Name), keyword, 1, true) then
            local part = obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then
                pcall(function() hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) end)
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
    local function get_round_data()
        if not __R1.round_mod then
            local ok, m = pcall(function()
            return require(__R1.rs:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("CurrentRoundClient"))
        end)
        if ok and type(m) == "table" then __R1.round_mod = m end
    end
    return __R1.round_mod and __R1.round_mod.PlayerData
end
    local function can_farm()
    local char = __R1.lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local d = get_round_data()
        if type(d) == "table" then
        local me = d[__R1.lp.Name]
        if not me or not me.Role or me.Dead then return false end
    end
    return true
end
    local function coin_bags_full()
    local pg = __R1.lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
    local main = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    local gg = main and main:FindFirstChild("Game")
    local bags = gg and gg:FindFirstChild("CoinBags")
    local container = bags and bags:FindFirstChild("Container")
    if not container then return false end
    local any = false
        for _, v in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Frame") and v.Visible then
            any = true
            local full = v:FindFirstChild("Full")
                if not (full and full.Visible) then
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    return any
end
    local function update_hold()
    getgenv().AUTOFARM_HOLD = __R1.autofarm_on and __R1.autokill_on and not __R1.coins_done
end
    local function reset_farm_progress()
    __R1.collected_ids = {}
    __R1.collected_count = 0
    __R1.coins_done = false
    __R1.saw_coins = false
    __R1.farm_target = nil
    update_hold()
end
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, remote = pcall(function()
        return __R1.rs:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Gameplay"):WaitForChild("CoinsStarted", 15)
    end)
        if ok and remote then
        remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(reset_farm_progress)
    end
end)
    __R1.lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    reset_farm_progress()
end)
    local function coin_available(v)
    return v and v.Parent and v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:GetAttribute("Collected") and not v:GetAttribute("Delete")
end
    local function nearest_coin(pos, list)
    local best, bd = nil, math.huge
        for _, v in ipairs(list) do
        local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
        if d < bd then bd = d best = v end
    end
    return best
end
    local function set_farm_noclip(on)
    local char = __R1.lp.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if on then
        if not char then return end
        if hum then pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end) end
            for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then
                if __R1.nc_cache[p] == nil then __R1.nc_cache[p] = p.CanCollide end
                p.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    else
        if hum then pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end) end
            for p, v in pairs(__R1.nc_cache) do
            if p and p.Parent then pcall(function() p.CanCollide = v end) end
        end
        __R1.nc_cache = {}
    end
end
__R1.up_params = RaycastParams.new()
__R1.up_params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
__R1.up_params.IgnoreWater = true
    local function return_to_surface()
    local hrp = farm_hrp()
    if not hrp then return end
    local origin = hrp.Position
    __R1.up_params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { __R1.lp.Character }
    local res = workspace:Raycast(origin, Vector3.new(0, 400, 0), __R1.up_params)
    local y = res and (res.Position.Y + 5) or (__R1.down_ref_y and __R1.down_ref_y + 5 or nil)
    if not y then return end
        pcall(function()
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin.X, y, origin.Z)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end
    local function farm_release()
        if __R1.was_down then
        __R1.was_down = false
        return_to_surface()
    end
    set_farm_noclip(false)
end
__R1.murder_hrp_cache, __R1.murder_hrp_t = nil, 0
    local function murderer_hrp()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - __R1.murder_hrp_t < 0.25 then return __R1.murder_hrp_cache end
    __R1.murder_hrp_t = now
    __R1.murder_hrp_cache = nil
    local d = get_round_data()
        if type(d) == "table" then
        local me = d[__R1.lp.Name]
        if me and me.Role == "Murderer" then return nil end
            for name, info in pairs(d) do
                if type(info) == "table" and info.Role == "Murderer" and not info.Dead and name ~= __R1.lp.Name then
                local pl = players:FindFirstChild(name)
                local char = pl and pl.Character
                local h = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h and (not hum or hum.Health > 0) then __R1.murder_hrp_cache = h end
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return __R1.murder_hrp_cache
end
    local function flat_dist(a, b)
    return Vector3.new(a.X - b.X, 0, a.Z - b.Z).Magnitude
end
    local function pick_coin(pos, list, mpos)
        if not (__R1.avoid_murder and mpos) then
        return nearest_coin(pos, list)
    end
    local safe, sd = nil, math.huge
    local far, fd = nil, -1
        for _, v in ipairs(list) do
        local md = flat_dist(v.Position, mpos)
        if md > fd then fd = md far = v end
            if md >= __R1.AVOID_DIST then
            local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
            if d < sd then sd = d safe = v end
        end
    end
    if safe then return safe end
    if far and fd >= __R1.AVOID_DIST * 0.6 then return far end
    return nil
end
    local function coin_ok_now(v, mpos)
    if not coin_available(v) then return false end
    if __R1.avoid_murder and mpos and flat_dist(v.Position, mpos) < __R1.AVOID_DIST * 0.6 then return false end
    return true
end
    local function avoid_steer(cur, dest, mpos)
    if not (__R1.avoid_murder and mpos) then return dest end
    local dm = flat_dist(cur, mpos)
    if dm >= __R1.AVOID_DIST then return dest end
    local away = Vector3.new(cur.X - mpos.X, 0, cur.Z - mpos.Z)
    if away.Magnitude < 0.1 then away = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
    away = away.Unit
    local want = Vector3.new(dest.X - cur.X, 0, dest.Z - cur.Z)
    local mag = want.Magnitude
    if mag < 0.1 then return dest end
    local weight = 1 + (1 - dm / __R1.AVOID_DIST) * 2
    local blend = (want.Unit + away * weight)
    if blend.Magnitude < 0.1 then blend = away else blend = blend.Unit end
    local np = cur + blend * mag
    return Vector3.new(np.X, dest.Y, np.Z)
end
    local function touch_targets(coin)
    local list = {}
    local seen = {}
        local function add(p)
            if p and not seen[p] and p:IsA("BasePart") and p:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") then
            seen[p] = true
            list[#list + 1] = p
        end
    end
    add(coin)
    for _, v in ipairs(coin:GetChildren()) do add(v) end
    local par = coin.Parent
        if par then
        if par:IsA("BasePart") then add(par) end
        for _, v in ipairs(par:GetChildren()) do add(v) end
    end
    if #list == 0 then list[1] = coin end
    return list
end
    local function fire_touch(coin, force)
    if type(firetouchinterest) ~= "function" then return end
    if not coin or not coin.Parent then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if not force and now - __R1.last_touch < 0.05 then return end
    __R1.last_touch = now
    local hrp = farm_hrp()
    if not hrp then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(touch_targets(coin)) do
        pcall(firetouchinterest, hrp, p, 0)
        pcall(firetouchinterest, hrp, p, 1)
    end
end
    local function farm_move(hrp, dest, dt)
    local dir = dest - hrp.Position
    local dist = dir.Magnitude
    local np = dest
        if dist > 0.1 then
        np = hrp.Position + dir.Unit * math.min(__R1.FARM_SPEED * dt, dist)
    end
    local cf = CFrame.new(np)
        if __R1.farm_mode == "Down" then
        cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(-math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0)
        __R1.was_down = true
    end
        pcall(function()
        hrp.CFrame = cf
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end
    __R1.farm_conn = run.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
    if not __R1.autofarm_on then return end
    if __R1.shootfull_busy then return end
        if not can_farm() then
        __R1.farm_target = nil
        __R1.was_down = false
        set_farm_noclip(false)
        return
    end
    local hrp = farm_hrp()
    if not hrp then return end
    local list = {}
        for _, v in ipairs(__R1.cs:GetTagged("CoinVisual")) do
            if v and v.Parent and v:IsA("BasePart") then
                if v:GetAttribute("Collected") then
                local id = v:GetAttribute("CoinID")
                    if id and not __R1.collected_ids[id] then
                    __R1.collected_ids[id] = true
                    __R1.collected_count = __R1.collected_count + 1
                end
            elseif not v:GetAttribute("Delete") then
                list[#list + 1] = v
            end
        end
    end
        local function finish()
        __R1.farm_target = nil
        farm_release()
            if not __R1.coins_done then
            __R1.coins_done = true
            update_hold()
                if __R1.tpAfterFarm_mode ~= "None" then
                    task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(0.4)
                    pcall(farm_tp_after)
                end)
            end
                if __R1.autoreset_on then
                local hum = __R1.lp.Character and __R1.lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then pcall(function() hum.Health = 0 end) end
            end
        end
    end
        if __R1.saw_coins and coin_bags_full() then
        finish()
        return
    end
        if #list > 0 then
        __R1.saw_coins = true
        if __R1.coins_done then __R1.coins_done = false update_hold() end
        local mhrp = __R1.avoid_murder and murderer_hrp() or nil
        local mpos = mhrp and mhrp.Position or nil
            if not coin_ok_now(__R1.farm_target, mpos) then
            __R1.farm_target = pick_coin(hrp.Position, list, mpos)
        end
            if __R1.farm_target then
            set_farm_noclip(true)
            local cpos = __R1.farm_target.Position
            __R1.down_ref_y = cpos.Y
            local dest = cpos
                if __R1.farm_mode == "Down" then
                local xz = flat_dist(hrp.Position, cpos)
                local safe_to_rise = (not mpos) or flat_dist(hrp.Position, mpos) > __R1.RISE_SAFE_DIST
                    if xz <= __R1.DOWN_RISE_XZ and safe_to_rise then
                    dest = cpos
                    fire_touch(__R1.farm_target)
                else
                    dest = Vector3.new(cpos.X, cpos.Y - __R1.DOWN_DEPTH, cpos.Z)
                end
            elseif (cpos - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 6 then
                fire_touch(__R1.farm_target)
            end
            dest = avoid_steer(hrp.Position, dest, mpos)
            farm_move(hrp, dest, dt)
        elseif mpos then
            set_farm_noclip(true)
            local away = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X - mpos.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z - mpos.Z)
            if away.Magnitude < 0.1 then away = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
            away = away.Unit
            local y = hrp.Position.Y
            if __R1.farm_mode == "Down" and __R1.down_ref_y then y = __R1.down_ref_y - __R1.DOWN_DEPTH end
            farm_move(hrp, hrp.Position + away * 40 + Vector3.new(0, y - hrp.Position.Y, 0), dt)
        end
    else
        __R1.farm_target = nil
        farm_release()
            if __R1.saw_coins and not __R1.coins_done and __R1.collected_count > 0 then
            finish()
        end
    end
end)
-- ---------- Coin Aura (autofarm page) ----------
-- Built from this file's own coin primitives: CoinVisual tag -> coin_available ->
-- touch_targets -> firetouchinterest. Same touch path as the farm walk, but
-- nothing moves: every coin inside the radius is touched every Aura Interval.
    __R1.aura_conn = run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not __R1.aura_on then return end
    local hrp = farm_hrp()
    if not hrp then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - __R1.aura_last < __R1.AURA_INTERVAL then return end
    __R1.aura_last = now
    if __R1.saw_coins and coin_bags_full() then return end
    local origin = hrp.Position
    local mpos = nil
        if __R1.avoid_murder then
        local mhrp = murderer_hrp()
        mpos = mhrp and mhrp.Position or nil
    end
    local radius = __R1.AURA_RADIUS
    local radius2 = radius * radius
    local touched = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(__R1.cs:GetTagged("CoinVisual")) do
            if v and v.Parent and v:IsA("BasePart") and not v:GetAttribute("Collected") and not v:GetAttribute("Delete") then
            local d = v.Position - origin
                if d.X * d.X + d.Z * d.Z <= radius2 and math.abs(d.Y) <= radius * 1.5 then
                    if coin_ok_now(v, mpos) then
                    fire_touch(v, true)
                    touched = touched + 1
                    if touched >= 40 then break end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)
-- auto kill executor: the paste's kill modules honor getgenv().AUTOFARM_HOLD
-- (paused while coins remain, released when bags are full). This mirrors that:
-- when the hold drops and coins are done, clear the round as the Murderer.
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
        task.wait(0.25)
        if not (__R1.autofarm_on and (__R1.autokill_on or __R1.autokillsheriff_on)) then continue end
        if getgenv().AUTOFARM_HOLD then continue end
        if not __R1.coins_done then continue end
        local my_root = farm_hrp()
        if not my_root then continue end
        local knife = __R1.autokill_on and farm_knife_tool() or nil
            if __R1.autokill_on and knife then
            -- kill everyone in the full bag: knife out, stab every player (no teleport)
                for _, plr in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr ~= __R1.lp then
                    local tc = plr.Character
                    local hum = tc and tc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local part = tc and (tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tc:FindFirstChild("Head"))
                        if hum and hum.Health > 0 and part then
                        farm_stab(knife, part)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
            if __R1.autokillsheriff_on then
            -- reuse the Knife Silent Aim killer (it equips the knife and stabs the sheriff)
                pcall(function()
                local runtime = NoirGenv().__NoirKnifeUtilityRuntime
                    if type(runtime) == "table" and type(runtime.KillSheriff) == "function" then
                    runtime:KillSheriff()
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)
-- Autofarm: shoot murder on full bag + auto fling sheriff when innocent for gun
-- Expose flags for external access
pcall(function() NoirGenv().__ShootFull = __R1.shootFull_on; NoirGenv().__FlingSheriffFull = __R1.flingSheriffFull_on end)
-- Fling helper for autofarm — uses proper Noir fling from Part2 (no stretch)
    local function autofarmFlingTarget(targetPlr)
    if not targetPlr or not targetPlr.Parent then return false end
    local ok = false
        pcall(function()
            if NoirGenv().__NoirFling and typeof(NoirGenv().__NoirFling)=="function" then
            local res = NoirGenv().__NoirFling(targetPlr)
            ok = res ~= false
        elseif getgenv().__NoirFling and typeof(getgenv().__NoirFling)=="function" then
            local res = getgenv().__NoirFling(targetPlr)
            ok = res ~= false
        end
    end)
    return ok
end
-- ===== Shoot Murder on full bag: прилипаем за спиной (как bang), один возврат =====
-- Держимся в системе координат маньяка на SF_DIST студов сзади и чуть выше —
-- едем вместе с ним, пока он жив, и стреляем. CFrame пишем только когда реально
-- съехали (стоит — ни одной записи). Возврат один: убийца умер / потеряли его /
-- сняли тоггл. Никаких "туда-сюда" циклами.
__R1.sf_state = "idle" -- idle | hold
__R1.sf_target, __R1.sf_originCF = nil, nil
__R1.sf_seenSince, __R1.sf_cooldownUntil = 0, 0
__R1.sf_lastSeen, __R1.sf_lastShot, __R1.sf_lastEquip, __R1.sf_lastResolve = 0, 0, 0, 0
__R1.sf_prevAutoRotate = nil
__R1.sf_tick = 0
    local function sf_release()
    __R1.shootfull_busy = false
    local hum = __R1.lp.Character and __R1.lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and __R1.sf_prevAutoRotate ~= nil then pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = __R1.sf_prevAutoRotate end) end
    __R1.sf_prevAutoRotate = nil
    pcall(function() set_farm_noclip(false) end)
    __R1.sf_target = nil
    __R1.sf_seenSince = 0
    __R1.sf_state = "idle"
end
    local function sf_home(my_root)
    if not (__R1.sf_originCF and my_root and my_root.Parent) then return end
    local restore = __R1.sf_originCF
        pcall(function()
        local rotation = restore - restore.Position
        local landing = restore
        local down = RaycastParams.new()
        down.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        down.FilterDescendantsInstances = { __R1.lp.Character }
        down.IgnoreWater = true
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(restore.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), down)
        if hit then landing = CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)) * rotation end
        my_root.CFrame = landing
        my_root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        my_root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end
    run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - __R1.sf_tick < 0.03 then return end
    __R1.sf_tick = now
    local my_root = farm_hrp()
    local my_hum = __R1.lp.Character and __R1.lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (my_root and my_hum and my_hum.Health > 0) then
        if __R1.sf_state ~= "idle" then __R1.sf_originCF = nil; sf_release() end
        return
    end
    local hasGun = my_root.Parent:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
        if not hasGun then
        local bp = __R1.lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        hasGun = bp ~= nil and bp:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil
    end
        if __R1.sf_state ~= "idle" and not (__R1.shootFull_on and __R1.autofarm_on and hasGun) then
        sf_home(my_root)
        __R1.sf_originCF = nil
        sf_release()
        __R1.sf_cooldownUntil = now + 1.5
        return
    end
    -- цель: одна и та же, пока жива
    local target_root = __R1.sf_target and __R1.sf_target.Character and __R1.sf_target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local target_hum = __R1.sf_target and __R1.sf_target.Character and __R1.sf_target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (__R1.sf_target and target_root and target_hum and target_hum.Health > 0) then
        target_root, target_hum = nil, nil
            if now - __R1.sf_lastResolve > 0.4 then
            __R1.sf_lastResolve = now
            local found = __R1.murderer
                if not (found and validTarget(found)) then
                local okFind, byKnife = pcall(function() return findByKnife and findByKnife() or nil end)
                if okFind and byKnife and validTarget(byKnife) then found = byKnife end
            end
                if found and validTarget(found) then
                if found ~= __R1.sf_target then __R1.sf_seenSince = now end
                __R1.sf_target = found
                target_root = found.Character and found.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                target_hum = found.Character and found.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            end
        end
    end
        if target_root and target_hum and target_hum.Health > 0 then
        __R1.sf_lastSeen = now
            if __R1.sf_state == "idle" then
                if __R1.shootFull_on and __R1.autofarm_on and hasGun and __R1.coins_done
                and now >= __R1.sf_cooldownUntil and __R1.sf_seenSince > 0 and now - __R1.sf_seenSince >= 0.35 then
                __R1.sf_state = "hold"
                __R1.sf_originCF = my_root.CFrame
                __R1.sf_lastShot, __R1.sf_lastEquip = 0, 0
                __R1.shootfull_busy = true
                __R1.sf_prevAutoRotate = my_hum.AutoRotate
                pcall(function() my_hum.AutoRotate = false end)
                pcall(function() set_farm_noclip(true) end)
            end
        end
            if __R1.sf_state == "hold" then
            -- держимся за спиной на дистанции: пишем CFrame только при сносе,
            -- скорость берём у цели, чтобы физика не тянула вниз
            local desired = target_root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, __R1.SF_DIST)
                if (desired.Position - my_root.Position).Magnitude > 0.12 then
                pcall(function() my_root.CFrame = desired end)
            end
                pcall(function()
                my_root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = target_root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                my_root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
                if now - __R1.sf_lastEquip > 0.8 then
                __R1.sf_lastEquip = now
                pcall(farm_equip_gun)
            end
                if now - __R1.sf_lastShot > 0.12 then
                __R1.sf_lastShot = now
                pcall(function() if fireGunAt then fireGunAt(__R1.sf_target, true) end end)
            end
        end
    elseif __R1.sf_state == "hold" and now - __R1.sf_lastSeen > 0.5 then
        -- убийца умер или пропал: один возврат назад и сброс
        sf_home(my_root)
        __R1.sf_originCF = nil
        sf_release()
        __R1.sf_cooldownUntil = now + 3.0
    end
end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
        task.wait(0.9)
        if not (__R1.flingSheriffFull_on and __R1.autofarm_on and __R1.coins_done) then continue end
        if getgenv().AUTOFARM_HOLD then continue end
        local d = get_round_data and get_round_data() or nil
        local me = type(d)=="table" and d[__R1.lp.Name] or nil
        local isInnocent = false
            if me and me.Role then
            local r = string.lower(tostring(me.Role))
            isInnocent = r:find("innocent")~=nil and not r:find("murder") and not r:find("sheriff") and not r:find("hero")
        else
            -- fallback via roleCache
            pcall(function() isInnocent = (__R1.roleCache[__R1.lp.UserId]=="innocent") end)
        end
        if not isInnocent then continue end
        -- we are innocent, find sheriff with gun
        local sh = __R1.sheriff or findByGun and findByGun() or nil
            if not sh then
                pcall(function()
                    if __R1.roleCache then
                        for uid, role in pairs(__R1.roleCache) do
                            if role=="sheriff" then
                            local pl = players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(uid) or 0) or players:FindFirstChild(tostring(uid))
                            if pl then sh=pl end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if not sh or sh==__R1.lp then continue end
        local tChar = sh.Character
        local hasGun = false
        pcall(function() hasGun = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil end)
            if not hasGun then
            pcall(function() hasGun = sh:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and sh.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil end)
        end
        if not hasGun then continue end
        local myGun = false
        pcall(function() myGun = __R1.lp.Character and __R1.lp.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil end)
        if myGun then continue end -- already have gun
        -- fling sheriff
        pcall(function() autofarmFlingTarget(sh) end)
        task.wait(3.5)
    end
end)
-- ===== Fling Murder on full bag =====
-- Тот же fling, что у шерифа (autofarmFlingTarget -> Noir __NoirFling), но по
-- убийце и с одним срабатыванием: включается, когда монеты собраны (полный
-- мешок) или когда свой персонаж умер. Повтор на ту же цель не чаще 6 с.
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
        task.wait(0.35)
            if not (__R1.flingMurderFull_on and __R1.autofarm_on) then
            __R1.flingMurderTargetId = nil
            continue
        end
        local my_hum = __R1.lp.Character and __R1.lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local dead = (my_hum == nil) or my_hum.Health <= 0
        if not (__R1.coins_done or dead) then continue end
        local target = __R1.murderer
            if not (target and validTarget(target)) then
            local okFind, byKnife = pcall(function() return findByKnife and findByKnife() or nil end)
            if okFind and byKnife and validTarget(byKnife) then target = byKnife end
        end
        if not (target and target ~= __R1.lp and validTarget(target)) then continue end
        if __R1.flingMurderTargetId == target.UserId and (os.clock() - __R1.flingMurderLast) < 6 then continue end
        __R1.flingMurderLast = os.clock()
        __R1.flingMurderTargetId = target.UserId
        pcall(function() autofarmFlingTarget(target) end)
    end
end)
-- ---------- UI (paste names) ----------

    if holder then

    end, false)

        farmSlider(holder, "Murder TP Distance", 5, 40, __R1.SF_DIST, function(v)
        __R1.SF_DIST = v
