        local function fadeHide(frame)
        if not frame or not frame.Parent or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
            if fadeCache[frame] == nil then
            local backgroundTransparency
            pcall(function() backgroundTransparency = frame.BackgroundTransparency end)
            fadeCache[frame] = { visible = frame.Visible, backgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency }
        end
        if frame.Visible then pcall(function() frame.Visible = false end) end
            if not fadeConnections[frame] then
                fadeConnections[frame] = frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                    if fpsProtection.fade and frame.Parent and frame.Visible then
                    pcall(function() frame.Visible = false end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
        local function fadeMatches(instance)
        if not instance or not instance:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
        local parent = instance.Parent
        if not parent then return false end
            if (instance.Name == "Fade" or instance.Name == "Frame") and parent:IsA("ScreenGui") and FADE_GUI_NAMES[parent.Name] then
            return true
        end
        return instance.Name == "Fade" and parent.Name == "Game"
    end
        local function fadeTargets()
        local list = {}
        local gui = getPlayerGui()
        if not gui then return list end
            for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and FADE_GUI_NAMES[child.Name] then
                    for _, sub in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                        if sub:IsA("GuiObject") and (sub.Name == "Fade" or sub.Name == "Frame") then
                        list[#list + 1] = sub
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local main = gui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        local gameFrame = main and main:FindFirstChild("Game")
        local fadeFrame = gameFrame and gameFrame:FindFirstChild("Fade")
        if fadeFrame and fadeFrame:IsA("GuiObject") then list[#list + 1] = fadeFrame end
        return list
    end
        local function fadeWatch()
        local gui = getPlayerGui()
        if not gui then return end
        if fadeDescendantConnection and fadeWatchedGui == gui then return end
        if fadeDescendantConnection then pcall(function() fadeDescendantConnection:Disconnect() end) end
        fadeWatchedGui = gui
            fadeDescendantConnection = gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
            if not fpsProtection.fade or not fadeMatches(instance) then return end
                task.defer(function()
                if fpsProtection.fade and instance.Parent then pcall(fadeHide, instance) end
            end)
        end)
    end
        local function applyFade()
        fadeWatch()
        for _, frame in ipairs(fadeTargets()) do pcall(fadeHide, frame) end
    end
        local function restoreFade()
        for _, connection in pairs(fadeConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(fadeConnections)
            for frame, original in pairs(fadeCache) do
                if frame and frame.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                    if original.backgroundTransparency ~= nil then frame.BackgroundTransparency = original.backgroundTransparency end
                    frame.Visible = original.visible
                end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(fadeCache)
    end
        local function setFade(enabled)
        fpsProtection.fade = enabled == true
        if fpsProtection.fade then applyFade() else restoreFade() end
    end
        local function setAntiAfk(enabled)
        fpsProtection.antiAfk = enabled == true
    end
        local idleConnection = LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
        if not fpsProtection.antiAfk then return end
            pcall(function()
            virtualUser:CaptureController()
            virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
        end)
    end)
        local function setAntiVoid(enabled)
        fpsProtection.antiVoid = enabled == true
            pcall(function()
            Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = fpsProtection.antiVoid and -9e9 or originalVoidHeight
        end)
    end
    local TRAP_LOCK, TRAP_HOLD = 1, 5
    local trapWindow, trapBusy = 0, false
    local trapSpeedCache, trapJumpCache = 16, 50
    local trapHitConnection, trapWaitConnection = nil, nil
        local function trapHumanoid()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
        local function removeTrapGui()
        local gui = getPlayerGui()
        if not gui then return end
            for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "TrapGUI" then pcall(function() child:Destroy() end) end
        end
    end
        local function trapUnlock(humanoid)
        if not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then return end
            pcall(function()
            if humanoid.WalkSpeed <= TRAP_LOCK then humanoid.WalkSpeed = trapSpeedCache end
            if humanoid.JumpPower <= TRAP_LOCK then humanoid.JumpPower = trapJumpCache end
        end)
    end
        local function trapEngage()
        if not fpsProtection.trap then return end
        trapWindow = os.clock() + TRAP_HOLD
        local humanoid = trapHumanoid()
            if humanoid then
                pcall(function()
                if humanoid.WalkSpeed > TRAP_LOCK then trapSpeedCache = humanoid.WalkSpeed end
                if humanoid.JumpPower > TRAP_LOCK then trapJumpCache = humanoid.JumpPower end
            end)
        end
        removeTrapGui()
        if trapBusy then return end
        trapBusy = true
            task.spawn(function()
                while fpsProtection.trap and os.clock() < trapWindow do
                trapUnlock(trapHumanoid())
                removeTrapGui()
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            trapBusy = false
        end)
    end
        local function attachTrapRemote(remote)
        if trapHitConnection or not remote then return end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                trapHitConnection = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                task.spawn(trapEngage)
            end)
        end)
            if ok and trapWaitConnection then
            pcall(function() trapWaitConnection:Disconnect() end)
            trapWaitConnection = nil
        end
    end
        local function attachTrap()
        if trapHitConnection then return end
            local ok, remote = pcall(function()
            local system = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TrapSystem")
            return system and system:FindFirstChild("TrapHitLocal")
        end)
            if ok and remote then
            attachTrapRemote(remote)
        elseif not trapWaitConnection then
                trapWaitConnection = ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
                if fpsProtection.trap and instance.Name == "TrapHitLocal" then attachTrapRemote(instance) end
            end)
        end
    end
        local function detachTrap()
        local shouldUnlock = trapBusy or trapWindow > 0
        if trapHitConnection then pcall(function() trapHitConnection:Disconnect() end); trapHitConnection = nil end
        if trapWaitConnection then pcall(function() trapWaitConnection:Disconnect() end); trapWaitConnection = nil end
        trapWindow = 0
        if shouldUnlock then trapUnlock(trapHumanoid()) end
    end
        local function setTrap(enabled)
        local wasEnabled = fpsProtection.trap
        fpsProtection.trap = enabled == true
        if fpsProtection.trap then attachTrap() elseif wasEnabled then detachTrap() end
    end
    local ANTIFLING_BATCH_SIZE = 256
    local antiFlingParts, antiFlingPartMap = {}, {}
    local antiFlingCharacters, antiFlingPlayerConnections = {}, {}
    local antiFlingGlobalConnections = {}
    local antiFlingStepConnection, antiFlingCursor, antiFlingAttached = nil, 1, false
        local function disconnectAntiFlingConnections(connections)
            for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        end
        table.clear(connections)
    end
        local function untrackAntiFlingPart(part, restore)
        local entry = antiFlingPartMap[part]
        if not entry then return end
        antiFlingPartMap[part] = nil
        entry.active = false
            if entry.changedConnection then
            pcall(function() entry.changedConnection:Disconnect() end)
            entry.changedConnection = nil
        end
        if entry.character and entry.character.parts then entry.character.parts[part] = nil end
            if restore then
                pcall(function()
                if part.CanCollide ~= entry.originalCanCollide then part.CanCollide = entry.originalCanCollide end
            end)
        end
    end
        local function trackAntiFlingPart(part, characterRecord)
        if not fpsProtection.antiFling or not part or antiFlingPartMap[part] then return end
            local ok, canCollide = pcall(function()
            if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
            return part.CanCollide
        end)
        if not ok or canCollide == nil then return end
        local entry = {
        part = part,
        character = characterRecord,
        originalCanCollide = canCollide,
        active = true,
        }
        antiFlingPartMap[part] = entry
        antiFlingParts[#antiFlingParts + 1] = entry
        if characterRecord then characterRecord.parts[part] = true end
            local okConnection, connection = pcall(function()
                return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
                if not entry.active or not fpsProtection.antiFling or not part.Parent then return end
                    pcall(function()
                    if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
                end)
            end)
        end)
        if okConnection then entry.changedConnection = connection end
        if canCollide then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end) end
    end
        local function stopAntiFlingCharacter(player, expectedCharacter, restore)
        local record = antiFlingCharacters[player]
        if not record or (expectedCharacter and record.character ~= expectedCharacter) then return end
        antiFlingCharacters[player] = nil
        disconnectAntiFlingConnections(record.connections)
        local parts = {}
        for part in pairs(record.parts) do parts[#parts + 1] = part end
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do untrackAntiFlingPart(part, restore) end
        table.clear(record.parts)
    end
        local function watchAntiFlingCharacter(player, character)
        if not fpsProtection.antiFling or player == LocalPlayer or not character then return end
        local previous = antiFlingCharacters[player]
        if previous and previous.character == character then return end
        if previous then stopAntiFlingCharacter(player, nil, true) end
        local record = { player = player, character = character, parts = {}, connections = {} }
        antiFlingCharacters[player] = record
        local okDescendants, descendants = pcall(function() return character:GetDescendants() end)
            if okDescendants then
            for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do trackAntiFlingPart(descendant, record) end
        end
            local okAdded, addedConnection = pcall(function()
                return character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
                    if fpsProtection.antiFling and antiFlingCharacters[player] == record then
                    trackAntiFlingPart(instance, record)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if okAdded then record.connections[#record.connections + 1] = addedConnection end
            local okRemoving, removingConnection = pcall(function()
                return character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
                if antiFlingPartMap[instance] then untrackAntiFlingPart(instance, true) end
            end)
        end)
        if okRemoving then record.connections[#record.connections + 1] = removingConnection end
    end
        local function watchAntiFlingPlayer(player)
        if not fpsProtection.antiFling or player == LocalPlayer or antiFlingPlayerConnections[player] then return end
        local connections = {}
        antiFlingPlayerConnections[player] = connections
            local okAdded, addedConnection = pcall(function()
                return player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
                if fpsProtection.antiFling then watchAntiFlingCharacter(player, character) end
            end)
        end)
        if okAdded then connections[#connections + 1] = addedConnection end
            local okRemoving, removingConnection = pcall(function()
                return player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
                stopAntiFlingCharacter(player, character, true)
            end)
        end)
        if okRemoving then connections[#connections + 1] = removingConnection end
        if player.Character then watchAntiFlingCharacter(player, player.Character) end
    end
        local function sweepAntiFlingParts()
        if not fpsProtection.antiFling then return end
        local total = #antiFlingParts
        if total == 0 then antiFlingCursor = 1; return end
        local quota = math.min(ANTIFLING_BATCH_SIZE, total)
        local processed = 0
            while processed < quota and #antiFlingParts > 0 do
            if antiFlingCursor > #antiFlingParts then antiFlingCursor = 1 end
            local entry = antiFlingParts[antiFlingCursor]
            local part = entry and entry.part
                if not entry or not entry.active or antiFlingPartMap[part] ~= entry or not part or not part.Parent then
                if entry and entry.active and part then untrackAntiFlingPart(part, true) end
                antiFlingParts[antiFlingCursor] = antiFlingParts[#antiFlingParts]
                antiFlingParts[#antiFlingParts] = nil
                if antiFlingCursor > #antiFlingParts then antiFlingCursor = 1 end
            else
                    pcall(function()
                    if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
                end)
                antiFlingCursor = antiFlingCursor + 1
            end
            processed = processed + 1
        end
        if antiFlingCursor > #antiFlingParts then antiFlingCursor = 1 end
    end
        local function attachAntiFling()
        if antiFlingAttached then return end
        antiFlingAttached = true
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchAntiFlingPlayer(player) end
        antiFlingGlobalConnections[#antiFlingGlobalConnections + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchAntiFlingPlayer)
            antiFlingGlobalConnections[#antiFlingGlobalConnections + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
            stopAntiFlingCharacter(player, nil, true)
            local connections = antiFlingPlayerConnections[player]
            if connections then disconnectAntiFlingConnections(connections) end
            antiFlingPlayerConnections[player] = nil
        end)
        local simulationSignal
        pcall(function() simulationSignal = RunService.PreSimulation end)
        if not simulationSignal then pcall(function() simulationSignal = RunService.Stepped end) end
            if simulationSignal then
                local ok, connection = pcall(function()
                return simulationSignal:Connect(sweepAntiFlingParts)
            end)
            if ok then antiFlingStepConnection = connection end
        end
    end
        local function stopAntiFling()
        antiFlingAttached = false
            if antiFlingStepConnection then
            pcall(function() antiFlingStepConnection:Disconnect() end)
            antiFlingStepConnection = nil
        end
        disconnectAntiFlingConnections(antiFlingGlobalConnections)
            for player, connections in pairs(antiFlingPlayerConnections) do
            disconnectAntiFlingConnections(connections)
            antiFlingPlayerConnections[player] = nil
        end
        local players = {}
        for player in pairs(antiFlingCharacters) do players[#players + 1] = player end
        for _, player in ipairs(players) do stopAntiFlingCharacter(player, nil, true) end
        local parts = {}
        for part in pairs(antiFlingPartMap) do parts[#parts + 1] = part end
        for _, part in ipairs(parts) do untrackAntiFlingPart(part, true) end
        table.clear(antiFlingPartMap)
        table.clear(antiFlingParts)
        antiFlingCursor = 1
    end
        local function setAntiFling(enabled)
        fpsProtection.antiFling = enabled == true
        if fpsProtection.antiFling then pcall(attachAntiFling) else stopAntiFling() end
    end
        local function cleanupFPSProtections()
        fpsProtection.antiAfk = false
        fpsProtection.antiFling = false
        fpsProtection.antiVoid = false
        fpsProtection.removeCoins = false
        fpsProtection.fade = false
        fpsProtection.trap = false
        stopAntiFling(); detachTrap(); restoreCoins(); restoreFade()
        pcall(function() Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = originalVoidHeight end)
            for _, connection in ipairs({ idleConnection, coinTagConnection, coinDescendantConnection, fadeDescendantConnection }) do
            if connection then pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        end
    end
    local fpsRuntime = NoirGenv().__NoirFPSBoostRuntime
    if type(fpsRuntime) == "table" then fpsRuntime.CleanupProtections = cleanupFPSProtections end
    local fpsProtectionMigrationChanged = false
        local function migrateFPSProtectionToggle(label, oldSection)
        local newKey = "MISC • FPS::" .. label
        local oldKey = oldSection .. "::" .. label
            if NoirPersistence.data.toggles[newKey] == nil and NoirPersistence.data.toggles[oldKey] ~= nil then
            NoirPersistence.data.toggles[newKey] = NoirPersistence.data.toggles[oldKey]
            fpsProtectionMigrationChanged = true
        end
    end
    migrateFPSProtectionToggle("AntiFling", "MAIN • UNIVERSAL")
    migrateFPSProtectionToggle("Anti AFK", "MAIN • SELF MODS")
    if fpsProtectionMigrationChanged then NoirPersistence.Save() end
    local fpsSection = tab:AddSection("MISC • FPS", "Local visual-performance controls; server-side objects and round rules are not changed")
    NoirGenv().__NoirFPSBoostToggle = fpsSection:AddToggle("Fps Boost", setFPSBoost)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Less Lag", function(enabled) state.lessLag = enabled == true; refreshPerformance() end)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("No Shadows", function(enabled) state.noShadows = enabled == true; refreshPerformance() end)
        fpsSection:AddToggle("Optimize Coins", function(enabled)
        state.optimizeCoins = enabled == true
        updateAutoVisualConnections()
        if state.optimizeCoins then scanAutoVisuals() else restoreCoinOptimization() end
    end)
        fpsSection:AddToggle("Auto Remove Chroma Effects", function(enabled)
        state.removeChroma = enabled == true
        updateAutoVisualConnections()
            if state.removeChroma then scanAutoVisuals() else
            for instance, original in pairs(state.chromaOriginals) do if instance and instance.Parent then setProperty(instance, "Enabled", original) end end
            table.clear(state.chromaOriginals)
        end
    end)
        fpsSection:AddToggle("Auto Remove Pets Display", function(enabled)
        state.removePets = enabled == true
        updateAutoVisualConnections()
        if state.removePets then scanAutoVisuals() else restoreHidden(state.hiddenPets) end
    end)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Auto Remove Coins", setRemoveCoins)
        fpsSection:AddToggle("Auto Remove Corpses", function(enabled)
        state.removeCorpses = enabled == true
        updateAutoVisualConnections()
        if state.removeCorpses then hideKnownCorpseParts(); scanAutoVisuals() else restoreHidden(state.hiddenCorpses) end
    end)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Enable Frame Enhancement", function(enabled) state.frameEnhancement = enabled == true; refreshPerformance() end)
    fpsSection:AddLabel("Client-side protections")
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Fade", setFade)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Trap", setTrap)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("AntiFling", setAntiFling)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Anti AFK", setAntiAfk)
    fpsSection:AddToggle("Anti Void", setAntiVoid)
end)
    task.defer(function()
    local oldRuntime = NoirGenv().__NoirMiscAimlockRuntime
    if type(oldRuntime) == "table" and type(oldRuntime.Stop) == "function" then pcall(oldRuntime.Stop) end
    local aimSizeStorageKey = "NoirAimlockBindSizeV2"
    local aimSizeControlKey = "AIM • AIMLOCK::Aimlock Bind Button Size"
    local savedAimBindPercent = tonumber(NoirPersistence.data.sliders[aimSizeStorageKey]) or 8
    savedAimBindPercent = math.clamp(math.floor(savedAimBindPercent + .5), 5, 25)
    NoirPersistence.data.sliders[aimSizeControlKey] = savedAimBindPercent
    local aim = {
    enabled = false, wallCheck = false, fovEnabled = false, fovRadius = 250,
    smoothness = .25, smoothRate = 18, horizontalPrediction = false, prediction = .145,
    targetPart = "Head", selectedPlayer = nil, targetPlayer = nil, lastSearch = 0, searchInterval = .10,
    lastAimPos = nil, lastTarget = nil, cachedPlayer = nil, cachedCharacter = nil,
    cachedRoot = nil, cachedHead = nil, key = "T", bindVisible = false, bindSize = savedAimBindPercent / 100,
    overlay = nil, bindButton = nil, bindOuterGradient = nil, bindInnerGradient = nil, bindPressScale = nil,
    fovCircle = nil, connections = {}, bindConnections = {}, stopped = false,
    }
        local function connect(signal, callback)
        local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
        aim.connections[#aim.connections + 1] = connection
        return connection
    end
        local function validPlayer(player)
        local character = player and player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        return player and player ~= LocalPlayer and character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
    end
        local function clearCache()
        aim.cachedPlayer, aim.cachedCharacter, aim.cachedRoot, aim.cachedHead = nil, nil, nil, nil
        aim.lastAimPos, aim.lastTarget = nil, nil
    end
        local function findMurdererForAimlock()
        if validPlayer(__R1.murderer) then return __R1.murderer end
            for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
            if validPlayer(player) and __R1.roleCache[player.UserId] == "murderer" then return player end
        end
        local closest, closestDistance, ownRoot = nil, math.huge, localRoot()
            for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do
                if validPlayer(player) and playerHasTool(player, "Knife") then
                local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local distance = ownRoot and root and (root.Position - ownRoot.Position).Magnitude or 0
                if distance < closestDistance then closest, closestDistance = player, distance end
            end
        end
        return closest
    end
        local function getAimTarget()
        if validPlayer(aim.selectedPlayer) then return aim.selectedPlayer end
        aim.selectedPlayer = nil
        return validPlayer(aim.targetPlayer) and aim.targetPlayer or nil
    end
        local function resolvePart(player)
        local character = player and player.Character
        if not character then return nil end
            if aim.cachedPlayer ~= player or aim.cachedCharacter ~= character then
            aim.cachedPlayer, aim.cachedCharacter = player, character
            aim.cachedRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            aim.cachedHead = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            aim.lastAimPos, aim.lastTarget = nil, nil
        end
        return aim.targetPart == "HumanoidRootPart" and aim.cachedRoot or aim.cachedHead or aim.cachedRoot
    end
        local function hasLineOfSight(part, player)
        if not aim.wallCheck then return true end
        local camera, character = Workspace.CurrentCamera, player and player.Character
        if not camera or not character then return false end
        local ownCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ownCharacter and { ownCharacter, character } or { character }
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        local visible, checked = 0, 0
            for _, name in ipairs({ "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }) do
            local checkPart = character:FindFirstChild(name)
                if checkPart then
                checked += 1
                if not Workspace:Raycast(camera.CFrame.Position, checkPart.Position - camera.CFrame.Position, params) then visible += 1 end
            end
        end
        return checked == 0 or visible >= (checked >= 3 and 2 or 1)
    end
        local function inFov(worldPosition)
        if not aim.fovEnabled then return true end
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return false end
        local point, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPosition)
        if not onScreen then return false end
        local size = camera.ViewportSize
        return (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - Vector2.new(size.X * .5, size.Y * .5)).Magnitude <= aim.fovRadius
    end
        local function ensureOverlay()
        if aim.overlay and aim.overlay.Parent then return aim.overlay end
            for _, parent in ipairs({ guiParent, CoreGui, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") }) do
                if parent then
                local stale = parent:FindFirstChild("NoirAimlockOverlay")
                if stale then stale:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        local parent = guiParent
        if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
        if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
        aim.overlay = New("ScreenGui", { Name = "NoirAimlockOverlay", Parent = parent, ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 84, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling })
        return aim.overlay
    end
        local function updateFovCircle()
            if not aim.fovEnabled then
            if aim.fovCircle then aim.fovCircle.Visible = false end
            return
        end
        local overlay = ensureOverlay()
        if not overlay then return end
            if not aim.fovCircle or not aim.fovCircle.Parent then
            local circle = New("Frame", { Name = "FOV", Parent = overlay, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1 })
            local rounded = New("UICorner", { Parent = circle, CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) })
            local outline = New("UIStroke", { Parent = circle, Color = C.accent, Thickness = 1.4, Transparency = .18 })
            aim.fovCircle = circle
        end
        aim.fovCircle.Visible = true
        aim.fovCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(aim.fovRadius * 2, aim.fovRadius * 2)
    end
    local aimMetallicGradient = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(16, 60, 66)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22, Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 196)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.48, Color3.fromRGB(20, 90, 98)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.72, Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 228)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(10, 44, 50)),
    })
    local aimActiveGradient = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(6, 78, 84)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.24, Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 250)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5, Color3.fromRGB(38, 240, 228)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.76, Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 252)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 52, 58)),
    })
        local function bindButtonPixels()
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        local shortEdge = viewport and math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) or 720
        return math.clamp(math.floor(shortEdge * aim.bindSize * .5 + .5), 24, 96)
    end
        local function updateBindSize()
        local button = aim.bindButton
        if not button then return end
        local pixels = bindButtonPixels()
        button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pixels, pixels)
    end
        local function updateBindVisual()
        local button = aim.bindButton
        if not button then return end
        local label = button:FindFirstChild("Text")
        if label then label.Text = "Aimlock" end
        if aim.bindOuterGradient then aim.bindOuterGradient.Color = aim.enabled and aimActiveGradient or aimMetallicGradient end
        if aim.bindInnerGradient then aim.bindInnerGradient.Color = aim.enabled and aimActiveGradient or aimMetallicGradient end
    end
        local function setAimlock(enabled)
        aim.enabled = enabled == true
            if aim.enabled then
            aim.targetPlayer = findMurdererForAimlock()
        else
            aim.targetPlayer = nil
            clearCache()
        end
        updateBindVisual()
    end
        local function disconnectBindButton()
        for _, connection in ipairs(aim.bindConnections or {}) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        aim.bindConnections = {}
    end
        local function removeBindButton()
        disconnectBindButton()
        if aim.bindButton and aim.bindButton.Parent then aim.bindButton:Destroy() end
        aim.bindButton, aim.bindOuterGradient, aim.bindInnerGradient, aim.bindPressScale = nil, nil, nil, nil
            if aim.overlay then
            local stale = aim.overlay:FindFirstChild("AimlockButton")
            if stale then stale:Destroy() end
        end
    end
        local function createBindButton()
        if aim.bindButton then return end
        local overlay = ensureOverlay()
        if not overlay then return end
        local initialPixels = bindButtonPixels()
        local button = New("ImageButton", { Name = "AimlockButton", Parent = overlay, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = NoirPersistence.GetPosition("aimlock_bind_v1", UDim2.new(.83, 0, .70, 0)),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(initialPixels, initialPixels), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 28, 33), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false,
        Image = "", ClipsDescendants = false, ZIndex = 8 })
        local novaFx = noirNovaButton(button, { round = true, press = false })
        local aspect = New("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { Parent = button, AspectRatio = 1, AspectType = Enum.AspectType.ScaleWithParentSize })
        local outerGradient, innerGradient, pressScale = novaFx.outer, novaFx.inner, novaFx.scale
        local label = New("TextLabel", { Parent = button, Name = "Text", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(.76, .76),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Aimlock", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 248, 246), TextSize = 12, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ZIndex = 9 })
        aim.bindOuterGradient, aim.bindInnerGradient, aim.bindPressScale = outerGradient, innerGradient, pressScale
        local dragging, moved, dragStart, startPosition, dragInput = false, false, nil, nil, nil
            aim.bindConnections[#aim.bindConnections + 1] = button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
            dragging, moved, dragStart, startPosition = true, false, input.Position, button.Position
            TweenService:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.035 }):Play()
        end)
            aim.bindConnections[#aim.bindConnections + 1] = button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput = input end
        end)
            aim.bindConnections[#aim.bindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input ~= dragInput then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 7 then moved = true end
            button.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end)
            aim.bindConnections[#aim.bindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or not isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
            dragging = false
            TweenService:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if moved then NoirPersistence.SetPosition("aimlock_bind_v1", button.Position) end
        end)
            aim.bindConnections[#aim.bindConnections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
            if not moved then setAimlock(not aim.enabled) end
        end)
        aim.bindButton = button
        updateBindSize(); updateBindVisual()
    end
        local function setBindVisible(enabled)
        aim.bindVisible = enabled == true
        if aim.bindVisible then createBindButton() else removeBindButton() end
    end
        local function aimStep(dt)
        if aim.stopped or not aim.enabled then return end
        local now = os.clock()
            if now - aim.lastSearch >= aim.searchInterval then
            aim.lastSearch = now
            if not validPlayer(aim.selectedPlayer) then aim.selectedPlayer = nil end
            if not aim.selectedPlayer then aim.targetPlayer = findMurdererForAimlock() end
        end
        local target = getAimTarget()
        local part, camera = target and resolvePart(target), Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not part or not camera or not hasLineOfSight(part, target) then aim.lastAimPos = nil; return end
        if aim.lastTarget ~= target then aim.lastAimPos, aim.lastTarget = nil, target end
        local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local predicted = Vector3.new(aim.horizontalPrediction and velocity.X * aim.prediction or 0, velocity.Y * .3 * aim.prediction, aim.horizontalPrediction and velocity.Z * aim.prediction or 0)
        local aimPosition = part.Position + predicted
        if not inFov(aimPosition) then aim.lastAimPos = nil; return end
            if aim.lastAimPos and aim.smoothness > 0 then
            local alpha = math.clamp(1 - math.exp(-aim.smoothRate * dt), 0, 1)
            aimPosition = aim.lastAimPos:Lerp(aimPosition, alpha)
        end
        aim.lastAimPos = aimPosition
        pcall(function() camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, aimPosition, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) end)
    end
        local function playerChoices()
        local names = { "Auto Murderer" }
        for _, player in ipairs(getPlayers()) do if player ~= LocalPlayer then names[#names + 1] = player.Name end end
        table.sort(names, function(a, b) if a == "Auto Murderer" then return true elseif b == "Auto Murderer" then return false end return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b) end)
        return names
    end
    local aimSection = tab:AddSection("AIM • AIMLOCK", "Camera lock for Murderer or a selected player • all controls are local")
    aimSection:AddToggle("Enable Aimlock", setAimlock)
    aimSection:AddToggle("Enable Aimlock Bind Button", setBindVisible)
        aimSection:AddSlider("Aimlock Bind Button Size", 5, 25, savedAimBindPercent, function(value)
        local percent = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(value) or savedAimBindPercent) + .5), 5, 25)
        aim.bindSize = percent / 100
        NoirPersistence.data.sliders[aimSizeStorageKey] = percent
        NoirPersistence.data.sliders[aimSizeControlKey] = percent
        NoirPersistence.Save()
        if aim.bindPressScale then aim.bindPressScale.Scale = 1 end
        updateBindSize()
    end)
    aimSection:AddToggle("Aimlock Wall Check", function(enabled) aim.wallCheck = enabled == true end)
    aimSection:AddToggle("Aimlock FOV Check", function(enabled) aim.fovEnabled = enabled == true; updateFovCircle() end)
    aimSection:AddSlider("Aimlock FOV Radius", 50, 800, 250, function(value) aim.fovRadius = tonumber(value) or 250; updateFovCircle() end)
        aimSection:AddSlider("Aimlock Smoothness", 0, 95, 25, function(value)
        local percent = math.clamp((tonumber(value) or 25) / 100, 0, .95)
        aim.smoothness = percent
        aim.smoothRate = percent <= .001 and 1000 or math.clamp(24 * (1 - percent) + 1, 1, 1000)
    end)
    aimSection:AddToggle("Aimlock Horizontal Prediction", function(enabled) aim.horizontalPrediction = enabled == true end)
        local playerSelector = aimSection:AddDropdown("Aimlock Target Player", playerChoices(), function(name)
        aim.selectedPlayer = name == "Auto Murderer" and nil or Players:FindFirstChild(name)
        if not aim.selectedPlayer then aim.targetPlayer = findMurdererForAimlock() end
        clearCache()
    end)
        aimSection:AddButton("Refresh Aimlock Player List", function()
        local selected = aim.selectedPlayer and aim.selectedPlayer.Name or "Auto Murderer"
        playerSelector:Refresh(playerChoices(), selected)
    end)
        aimSection:AddButton("Clear Aimlock Player Selection", function()
        aim.selectedPlayer = nil; aim.targetPlayer = findMurdererForAimlock(); clearCache()
        playerSelector:SetValue("Auto Murderer")
    end)
    aimSection:AddDropdown("Aimlock Target Body Part", { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart" }, function(value) aim.targetPart = value; clearCache() end)
        aimSection:AddDropdown("Aimlock Prediction", { "Medium (0.145)", "Low (0.08)", "High (0.20)", "Disabled" }, function(value)
        aim.prediction = string.find(value, "Low", 1, true) and .08 or string.find(value, "High", 1, true) and .20 or value == "Disabled" and 0 or .145
    end)
    aimSection:AddKeybind("Aimlock Quick Toggle", "T", function(value) aim.key = tostring(value or "T") end)
    aimSection:AddLabel("Tip: select Auto Murderer for automatic role targeting. Drag the round AIM button to move it.")
        connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(input, processed)
        if processed or UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode.Name == aim.key then setAimlock(not aim.enabled) end
    end)
        connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, function(player)
        if aim.selectedPlayer == player then aim.selectedPlayer = nil end
        if aim.targetPlayer == player then aim.targetPlayer = nil end
        clearCache()
    end)
        connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
        aim.targetPlayer = nil; aim.selectedPlayer = nil; clearCache()
        task.delay(1, function() if aim.enabled and not aim.stopped then aim.targetPlayer = findMurdererForAimlock() end end)
    end)
    connect(Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), function() updateBindSize(); updateFovCircle() end)
    RunService:BindToRenderStep("NoirMiscAimlock", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, aimStep)
    NoirGenv().__NoirMiscAimlockRuntime = {
        Stop = function()
        if aim.stopped then return end
        aim.stopped = true
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("NoirMiscAimlock") end)
        for _, connection in ipairs(aim.connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        disconnectBindButton()
        if aim.overlay then aim.overlay:Destroy() end
        aim.overlay, aim.bindButton, aim.fovCircle = nil, nil, nil
    end,
    }
end)
do
    local function buildUniversalUtilities()
    local universalState = {
    infiniteJump = false,
    invisible = false,
    invisibleOriginals = {},
    invisibleCharacter = nil,
    invisibleHumanoid = nil,
    invisibleRoot = nil,
    invisibleBindEnabled = false,
    invisibleBindGui = nil,
    invisibleBindButton = nil,
    invisibleBindSize = .105,
    invisibleBindConnections = {},
    }
        local function disconnectAll(list)
        for _, connection in ipairs(list) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(list)
    end
        local function restoreInvisible()
            for instance, transparency in pairs(universalState.invisibleOriginals) do
            if instance and instance.Parent then pcall(function() instance.Transparency = transparency end) end
        end
        table.clear(universalState.invisibleOriginals)
    end
        local function setupInvisibleCharacter(character)
        universalState.invisibleCharacter = character or LocalPlayer.Character
        local current = universalState.invisibleCharacter
        universalState.invisibleHumanoid = current and current:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid") or nil
        universalState.invisibleRoot = current and current:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
        table.clear(universalState.invisibleOriginals)
        if not current then return end
            for _, instance in ipairs(current:GetDescendants()) do
                if instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance.Transparency == 0 then
                universalState.invisibleOriginals[instance] = instance.Transparency
            end
        end
    end
        local function setInvisibleTransparency(value)
            for instance in pairs(universalState.invisibleOriginals) do
            if instance and instance.Parent then pcall(function() instance.Transparency = value end) end
        end
    end
        local function applyInvisible()
        restoreInvisible()
        if not universalState.invisible then return end
        setupInvisibleCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
        setInvisibleTransparency(.5)
    end
        local function setInvisible(enabled)
        universalState.invisible = enabled == true
        applyInvisible()
        updateInvisibleBindText()
    end
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not universalState.invisible then return end
        -- NOIR fix v6: весь кадр невидимости под pcall — сбой исполнителя не роняет кадр
            pcall(function()
            local root, humanoid = universalState.invisibleRoot, universalState.invisibleHumanoid
                if not (root and root.Parent and humanoid and humanoid.Parent) then
                setupInvisibleCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
                root, humanoid = universalState.invisibleRoot, universalState.invisibleHumanoid
            end
            if not (root and humanoid) then return end
            local originalCFrame, originalOffset = root.CFrame, humanoid.CameraOffset
            local downCFrame = originalCFrame * CFrame.new(0, -200000, 0)
                local ok = pcall(function()
                root.CFrame = downCFrame
                humanoid.CameraOffset = downCFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(originalCFrame.Position)).Position
            end)
            if not ok then return end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                pcall(function()
                if root.Parent then root.CFrame = originalCFrame end
                if humanoid.Parent then humanoid.CameraOffset = originalOffset end
            end)
        end)
    end)
        local function updateInvisibleBindText()
        local button = universalState.invisibleBindButton
        if not button then return end
        local label = button:FindFirstChild("Text")
        if label then label.Text = universalState.invisible and "Invisible\nON" or "Invisible\nOFF" end
    end
    local createInvisibleBindButton, removeInvisibleBindButton -- NOIR fix v5: опережающее объявление кнопки невидимости
        local function setInvisible(enabled)
        universalState.invisible = enabled == true
        -- NOIR fix v6: кнопка создаётся ПЕРВОЙ и под pcall — ни одна ошибка
        -- (визуал, персонаж, сбой исполнителя) больше не может помешать её появлению
            pcall(function()
            if type(createInvisibleBindButton) ~= "function" or type(removeInvisibleBindButton) ~= "function" then return end
                if universalState.invisible or universalState.invisibleBindEnabled then
                createInvisibleBindButton()
            else
                removeInvisibleBindButton()
            end
        end)
        pcall(applyInvisible)
        pcall(updateInvisibleBindText)
            pcall(function()
                if type(getgenv) == "function" then
                local g = getgenv()
                if type(g) == "table" then g.__noirInvis = { active = universalState.invisible == true } end
            end
        end)
    end
        function removeInvisibleBindButton()
        disconnectAll(universalState.invisibleBindConnections)
        if universalState.invisibleBindGui then universalState.invisibleBindGui:Destroy() end
        universalState.invisibleBindGui, universalState.invisibleBindButton = nil, nil
            for _, parent in ipairs({ guiParent, CoreGui, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") }) do
                if typeof(parent) == "Instance" then
                local stale = parent:FindFirstChild("NoirInvisibleBindButton")
                if stale then stale:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end
        local function updateInvisibleBindButtonSize()
        local button, camera = universalState.invisibleBindButton, Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not button or not camera then return end
        local screen = camera.ViewportSize
        local heightScale = universalState.invisibleBindSize
        button.Size = UDim2.new(heightScale * (screen.Y / math.max(screen.X, 1)), 0, heightScale, 0)
    end
        function createInvisibleBindButton()
        -- NOIR fix v6: не выходим, если кнопка "мертва" (gui уничтожен внешне) — пересоздаём
        if universalState.invisibleBindButton and universalState.invisibleBindButton.Parent then return end
        removeInvisibleBindButton()
        local parent = guiParent
            if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then
            parent = nil
            pcall(function() parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end)
        end
        if not parent then return end
        local bindGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        bindGui.Name, bindGui.ResetOnSpawn, bindGui.IgnoreGuiInset, bindGui.DisplayOrder = "NoirInvisibleBindButton", false, true, 82
        bindGui.Parent = parent
        local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
        button.Name = "Invisible"
        button.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        local bindPos = NoirPersistence.GetPosition("invisible_bind_v1", UDim2.new(.24, 0, .88, 0))
        -- NOIR fix v6: сбрасываем сохранённую позицию, если она за пределами экрана
            if typeof(bindPos) ~= "UDim2" or bindPos.X.Scale < -.25 or bindPos.X.Scale > 1.25 or bindPos.Y.Scale < -.25 or bindPos.Y.Scale > 1.25 then
            bindPos = UDim2.new(.24, 0, .88, 0)
        end
        button.Position = bindPos
        button.Size = UDim2.new(universalState.invisibleBindSize, 0, universalState.invisibleBindSize, 0)
        button.BackgroundColor3, button.BackgroundTransparency, button.BorderSizePixel = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25), .16, 0
        button.Image, button.AutoButtonColor, button.ZIndex = "", false, 5
        button.Parent = bindGui
        local novaFx = noirNovaButton(button, { round = true })
        local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint"); aspect.AspectRatio = 1; aspect.Parent = button
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name, label.AnchorPoint, label.Position, label.Size = "Text", Vector2.new(.5,.5), UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5), UDim2.fromScale(.76,.76)
        label.BackgroundTransparency, label.TextColor3, label.TextSize, label.TextWrapped, label.Font, label.ZIndex = 1, Color3.fromRGB(220,248,246), 14, true, Enum.Font.Gotham, 6
        label.Parent = button
        local dragging, moved, dragStart, startPosition, dragInput = false, false, nil, nil, nil
            universalState.invisibleBindConnections[#universalState.invisibleBindConnections + 1] = button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if not isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
            dragging, moved, dragStart, startPosition = true, false, input.Position, button.Position
        end)
            universalState.invisibleBindConnections[#universalState.invisibleBindConnections + 1] = button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput = input end
        end)
            universalState.invisibleBindConnections[#universalState.invisibleBindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input ~= dragInput then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 7 then moved = true end
            button.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end)
            universalState.invisibleBindConnections[#universalState.invisibleBindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or not isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
            dragging = false
            NoirPersistence.SetPosition("invisible_bind_v1", button.Position)
        end)
            universalState.invisibleBindConnections[#universalState.invisibleBindConnections + 1] = button.Activated:Connect(function()
            if not moved then setInvisible(not universalState.invisible) end
        end)
        universalState.invisibleBindGui, universalState.invisibleBindButton = bindGui, button
        updateInvisibleBindButtonSize()
        updateInvisibleBindText()
    end
        local function setInvisibleBindButton(enabled)
        universalState.invisibleBindEnabled = enabled == true
        -- NOIR fix v5: кнопка видна, если включён её тоггл ИЛИ сама невидимость
        -- NOIR fix v6: создание/удаление под pcall — сбой исполнителя не роняет тоггл
            pcall(function()
            if type(createInvisibleBindButton) ~= "function" then return end
            if universalState.invisibleBindEnabled or universalState.invisible then createInvisibleBindButton() else removeInvisibleBindButton() end
        end)
    end
        UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if not universalState.infiniteJump then return end
        local humanoid = localHumanoid()
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end)
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.wait(1)
        setupInvisibleCharacter(character)
        if universalState.invisible then setInvisibleTransparency(.5) end
        -- NOIR fix v6: после респауна убеждаемся, что кнопка на месте
            pcall(function()
                if (universalState.invisible or universalState.invisibleBindEnabled) and type(createInvisibleBindButton) == "function" then
                createInvisibleBindButton()
            end
        end)
    end)
    local universalMods = tab:AddSection("MAIN • UNIVERSAL", "Movement and survival utilities")
    universalMods:AddToggle("Infinite Jump", function(enabled) universalState.infiniteJump = enabled == true end)
    local invisibleMods = tab:AddSection("MAIN • INVISIBLE", "Desync invisibility and floating bind button")
    invisibleMods:AddToggle("Invisible", setInvisible)
    invisibleMods:AddToggle("Enable Invisible Bind Button", setInvisibleBindButton)
        invisibleMods:AddSlider("Invisible Bind Button Size", 5, 25, universalState.invisibleBindSize * 100, function(value)
        universalState.invisibleBindSize = (tonumber(value) or 10.5) / 100
        updateInvisibleBindButtonSize()
    end)
    invisibleMods:AddLabel("Round Invisible button: tap to toggle; drag it to move. Its size and position are saved.")
    if not (universalState.invisibleBindEnabled or universalState.invisible) then removeInvisibleBindButton() end
    -- NOIR fix v6: сторож-самовосстановление. Пока сессия жива и невидимость (или
    -- её кнопка-бинд) включена, раз в секунду проверяем, что круглая кнопка реально
    -- существует и припарентована; если её уничтожил исполнитель или перезапуск —
    -- молча пересоздаём. Это гарантирует появление кнопки при любом раскладе.
        task.spawn(function()
            while __R1.running do
            task.wait(1)
                if universalState.invisible or universalState.invisibleBindEnabled then
                local alive = false
                    pcall(function()
                    local gui, btn = universalState.invisibleBindGui, universalState.invisibleBindButton
                    alive = gui ~= nil and btn ~= nil and gui.Parent ~= nil and btn.Parent ~= nil
                end)
                    if not alive then
                    universalState.invisibleBindGui, universalState.invisibleBindButton = nil, nil
                        pcall(function()
                        if type(createInvisibleBindButton) == "function" then createInvisibleBindButton() end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end
buildUniversalUtilities()
end
    task.defer(function()
    local desyncState = {
    enabled = false,
    anchorCFrame = nil,
    bindEnabled = false,
    bindGui = nil,
    bindButton = nil,
    bindSize = .105,
    bindConnections = {},
    bindOuterGradient = nil,
    bindInnerGradient = nil,
    }
    local desyncToggleControl, syncingDesyncToggle = nil, false
    local monochromeGradient = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(16, 60, 66)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22, Color3.fromRGB(70, 190, 196)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.48, Color3.fromRGB(20, 90, 98)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.72, Color3.fromRGB(120, 235, 228)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(10, 44, 50)),
    })
    local rubyGradient = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(6, 78, 84)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.24, Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 250)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5, Color3.fromRGB(38, 240, 228)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.76, Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 252)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 52, 58)),
    })
        local function updateDesyncBindText()
        local button = desyncState.bindButton
        local label = button and button:FindFirstChild("Text")
        if label then label.Text = "Desync" end
        if desyncState.bindOuterGradient then desyncState.bindOuterGradient.Color = desyncState.enabled and rubyGradient or monochromeGradient end
        if desyncState.bindInnerGradient then desyncState.bindInnerGradient.Color = desyncState.enabled and rubyGradient or monochromeGradient end
    end
        local function setDesync(enabled)
        desyncState.enabled = enabled == true
            if desyncState.enabled then
            local root = localRoot()
            desyncState.anchorCFrame = root and root.CFrame or nil
            if not desyncState.anchorCFrame then desyncState.enabled = false end
        else
            desyncState.anchorCFrame = nil
            local pendingRoot, pendingCFrame = desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame
            desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame = nil, nil
            if pendingRoot and pendingRoot.Parent and pendingCFrame then pcall(function() pendingRoot.CFrame = pendingCFrame end) end
        end
        updateDesyncBindText()
            if desyncToggleControl and not syncingDesyncToggle then
            syncingDesyncToggle = true
            desyncToggleControl(desyncState.enabled)
            syncingDesyncToggle = false
        end
    end
        local function disconnectDesyncBind()
        for _, connection in ipairs(desyncState.bindConnections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(desyncState.bindConnections)
    end
        local function removeDesyncBindButton()
        disconnectDesyncBind()
        if desyncState.bindGui then desyncState.bindGui:Destroy() end
        desyncState.bindGui, desyncState.bindButton = nil, nil
            for _, parent in ipairs({ guiParent, CoreGui, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") }) do
                if parent then
                local stale = parent:FindFirstChild("NoirDesyncBindButton")
                if stale then stale:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end
        local function updateDesyncBindSize()
        local button, camera = desyncState.bindButton, Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not button or not camera then return end
        local viewport = camera.ViewportSize
        local h = desyncState.bindSize
        button.Size = UDim2.new(h * (viewport.Y / math.max(viewport.X, 1)), 0, h, 0)
    end
        local function createDesyncBindButton()
        if desyncState.bindButton then return end
        removeDesyncBindButton()
        local parent = guiParent
        if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
        local bindGui = New("ScreenGui", { Parent = parent, Name = "NoirDesyncBindButton", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 83, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling })
        local button = New("ImageButton", { Parent = bindGui, Name = "Desync", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = NoirPersistence.GetPosition("desync_bind_v1", UDim2.new(.35, 0, .88, 0)), Size = UDim2.fromScale(desyncState.bindSize, desyncState.bindSize),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 28, 33), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Image = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ClipsDescendants = false, ZIndex = 7 })
        local novaFx = noirNovaButton(button, { round = true, press = false })
        local aspect = New("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { Parent = button, AspectRatio = 1, AspectType = Enum.AspectType.ScaleWithParentSize })
        local outerGradient, innerGradient, pressScale = novaFx.outer, novaFx.inner, novaFx.scale
        desyncState.bindOuterGradient, desyncState.bindInnerGradient = outerGradient, innerGradient
        local label = New("TextLabel", { Parent = button, Name = "Text", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(.76, .76),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "Desync\nOFF", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 248, 246), TextSize = 14, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, ZIndex = 8 })
        local dragging, moved, startInput, startPosition, dragInput = false, false, nil, nil, nil
            desyncState.bindConnections[#desyncState.bindConnections + 1] = button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging, moved, startInput, startPosition = true, false, input.Position, button.Position
                TweenService:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.035 }):Play()
            end
        end)
            desyncState.bindConnections[#desyncState.bindConnections + 1] = button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then dragInput = input end
        end)
            desyncState.bindConnections[#desyncState.bindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input ~= dragInput then return end
            local delta = input.Position - startInput
            if delta.Magnitude > 7 then moved = true end
            button.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end)
            desyncState.bindConnections[#desyncState.bindConnections + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or not (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
            dragging = false
            TweenService:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
                if moved then
                NoirPersistence.SetPosition("desync_bind_v1", button.Position)
            else
                setDesync(not desyncState.enabled)
            end
        end)
        desyncState.bindGui, desyncState.bindButton = bindGui, button
        updateDesyncBindSize(); updateDesyncBindText()
    end
        local function setDesyncBindButton(enabled)
        desyncState.bindEnabled = enabled == true
        if desyncState.bindEnabled then createDesyncBindButton() else removeDesyncBindButton() end
    end
    desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame = nil, nil
        RunService:BindToRenderStep("NoirDesyncRestore_" .. tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId), Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
        local root, cframe = desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame
        desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame = nil, nil
        if root and root.Parent and cframe then pcall(function() root.CFrame = cframe end) end
    end)
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not desyncState.enabled then return end
        local root = localRoot()
        if not root or not root.Parent then return end
        if not desyncState.anchorCFrame then desyncState.anchorCFrame = root.CFrame end
        local localCFrame = root.CFrame
        desyncState.pendingRoot, desyncState.pendingCFrame = root, localCFrame
        pcall(function() root.CFrame = desyncState.anchorCFrame end)
    end)
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
            if desyncState.enabled then
            task.wait(.35)
            local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then desyncState.anchorCFrame = root.CFrame end
        end
    end)
    local desyncMods = tab:AddSection("MAIN • DESYNC", "Keeps the server-facing character position at the activation point")
        desyncToggleControl = desyncMods:AddToggle("Desync", function(enabled)
        if not syncingDesyncToggle then setDesync(enabled) end
    end)
    desyncMods:AddToggle("Enable Desync Bind Button", setDesyncBindButton)
        desyncMods:AddSlider("Desync Bind Button Size", 5, 25, desyncState.bindSize * 100, function(value)
        desyncState.bindSize = (tonumber(value) or 10.5) / 100
        updateDesyncBindSize()
    end)
    desyncMods:AddLabel("Enable Desync to save the current position; you can then move locally while its saved position is sent on desync frames.")
    if not desyncState.bindEnabled then removeDesyncBindButton() end
end)
do
    local function buildSettingsUI()
    local page = settingsContent
        if page then
            local function card(title, subtitle)
            local c = New("Frame", { Parent = page, Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 90), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BackgroundTransparency = .86, ClipsDescendants = true })
            corner(c, 10); stroke(c, C.border, .15)
            local tickbar = New("Frame", { Parent = c, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20), BackgroundColor3 = C.accent })
            corner(tickbar, 2)
            kitiTitle(c, title)
            if subtitle and subtitle ~= "" then kitiDesc(c, subtitle) end
            local holder = New("Frame", { Parent = c, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, subtitle ~= "" and 48 or 38), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 0),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            New("UIListLayout", { Parent = holder, Padding = UDim.new(0, 7), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder })
            New("UIPadding", { Parent = holder, PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12) })
            return holder
        end
        local st = NoirGenv().__NoirLangState
        local holder = card("SETTINGS • HUB", "Language and hub preferences")
        local languageLabels = { en = "Language: English", ru = "Language: Russian", ar = "Language: Arabic" }
        local langBtn = New("TextButton", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44),
        Text = NoirTr(languageLabels[st.lang] or languageLabels.en), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, AutoButtonColor = false })
        corner(langBtn, 10); stroke(langBtn, C.border, .35)
        langBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(langBtn, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
        langBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(langBtn, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44) }):Play() end)
        langBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(langBtn, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(21, 28, 32) }):Play() end)
        langBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(langBtn, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
            local function updateLanguageButton()
            local source = languageLabels[st.lang] or languageLabels.en
            langBtn.Text = NoirTr(source)
                pcall(function()
                langBtn:SetAttribute("__NoirTextSource", source)
                langBtn:SetAttribute("__NoirTextRendered", langBtn.Text)
            end)
                if type(NoirGenv().__NoirRefreshLanguage) == "function" then
                pcall(NoirGenv().__NoirRefreshLanguage)
            end
        end
        updateLanguageButton()
            langBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            local order = { "en", "ru", "ar" }
            local currentIndex = 1
            for index, language in ipairs(order) do if language == st.lang then currentIndex = index break end end
            st.lang = order[(currentIndex % #order) + 1]
            NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns["Noir::Lang"] = st.lang
            NoirPersistence.Save()
            updateLanguageButton()
            notify(NoirTr("Language updated."), 2)
        end)
        streamModeButton = New("TextButton", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44),
        TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 15, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, AutoButtonColor = false })
        corner(streamModeButton, 10); stroke(streamModeButton, C.border, .35)
        streamModeButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(streamModeButton, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
        streamModeButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(streamModeButton, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44) }):Play() end)
        streamModeButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(streamModeButton, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(21, 28, 32) }):Play() end)
        streamModeButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(streamModeButton, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
        updateStreamModeButton()
        streamModeButton.Activated:Connect(function() StreamMode:Toggle() end)
        local streamHint = text(holder, "Hides button visuals only; buttons remain clickable.", 12, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), true)
        streamHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)
        local streamRecoveryHint = text(holder, "Restore buttons: Right Shift or hold three fingers for 1.3 seconds.", 12, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), true)
        streamRecoveryHint.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
        streamRecoveryHint.TextWrapped = true
        local execName = "Unknown"
            pcall(function()
            if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then execName = tostring(identifyexecutor()) end
        end)
        local execLbl = text(holder, "Executor: " .. execName, 14, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 6), true)
        execLbl.TextWrapped = true
        local supLbl = text(holder, "Windows: Xeno, Solara, Madium, Real, SirHurt, Potassium, Volt • Android: Delta, Codex, Arceus X • iOS: Delta • Mac: Opiumware, Macsploit", 12, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), true)
        supLbl.TextWrapped = true
        NoirGenv().__NoirSettingsHolder = holder

buildSettingsUI()

do
    local function buildAntiAim()
    local holder = NoirGenv().__NoirSettingsHolder
    if not holder then return end
    local presetNames = { "low", "high", "y high", "limit", "zero" }
    local aaPreset = "low"
    local savedPreset = NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns["Settings::Anti-AimPreset"]
        for _, presetName in ipairs(presetNames) do
            if savedPreset == presetName then
            aaPreset = presetName
            break
        end
    end
    local aaEnabled = false
    local aaHrp, aaHum, aaConn = nil, nil, nil
    local aaFflagOld = nil
    local aaBusy = false
        local function aaSetFF(value)
            pcall(function()
                if type(setfflag) == "function" then
                setfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate", tostring(value))
            end
        end)
    end
        local function aaBind(character)
        aaHrp, aaHum = nil, nil
        if not character then return end
            task.spawn(function()
            local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 6)
            local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 6)
                if LocalPlayer.Character == character then
                aaHrp, aaHum = root, humanoid
            end
        end)
    end
    aaBind(LocalPlayer.Character)
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(aaBind)
        local function aaSigned(value)
        return math.random(1, 2) == 1 and -value or value
    end
        local function aaVelocity()
            if aaPreset == "y high" then
            return Vector3.new(0, 16384, 0)
        elseif aaPreset == "limit" then
            -- Keep this preset inside Luau's safe integer range; signed 64-bit random bounds can overflow.
                local function limitComponent()
                local magnitude = math.random() * 2147483647
                return math.random(1, 2) == 1 and -magnitude or magnitude
            end
            return Vector3.new(limitComponent(), limitComponent(), limitComponent())
        elseif aaPreset == "high" then
            return Vector3.new(
            aaSigned(16384),
            math.random(1, 2) == 1 and -14384 or 16384,
            aaSigned(16384)
            )
        elseif aaPreset == "zero" then
            return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        return Vector3.new(aaSigned(300), aaSigned(300), aaSigned(300))
    end
        local function aaStop()
            if aaConn then
            pcall(function() aaConn:Disconnect() end)
            aaConn = nil
        end
        aaSetFF(aaFflagOld or "15")
        aaFflagOld = nil
            pcall(function()
            local env = NoirGenv()
            if type(env) == "table" then env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = os.clock() end
        end)
    end
        local function aaStart()
        if aaConn then return end
        aaFflagOld = nil
            pcall(function()
                if type(getfflag) == "function" then
                local value = getfflag("S2PhysicsSenderRate")
                if value ~= nil then aaFflagOld = tostring(value) end
            end
        end)
            aaConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not aaEnabled or aaBusy then return end
            local root, humanoid = aaHrp, aaHum
            if not root or not humanoid or not root.Parent or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
            local env = NoirGenv()
            local flingActive = type(env) == "table" and env.FLING_ACTIVE or nil
            if flingActive == true or (tonumber(flingActive) or 0) ~= 0 then return end
            local fps = 60
                if type(dt) == "number" and dt > 0 then
                fps = math.floor(math.min(1000, math.max(1, 1 / dt)) * 10 + 0.5) / 10
            end
            aaSetFF(fps)
                pcall(function()
                    if type(sethiddenproperty) == "function" then
                    sethiddenproperty(root, "NetworkIsSleeping", false)
                end
            end)
            aaBusy = true
            local oldLin, oldAng
                local ok = pcall(function()
                oldLin = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                oldAng = root.AssemblyAngularVelocity
                if type(env) == "table" then env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = os.clock() + 0.35 end
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = aaVelocity()
            end)
                if not ok then
                aaBusy = false
                return
            end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                if root and root.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = oldLin
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = oldAng
                end)
            end
            if type(env) == "table" then env.VELOCITY_DESYNC_UNTIL = os.clock() + 0.05 end
            aaBusy = false
        end)
    end
    local row = New("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    text(row, "Anti-Aim", 16, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 10))
    local pill = New("TextButton", { Parent = row, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 16),
    BackgroundColor3 = C.off, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false })
    corner(pill, 8); stroke(pill, C.border, 0)
    local dot = New("Frame", { Parent = pill, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, .5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), BackgroundColor3 = C.text })
    corner(dot, 6)
    local presetRow = New("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
    local presetLabel = text(presetRow, "Velocity preset", 13, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 5), true)
    presetLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 28)
    local presetButton = New("TextButton", { Parent = presetRow, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(132, 30),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44), TextColor3 = C.text, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, TextWrapped = false, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutoButtonColor = false })
    corner(presetButton, 10); stroke(presetButton, C.border, .35)
    -- NOIR design v4: стрелка нарисована фреймами (глиф был тофу на телефоне),
    -- добавлены состояния покой/ховер/нажатие
    New("Frame", { Parent = presetButton, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, .5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -14, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2), Rotation = 45,
    BackgroundColor3 = C.dim, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6 })
    New("Frame", { Parent = presetButton, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, .5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, .5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 2), Rotation = -45,
    BackgroundColor3 = C.dim, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6 })
    presetButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(presetButton, TweenInfo.new(.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
    presetButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(presetButton, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 44) }):Play() end)
    presetButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(presetButton, TweenInfo.new(.06), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(21, 28, 32) }):Play() end)
    presetButton.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(presetButton, TweenInfo.new(.12), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 58, 63) }):Play() end)
        local function updatePresetButton()
        presetButton.Text = string.upper(aaPreset)
    end
    updatePresetButton()
    local lastClick, lastPresetClick = 0, 0
        local function setAA(value)
        aaEnabled = value == true
        TweenService:Create(pill, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { BackgroundColor3 = aaEnabled and C.accent or C.off }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(dot, TweenInfo.new(.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = aaEnabled and UDim2.new(1, -14, .5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 2, .5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = aaEnabled and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 162)
        }):Play()
        if aaEnabled then aaStart() else aaStop() end
        NoirPersistence.data.toggles["Settings::Anti-Aim"] = aaEnabled
        NoirPersistence.Save()
        notify(aaEnabled and "Anti-Aim ON" or "Anti-Aim OFF", 2)
    end
        local function aaClick()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastClick < .18 then return end
        lastClick = now
        setAA(not aaEnabled)
    end
        local function nextPreset()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - lastPresetClick < .18 then return end
        lastPresetClick = now
        local current = 1
            for i, presetName in ipairs(presetNames) do
            if presetName == aaPreset then current = i; break end
        end
        aaPreset = presetNames[current % #presetNames + 1]
        updatePresetButton()
        NoirPersistence.data.dropdowns["Settings::Anti-AimPreset"] = aaPreset
        NoirPersistence.Save()
        notify("Anti-Aim preset: " .. aaPreset, 2)
    end
    pill.Activated:Connect(aaClick)
    presetButton.Activated:Connect(nextPreset)
    if NoirPersistence.data.toggles["Settings::Anti-Aim"] == true then setAA(true) end
end
buildAntiAim()
end
