do
    local __mvOk, __mvErr = pcall(function()
    local CORE = NoirGenv().__NoirCore
    if type(CORE) ~= "table" or type(CORE.host) ~= "table" then return end
    if type(New) ~= "function" or type(corner) ~= "function" or type(stroke) ~= "function" or type(text) ~= "function" then return end
    local CPal = type(CORE.C) == "table" and CORE.C or C
    local Players2 = CORE.Players or game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService2 = CORE.RunService or game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP = CORE.LocalPlayer or Players2.LocalPlayer
    local Workspace2 = CORE.Workspace or game:GetService("Workspace")
    local MVT = (NoirGenv().__NoirMapVoteToken or 0) + 1
    NoirGenv().__NoirMapVoteToken = MVT
    local function mvAlive() return NoirGenv().__NoirMapVoteToken == MVT end
    local function mvNotify(msg) pcall(function() CORE.host.Notify(tostring(msg), 3) end) end
    -- isolated engine environment (the same contract the original engine expects)
    local ENV = setmetatable({
    game = game, workspace = Workspace2, task = task, os = os, Instance = Instance,
    Enum = Enum, Color3 = Color3, Vector2 = Vector2, Vector3 = Vector3, CFrame = CFrame,
    UDim = UDim, UDim2 = UDim2, TweenInfo = TweenInfo,
    getgenv = getgenv or function() return _G end,
    }, { __index = _G })
    local context = {
    environment = ENV,
    configuration = { vote = {} },
    workspace = Workspace2,
    player = LP,
    players = Players2,
    runService = RunService2,
    connect = function(signal, callback) return signal:Connect(callback) end,
    isAlive = function() return mvAlive() and LP.Parent ~= nil end,
    }
    local MapVote = {}
    MapVote.maps = {
    {key = "bank2", name = "Bank 2", icon = "rbxassetid://3214475169"},
    {key = "biolab", name = "Bio Lab", icon = "rbxassetid://3214475802"},

        function MapVote.key(name)
        return (string.lower(tostring(name or "")):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
    end
        function MapVote.create(context)
        local vote = context.configuration.vote
            if type(vote) ~= "table" then
            vote = {}
            context.configuration.vote = vote
        end
        if type(vote.count) ~= "number" then vote.count = 10 end
        if vote.silent == nil then vote.silent = true end
        if type(vote.icons) ~= "table" then vote.icons = {} end
        if type(vote.extra) ~= "table" then vote.extra = {} end
        if type(vote.off) ~= "table" then vote.off = {} end
        if vote.auto == nil then vote.auto = false end
        if type(vote.fallback) ~= "string" then vote.fallback = "skip" end
        local state = {context = context, cfg = vote, busy = false, stop = false, done = 0, want = 0,
        status = "", sel = 1, log = {}, maps = {}, mapList = {}, iconCandidates = {}}
            for _, map in MapVote.maps do
            state.maps[map.key] = map
            table.insert(state.mapList, map)
        end
            for key, extra in vote.extra do
            if type(extra) ~= "table" or state.maps[key] then continue end
            local map = {key = key, name = tostring(extra.n or key), icon = extra.i}
            state.maps[key] = map
            table.insert(state.mapList, map)
        end
        local order, seen = {}, {}
            for _, key in type(vote.order) == "table" and vote.order or {} do
            if not state.maps[key] or seen[key] then continue end
            seen[key] = true
            table.insert(order, key)
        end
            for _, map in state.mapList do
            if seen[map.key] then continue end
            seen[map.key] = true
            table.insert(order, map.key)
        end
        vote.order = order
            for key, icon in vote.icons do
                if state.maps[key] and state.maps[key].icon or type(icon) ~= "string" then
                vote.icons[key] = nil
                continue
            end
            if MapVote.keyForIcon(state, icon, key) then vote.icons[key] = nil end
        end
        return state
    end
        function MapVote.icon(state, key)
        local map = state.maps[key]
        local icon = map and map.icon or state.cfg.icons[key]
        return type(icon) == "string" and icon ~= "" and icon or nil
    end
        function MapVote.keyForIcon(state, icon, except)
            for _, map in state.mapList do
            if map.key ~= except and MapVote.icon(state, map.key) == icon then return map.key end
        end
        return nil
    end
        function MapVote.pads(workspace)
        local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("RegularLobby")
        local pads = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
        if pads and lobby:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return lobby, pads end
            for _, model in workspace:GetChildren() do
            if not model:IsA("Model") then continue end
            local folder = model:FindFirstChild("VotePads")
            if not folder then continue end
            if model:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return model, folder end
            if folder:FindFirstChild("VotePad1") then return folder, folder end
        end
        return nil
    end
        function MapVote.readPad(state, index)
        local parent, detectors = MapVote.pads(state.context.workspace)
        if not parent then return nil end
        local pad = parent:FindFirstChild("VotePad" .. index)
        local detector = detectors and detectors:FindFirstChild("Detector" .. index) or pad and pad:FindFirstChild("Pad")
        if not pad or not detector then return nil end
        local result = {index = index, detector = detector, name = "", mode = "", votes = 0, icon = ""}
            pcall(function()
            local container = pad.VoteInfoGui.Container
            result.name = container.MapName.Text
            result.votes = tonumber(container.Votes.Text:match("%d+")) or 0
        end)
            pcall(function()
            result.icon = pad.MapInfoGui.MapIcon.Image
            result.mode = pad.MapInfoGui.GameMode.Text
        end)
        result.active = result.icon ~= ""
        return result
    end
        function MapVote.choose(state, pads)
        local vote = state.cfg
        local ranks, rank = {}, 0
            for _, key in vote.order do
            if vote.off[key] == true then continue end
            rank += 1
            ranks[key] = rank
        end
        local chosen, bestRank
            for index = 1, 3 do
            local pad = pads[index]
            if not pad or not pad.active then continue end
            local key = MapVote.keyForIcon(state, pad.icon) or MapVote.key(pad.name)
            local currentRank = ranks[key]
            if currentRank and (not bestRank or currentRank < bestRank) then chosen, bestRank = index, currentRank end
        end
        if chosen then return chosen end
            if vote.fallback == "first" then
            for index = 1, 3 do if pads[index] and pads[index].active then return index end end
        end
            if vote.fallback == "leading" then
            local bestVotes
                for index = 1, 3 do
                local pad = pads[index]
                if not pad or not pad.active then continue end
                if bestVotes == nil or pad.votes > bestVotes then chosen, bestVotes = index, pad.votes end
            end
        end
        return chosen
    end
        function MapVote.discover(state, name, icon, now)
        local vote = state.cfg
        local key = MapVote.key(name)
        if key == "" or name == "MAP NAME" then return false end
        local changed = false
            if not state.maps[key] then
            vote.extra[key] = {n = name, i = icon}
            local map = {key = key, name = name, icon = icon}
            state.maps[key] = map
            table.insert(state.mapList, map)
            table.insert(vote.order, key)
            changed = true
        end
        if not icon or icon == "" or state.maps[key].icon or vote.icons[key] == icon then return changed end
        if MapVote.keyForIcon(state, icon, key) then return changed end
        local candidate = state.iconCandidates[key]
            if candidate and candidate.icon == icon and now - candidate.time >= 0.4 then
            vote.icons[key] = icon
            state.iconCandidates[key] = nil
            return true
        end
        if not candidate or candidate.icon ~= icon then state.iconCandidates[key] = {icon = icon, time = now} end
        return changed
    end
        function MapVote.record(state, message)
        if #state.log > 60 then table.remove(state.log, 1) end
        local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
        table.insert(state.log, string.format("%.2f %s", now, message))
    end
        function MapVote.waitCharacter(state, previous, timeout)
        local context = state.context
        local started = context.environment.os.clock()
            while context.environment.os.clock() - started < timeout do
            if state.stop then return nil end
            local character = context.player.Character
                if character and character ~= previous then
                local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 then return character, humanoid, root end
            end
            context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        return nil
    end
        function MapVote.hideFades(state)
        local gui = state.context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local hidden = {}
        if not gui then return hidden end
            for _, name in {"SpawnFade", "CameraFade", "Fade"} do
            local fade = gui:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not fade or not fade:IsA("ScreenGui") or not fade.Enabled then continue end
            table.insert(hidden, fade)
            pcall(function() fade.Enabled = false end)
        end
        return hidden
    end
        function MapVote.restoreFades(state, hidden)
        if #hidden == 0 then return end
        local environment = state.context.environment
            environment.task.spawn(function()
            local started = environment.os.clock()
                while environment.os.clock() - started < 4 do
                local opaque = false
                    for _, fade in hidden do
                        for _, child in fade:GetChildren() do
                        if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Visible and child.BackgroundTransparency < 0.98 then opaque = true end
                    end
                end
                if not opaque then break end
                environment.task.wait(0.1)
            end
                for _, fade in hidden do
                pcall(function() if fade.Parent then fade.Enabled = true end end)
            end
        end)
    end
        function MapVote.protectGui(state)
        local playerGui = state.context.player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        local gui = playerGui and playerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        if not gui or not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") or not gui.ResetOnSpawn then return nil end
        local ok = pcall(function() gui.ResetOnSpawn = false end)
        if not ok then return nil end
        return {gui = gui, resets = 0}
    end
        function MapVote.restoreGui(state, saved)
        if not saved or not saved.gui or not saved.gui.Parent then return end
            if saved.resets > 0 then
            state.context.environment.task.defer(function() pcall(saved.gui.Destroy, saved.gui) end)
            return
        end
        pcall(function() saved.gui.ResetOnSpawn = true end)
    end
        function MapVote.muteDeath(character)
            for _, object in character:GetDescendants() do
            if not object:IsA("Sound") or object.Name ~= "Died" and not object.Name:lower():find("death", 1, true) then continue end
                pcall(function()
                object.Volume = 0
                object:Stop()
            end)
        end
    end
        function MapVote.run(state, index, count)
        local vote = MapVote
        local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
        state.busy, state.stop, state.idx, state.done, state.want, state.status = true, false, index, 0, count, "Voting"
        local silent = state.cfg.silent ~= false
        local hidden = silent and vote.hideFades(state) or {}
        local gui = vote.protectGui(state)
            local ok, raised = pcall(function()
            local character, humanoid, root = vote.waitCharacter(state, nil, 15)
            local failures = 0
                while state.done < count do
                    if state.stop then
                    state.status = "Stopped"
                    break
                end
                    if not character then
                    state.status = state.stop and "Stopped" or "No character"
                    break
                end
                local pad = vote.readPad(state, index)
                    if not pad or not pad.active then
                    state.status = "Voting ended"
                    break
                end
                state.status = "Voting"
                local before, started = pad.votes, environment.os.clock()
                local target = environment.CFrame.new(pad.detector.Position - environment.Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
                vote.record(state, "tp " .. index .. " before=" .. before)
                local counted = false
                    while environment.os.clock() - started < 1.2 and not state.stop do
                    local current = vote.readPad(state, index)
                    if not current or not current.active then break end
                        if current.votes > before and environment.os.clock() - started >= 0.18 then
                        counted = true
                        break
                    end
                        if root.Parent then
                        local delta = root.Position - current.detector.Position
                            if environment.Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > 1.5 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 3.5 then
                            root.CFrame = target * (root.CFrame - root.CFrame.Position)
                            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = environment.Vector3.zero
                        end
                    end
                    context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                vote.record(state, "vote " .. tostring(counted) .. " dt=" .. string.format("%.2f", environment.os.clock() - started))
                    if counted then
                    state.done += 1
                    failures = 0
                end
                    if not counted then
                    failures += 1
                        if failures >= 2 then
                        state.status = "Vote not counted"
                        break
                    end
                end
                if state.done >= count or state.stop then break end
                state.status = "Respawning"
                if silent then pcall(vote.muteDeath, character) end
                if gui then gui.resets += 1 end
                pcall(function() humanoid.Health = 0 end)
                started = environment.os.clock()
                character, humanoid, root = vote.waitCharacter(state, character, 15)
                vote.record(state, "respawned dt=" .. string.format("%.2f", environment.os.clock() - started))
                pad = vote.readPad(state, index)
                    if not pad or not pad.active then
                    state.status = "Voting ended"
                    break
                end
            end
            if state.done >= count then state.status = "Done" end
        end)
            if not ok then
            state.status = "Error"
            vote.record(state, "err " .. tostring(raised))
        end
        vote.restoreGui(state, gui)
        vote.restoreFades(state, hidden)
        state.busy = false
    end
        function MapVote.start(state, index)
        if state.busy then return end
        local pad = MapVote.readPad(state, index)
            if not pad or not pad.active then
            state.status = "Waiting for vote"
            return
        end
        state.sel = index
        local count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(state.cfg.count) or 10), 1, 100)
        state.context.environment.task.spawn(MapVote.run, state, index, count)
    end
        function MapVote.snapshot(state)
        local vote = MapVote
        local pads, active = {}, false
            for index = 1, 3 do
            pads[index] = vote.readPad(state, index)
            if pads[index] and pads[index].active then active = true end
        end
            if active then
            local previous, complete = {}, true
                for index = 1, 3 do
                local pad = pads[index]
                previous[index] = {n = pad and pad.name or "", i = pad and pad.icon or ""}
                if previous[index].n == "" then complete = false end
            end
            if complete then state.cfg.last = previous end
            return pads, true
        end
        if type(state.cfg.last) ~= "table" then return pads, false end
            for index = 1, 3 do
            local previous = state.cfg.last[index]
            if type(previous) ~= "table" or type(previous.n) ~= "string" or previous.n == "" then continue end
            pads[index] = {active = true, idle = true, name = previous.n,
            icon = vote.icon(state, vote.key(previous.n)) or previous.i, mode = "", votes = 0}
        end
        return pads, false
    end
        function MapVote.status(state, active)
        local remaining = state.startT and math.max(0, math.ceil(15 - (state.context.environment.os.clock() - state.startT)))
        local suffix = active and remaining and "  •  " .. remaining .. "s" or ""
        if state.busy then return (state.status ~= "" and state.status or "Voting") .. "  " .. state.done .. "/" .. state.want .. suffix end
        if state.status ~= "" and state.idx and state.done > 0 then return state.status .. "  +" .. state.done .. suffix end
        if state.status ~= "" and state.idx and state.status ~= "Voting" then return state.status .. suffix end
        return active and "Voting" .. suffix or "Waiting for vote"
    end
        function MapVote.autoStart(state)
        if state.closed or state.autoRan or state.busy or state.cfg.auto ~= true then return end
        local vote, context = MapVote, state.context
        local clock = context.environment.os.clock
        local started, changedAt, previous = clock(), clock(), nil
            while clock() - started < 1.2 do
            local signature, identified = "", 0
                for index = 1, 3 do
                local pad = vote.readPad(state, index)
                if not pad or not pad.active then continue end
                signature ..= "|" .. pad.icon
                if vote.keyForIcon(state, pad.icon) or pad.name ~= "" and pad.name ~= "MAP NAME" then identified += 1 end
            end
            if signature ~= previous then previous, changedAt = signature, clock() end
            if identified >= 3 and clock() - changedAt >= 0.12 then break end
            context.runService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
        if state.closed or state.autoRan or state.busy or state.cfg.auto ~= true then return end
        local pads, active = vote.snapshot(state)
        if not active then return end
        state.autoRan = true
            for index = 1, 3 do
            local pad = pads[index]
            if pad and pad.active and not vote.keyForIcon(state, pad.icon) then vote.discover(state, pad.name, nil, clock()) end
        end
        local selected = vote.choose(state, pads)
        if selected then state.sel = selected; vote.start(state, selected) end
    end
        function MapVote.observe(state)
        local vote = MapVote
        local now = state.context.environment.os.clock()
        local pads, active = vote.snapshot(state)
            if active then
            local leadingVotes, leadingKey
                for index = 1, 3 do
                local pad = pads[index]
                if not pad or not pad.active then continue end
                if pad.name ~= "" then vote.discover(state, pad.name, pad.icon, now) end
                    if leadingVotes == nil or pad.votes > leadingVotes then
                    leadingVotes, leadingKey = pad.votes, vote.keyForIcon(state, pad.icon) or vote.key(pad.name)
                end
            end
            if leadingKey and leadingKey ~= "" then state.lead = leadingKey end
                if not state.wasActive then
                state.startT = now
                if not state.busy then state.idx, state.done, state.status = nil, 0, "" end
            end
                if state.cfg.auto == true and not state.autoRan and not state.busy and not state.autoPending then
                state.autoPending = true
                    state.context.environment.task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(vote.autoStart, state)
                    state.autoPending = false
                end)
            end
        end
            if not active and state.wasActive then
                if state.lead then
                state.lastWin = {k = state.lead, t = now}
                vote.record(state, "win " .. state.lead)
            end
            state.lead, state.startT, state.autoRan = nil, nil, false
        end
        state.wasActive = active
        return pads, active
    end
    local state = MapVote.create(context)
    NoirGenv().__NoirMapVoteState = state
    local cfg = state.cfg
    local tab = CORE.host.CreateTab()
    local cardsSec = tab:AddSection("MAP • Vote Duper", "выбор карты в лобби")
    local ctrlSec = tab:AddSection("MAP • Vote Controls", "auto / dupe / экранный HUD")
    -- AddSection does not expose its content holder (the section api object
    -- has no such field), so get it through a temporary label row: AddLabel
    -- returns { Instance = row } and row is parented to the holder.
        local function sectionHolder(section)
        if not section or type(section.AddLabel) ~= "function" then return nil end
        local anchor = section:AddLabel(" ")
        local holder = anchor and anchor.Instance and anchor.Instance.Parent or nil
        return holder
    end
    local cardsParent = sectionHolder(cardsSec)
    local ctrlParent = sectionHolder(ctrlSec)
    if not cardsParent or not ctrlParent then return end
    local MapContainer = New("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = cardsParent })
    local cards = {}
        for i = 1, 3 do
        local xOffset = (i - 1) * 0.33 + 0.01
        local btn = New("TextButton", { Size = UDim2.new(0.31, 0, 0, 120), Position = UDim2.new(xOffset, 0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = CPal.card, BackgroundTransparency = .35, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, Parent = MapContainer })
        corner(btn, 8)
        local st = stroke(btn, CPal.border, .55)
        local imgFrame = New("Frame", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 58), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5),
        BackgroundColor3 = CPal.off, BackgroundTransparency = .3, ClipsDescendants = true, Parent = btn })
        corner(imgFrame, 6)
        local img = New("ImageLabel", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, Parent = imgFrame })
        local nm = New("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 24), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 66),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "map " .. i, TextColor3 = CPal.text, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11, TextWrapped = true, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, Parent = btn })
        local vt = New("TextLabel", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16), Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -20),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "votes: -", TextColor3 = CPal.dim, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 10, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Parent = btn })
            btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.16), { BackgroundTransparency = .14 }):Play()
        end)
            btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(.18), { BackgroundTransparency = .35 }):Play()
        end)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state.sel = i
            local pads = state.lastPads
            local pad = pads and pads[i]
            if pad and pad.active then MapVote.start(state, i) end
        end)
        cards[i] = { st = st, img = img, nm = nm, vt = vt }
    end
    local statusRow = New("Frame", { Parent = ctrlParent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = -100 })
    local stLbl = text(statusRow, "status: waiting for vote", 13, UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), true)
    stLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    stLbl.TextTransparency = .2
    stLbl.TextColor3 = CPal.accent2
    -- ===== on-screen HUD: pick a map and vote without opening the menu =====
    local hud = { enabled = false, gui = nil, cards = {}, statusLbl = nil, voteBtn = nil }
    local UISvc = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local function hudDestroy()
        if hud.gui then pcall(function() hud.gui:Destroy() end) end
        hud.gui = nil; hud.cards = {}; hud.statusLbl = nil; hud.voteBtn = nil
    end
        local function hudVote()
            if state.busy then
            state.stop = true
            return
        end
        local pad = MapVote.readPad(state, state.sel or 1)
            if not pad or not pad.active then
            mvNotify("no active vote pad")
            return
        end
        MapVote.start(state, state.sel or 1)
    end
        local function hudBuild()
        hudDestroy()
        local parent = guiParent
            if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then
            parent = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
        end
        if not parent then return end
        local sg = New("ScreenGui", { Name = "NoirMapVoteHUD", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true,
        DisplayOrder = 85, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Parent = parent })

        pcall(function() pos = NoirPersistence.GetPosition("mapvote_hud_v1", nil) end)

        BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = 80 })
        corner(root, 14); stroke(root, CPal.border, 0.35)
        local grip = New("Frame", { Parent = root, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Active = true, ZIndex = 90 })

        ttl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        ttl.ZIndex = 81
        hud.statusLbl = text(root, "waiting for vote", 11, UDim2.fromOffset(104, 8), true)
        hud.statusLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 13)
        hud.statusLbl.ZIndex = 81
        local row = New("Frame", { Parent = root, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 30), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 84), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 81 })
            for i = 1, 3 do
            local cb = New("TextButton", { Parent = row, Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 3, 2, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = CPal.card, BackgroundTransparency = .25, Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 82 })
            corner(cb, 10)
            local cst = stroke(cb, CPal.border, .55)
            local cimg = New("ImageLabel", { Parent = cb, Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 44),
            BackgroundColor3 = CPal.off, BackgroundTransparency = .35, Image = "", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop, ZIndex = 83 })
            corner(cimg, 8)
            local cnm = New("TextLabel", { Parent = cb, Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 50), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 16),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "map " .. i, TextColor3 = CPal.text, TextSize = 11, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 83 })
            local cvt = New("TextLabel", { Parent = cb, Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 66), Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 14),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "votes: -", TextColor3 = CPal.dim, TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 83 })

                if pad and pad.active then MapVote.start(state, i) end
            end
            cb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(pickCard)

        Text = "Vote Now", TextColor3 = CPal.base, TextSize = 13, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 82 })

        local dragging, dStart, dPos, dInput = false, nil, nil, nil
            grip.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, dStart, dPos = true, input.Position, root.Position
            end
        end)
            grip.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dInput = input end
        end)
            UISvc.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input ~= dInput then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dStart
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
            local x = math.clamp(dPos.X.Offset + delta.X, -vp.X * 0.5 + 40, vp.X * 0.5 - 40)
            local y = math.clamp(dPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y, 0, vp.Y - 60)
            root.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
        end)
            UISvc.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
                pcall(function() NoirPersistence.SetPosition("mapvote_hud_v1", root.Position) end)
            end
        end)
        hud.gui = sg
        return sg
    end
        ctrlSec:AddToggle("Display on Screen", function(v)
        hud.enabled = v == true
        if hud.enabled then pcall(hudBuild) else hudDestroy() end
    end)
        ctrlSec:AddToggle("Auto Dupe", function(v)
        cfg.auto = v == true
        if cfg.auto then cfg.autoRan = false; state.autoRan = false end
    end)

        cfg.silent = v ~= false
    end)

        local pad = MapVote.readPad(state, state.sel or 1)
        local ch = LP.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if pad and pad.active and hrp then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pad.detector.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0))
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            mvNotify("tp to slot " .. tostring(state.sel or 1))
        else
            mvNotify("no active vote pad")
        end
    end)
    local otherCodes = { skip = "Don't dupe", leading = "Dupe most voted", first = "Dupe first map" }
    local otherLabels, otherToCode = {}, {}
        for _, name in ipairs({ "Don't dupe", "Dupe most voted", "Dupe first map" }) do
        otherLabels[#otherLabels + 1] = name
    end
    for code, label in pairs(otherCodes) do otherToCode[label] = code end
        ctrlSec:AddDropdown("Other Maps", otherLabels, function(value)
        local code = otherToCode[value]
        if code then cfg.fallback = code end
    end)
    local mapLabels, mapLabelToKey = { "All" }, { All = false }
        for _, map in ipairs(MapVote.maps) do
        mapLabels[#mapLabels + 1] = map.name
        mapLabelToKey[map.name] = map.key
    end
        ctrlSec:AddDropdown("Preferred Map", mapLabels, function(value)
        local key = type(value) == "string" and mapLabelToKey[value] or nil
        local order = {}
            if key then
            order[1] = key
                for _, map in ipairs(state.mapList) do
                if map.key ~= key then order[#order + 1] = map.key end
            end
        else
            for _, map in ipairs(state.mapList) do order[#order + 1] = map.key end
        end
        cfg.order = order
    end)
        local function renderMenu()
        local pads = state.lastPads or {}
        local st = MapVote.status(state, state.lastActive)
            for i = 1, 3 do
            local pad = pads[i]
            local activePad = pad and pad.active
            local label = activePad and ((pad.name ~= "" and pad.name) or ("map " .. i)) or ("map " .. i)
            local votes = activePad and not pad.idle and ("votes: " .. tostring(pad.votes)) or "votes: -"
            local icon = activePad and (pad.icon or "") or ""
            local c = cards[i]
                if c then
                c.img.Image = icon
                c.nm.Text = activePad and label or (label .. " (waiting)")
                c.vt.Text = votes
                c.st.Color = (state.sel == i) and CPal.accent or CPal.border
                c.st.Transparency = (state.sel == i) and .05 or .55
            end
            local hc = hud.cards[i]
                if hc then
                hc.img.Image = icon
                hc.nm.Text = label
                hc.vt.Text = votes
                hc.st.Color = (state.sel == i) and CPal.accent or CPal.border
                hc.st.Transparency = (state.sel == i) and .05 or .55
            end
        end
        if stLbl then stLbl.Text = "status: " .. st end
        if hud.statusLbl then hud.statusLbl.Text = st end
            if hud.voteBtn then
            hud.voteBtn.Text = state.busy
            and ("Voting " .. tostring(state.done or 0) .. "/" .. tostring(state.want or 0) .. " …") or "Vote Now"
        end
    end
        task.spawn(function()
        local lastObservation = -math.huge
        local padsNow, activeNow = {}, false
            while mvAlive() do
                pcall(function()
                local now = os.clock()
                    if now - lastObservation >= 0.25 then
                    padsNow, activeNow = MapVote.observe(state)
                    state.lastPads, state.lastActive = padsNow, activeNow
                    lastObservation = now
                end
                renderMenu()
            end)
            task.wait(0.1)
        end
    end)
end)
    if not __mvOk then
    -- silent: keep the hub alive; store the reason for diagnostics
    NoirGenv().__NoirMapVoteError = tostring(__mvErr)
end
end
-- NOIR V6: report the hub state to the loader handshake. The guard starts as
-- "starting" (duplicate-launch protection); once the whole build is up it
-- flips to "running" with a heartbeat, so the loader closes immediately and
-- the duplicate-launch check stays accurate for later launches.
do
    if __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD then
    __NOIR_GUARD.state = "running"
    __NOIR_GUARD.heartbeat = os.clock()
        task.spawn(function()
            while __NOIR_SHARED[__NOIR_GUARD_KEY] == __NOIR_GUARD
            and __NOIR_GUARD.state == "running" do
            __NOIR_GUARD.heartbeat = os.clock()
            task.wait(5)
        end
    end)
end
end

local __noirVisualSource = nil  -- [INLINED] original string literal moved into do-end block below
-- [INLINED SATELLITE MODULE] __noirVisualSource
-- This code was originally embedded as a string and compiled
-- at runtime via loadstring(). It is now inlined as a do-end
-- block, which is semantically equivalent.
do
    -- Visuals run in a deferred satellite chunk.  Updates are event-driven so ESP does not rescan Workspace each fraction of a second.
    local V = NoirGenv().__NoirV4VisualContext
    if type(V) ~= "table" or not V.tab then return end
    local state = {
    revision = 0, playersDirty = true,
    feature = {
    cham = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    esp = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    outline = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    highlight = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    tracer = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    box = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    avatar = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    fire = {everyone=false,murderer=false,sheriff=false,hero=false,dead=false},
    },
    object = {gun=false,knife=false},
    }
    local entries, objectEntries, thumbnailCache, thumbnailPending = {}, {}, {}, {}
    local joinedLobby, roleRevealActive, drawingState, tracerCount = {}, false, nil, 0
    local prefix = "NoirSatelliteVisual_"
        local function safe(label, callback)
        local ok, err = pcall(callback)
        if not ok then warn("[Noir Visuals] " .. tostring(label) .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end
        return ok
    end
        local function markPlayersDirty()
        state.playersDirty = true
    end
    if V.roleBus and V.roleBus.Subscribe then V.roleBus:Subscribe(markPlayersDirty) end
    -- MM2 can finish assigning roles a moment after the UI appears. Requests are coalesced by the main scanner.
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, pause in ipairs({0, .7, 1.8}) do
            if pause > 0 then task.wait(pause) end
            if V.refreshRoles then V.refreshRoles(false) end
        end
    end)
        local function color(role)
        if role == "murderer" then return Color3.fromRGB(255,72,82) end
        if role == "sheriff" then return Color3.fromRGB(72,158,255) end
        if role == "hero" then return Color3.fromRGB(255,206,72) end
        if role == "dead" then return Color3.fromRGB(150,150,158) end
        return Color3.fromRGB(86,230,145)
    end
        local function isInactive(player, character, cached)
        if cached == "dead" or joinedLobby[player] then return true end
        local round = V.getRoundState and V.getRoundState() or "waiting"
        if round == "waiting" and not (V.isRoleRevealActive and V.isRoleRevealActive()) then return true end
        local teamName = player.Team and string.lower(tostring(player.Team.Name)) or ""
        if string.find(teamName,"lobby",1,true) or string.find(teamName,"spectat",1,true) or string.find(teamName,"waiting",1,true) or string.find(teamName,"observer",1,true) then return true end
            for _, container in ipairs({player, character}) do
                if container then
                    for key, value in pairs(container:GetAttributes()) do
                    local name = string.lower(tostring(key))
                    if (string.find(name,"inround",1,true) or string.find(name,"ingame",1,true) or string.find(name,"isplaying",1,true) or string.find(name,"alive",1,true)) and value == false then return true end
                        if string.find(name,"state",1,true) or string.find(name,"status",1,true) or string.find(name,"location",1,true) then
                        local text = string.lower(tostring(value))
                        if string.find(text,"lobby",1,true) or string.find(text,"spectat",1,true) or string.find(text,"dead",1,true) or string.find(text,"waiting",1,true) then return true end
                    end
                end
                    for _, name in ipairs({"InLobby","Spectating","Dead","IsDead"}) do
                    local flag = container:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if flag and flag:IsA("BoolValue") and flag.Value then return true end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end
        local function roleOf(player, character)
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        local cached = V.roleCache and V.roleCache[player.UserId]
        if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or isInactive(player, character, cached) then return "dead" end
        if player == V.getMurderer() or cached == "murderer" then return "murderer" end
        if player == V.getSheriff() or cached == "sheriff" then return "sheriff" end
        if player == V.getHero() or cached == "hero" then return "hero" end
        return "innocent"
    end
        local function wanted(kind, role)
        local filters = state.feature[kind]
        return filters and (filters.everyone or filters[role]) or false
    end
        local function anyPlayerVisual()
        for _, filters in pairs(state.feature) do for _, enabled in pairs(filters) do if enabled then return true end end end
        return false
    end
        local function clearPlayer(player)
        local entry = entries[player]
        if not entry then return end
        if entry.line then tracerCount = math.max(0, tracerCount - 1); pcall(function() entry.line:Remove() end) end
        for _, item in ipairs(entry.items) do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end
        entries[player] = nil
    end
        local function addHighlight(character, suffix, tint, fill, outline, entry)
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
        h.Name, h.Adornee, h.DepthMode = prefix .. suffix, character, Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        h.FillColor, h.OutlineColor, h.FillTransparency, h.OutlineTransparency, h.Parent = tint, tint, fill, outline, character
        table.insert(entry.items, h)
    end
        local function billboard(root, suffix, size, offset, entry)
        local b = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        b.Name, b.Adornee, b.AlwaysOnTop, b.Size, b.StudsOffset, b.Parent = prefix .. suffix, root, true, size, offset, root
        table.insert(entry.items, b)
        return b
    end
        local function loadAvatar(player, image)
        local cached = thumbnailCache[player.UserId]
        if cached then image.Image = cached; return end
        if thumbnailPending[player.UserId] then return end
        thumbnailPending[player.UserId] = true
            task.spawn(function()
            local ok, asset = pcall(function() return V.players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(player.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150) end)
            thumbnailPending[player.UserId] = nil
                if ok and asset then
                thumbnailCache[player.UserId] = asset
                if image.Parent then image.Image = asset end
            end
        end)
    end
        local function apply(player, enabled)
        if player == V.localPlayer then return end
        local character = player.Character
        if not character then clearPlayer(player); return end
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        local role = roleOf(player, character)
        local sign = tostring(state.revision) .. ":" .. role .. ":" .. tostring(root)
        local old = entries[player]
        if old and old.character == character and old.sign == sign then return end
        clearPlayer(player)
        if not enabled then return end
        local tint = color(role)
        local entry = {character=character, root=root, sign=sign, tint=tint, items={}, line=nil}
        entries[player] = entry
        if wanted("cham",role) then addHighlight(character,"Cham",tint,.45,1,entry) end
        if wanted("outline",role) then addHighlight(character,"Outline",tint,1,0,entry) end
        if wanted("highlight",role) then addHighlight(character,"Highlight",tint,.68,.05,entry) end
            if wanted("tracer",role) then
                if drawingState == nil then
                local ok, api = pcall(function() return Drawing end)
                drawingState = ok and type(api) == "table" and type(api.new) == "function" and api or false
            end
                if drawingState then
                local line = drawingState.new("Line")
                line.Thickness, line.Transparency, line.Color, line.Visible = 1.5, 1, tint, false
                entry.line, tracerCount = line, tracerCount + 1
            end
        end
            if root and wanted("esp",role) then
            local b = billboard(root,"ESP",UDim2.fromOffset(156,42),Vector3.new(0,3.4,0),entry)
            local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            l.Size, l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Font, l.TextSize = UDim2.fromScale(1,1), 1, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, 14
            l.TextColor3, l.TextStrokeTransparency, l.Text, l.Parent = Color3.new(1,1,1), .35, player.DisplayName .. "\n" .. string.upper(role), b
        end
            if root and wanted("box",role) then
            local b = billboard(root,"Box",UDim2.fromOffset(86,122),Vector3.new(0,1.8,0),entry)
            local f = Instance.new("Frame")
            f.Size, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.Parent = UDim2.fromScale(1,1), 1, b
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness, stroke.Parent = tint, 1.7, f
        end
            if root and wanted("avatar",role) then
            local b = billboard(root,"Avatar",UDim2.fromOffset(58,58),Vector3.new(0,4.8,0),entry)
            local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            image.Size, image.BackgroundColor3, image.BorderSizePixel, image.Parent = UDim2.fromScale(1,1), Color3.fromRGB(12,14,18), 0, b
            local corner = Instance.new("UICorner"); corner.CornerRadius, corner.Parent = UDim.new(1,0), image
            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke"); stroke.Color, stroke.Thickness, stroke.Parent = tint, 1.5, image
            loadAvatar(player, image)
        end
            if root and wanted("fire",role) then
            local flame = Instance.new("Fire")
            flame.Name, flame.Color, flame.SecondaryColor, flame.Size, flame.Heat, flame.Parent = prefix.."Fire", tint, tint:Lerp(Color3.new(1,1,1),.35), 5, 7, root
            table.insert(entry.items, flame)
        end
    end
        local function refreshPlayers()
        local enabled, seen = anyPlayerVisual(), {}
        for _, player in ipairs(V.getPlayers()) do if player ~= V.localPlayer then seen[player] = true; apply(player, enabled) end end
        for player in pairs(entries) do if not seen[player] then clearPlayer(player) end end
        state.playersDirty = false
    end
        local function objectType(instance)
        if not instance:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
        local owner = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if owner and V.players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(owner) then return nil end
        local name = string.lower(instance.Name)
        if name == "gundrop" or name == "gun" or string.find(name,"droppedgun",1,true) or string.find(name,"gun_drop",1,true) then return "gun" end
        if string.find(name,"throw",1,true) and string.find(name,"knife",1,true) then return "knife" end
    end
        local function clearObject(instance)
        local entry = objectEntries[instance]
        if entry then for _, item in ipairs(entry) do pcall(function() item:Destroy() end) end; objectEntries[instance] = nil end
    end
        local function trackObject(instance)
        local kind = objectType(instance)
            if not kind or not state.object[kind] then
            if objectEntries[instance] then clearObject(instance) end
            return
        end
        if objectEntries[instance] then return end
        local tint = kind == "gun" and Color3.fromRGB(72,158,255) or Color3.fromRGB(255,126,72)
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
        h.Name, h.Adornee, h.DepthMode = prefix.."Object", instance, Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        h.FillColor, h.OutlineColor, h.FillTransparency, h.OutlineTransparency, h.Parent = tint, tint, .72, 0, instance
        local b = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        b.Name, b.Adornee, b.AlwaysOnTop, b.Size, b.StudsOffset, b.Parent = prefix.."ObjectLabel", instance, true, UDim2.fromOffset(132,24), Vector3.new(0,1.5,0), instance
        local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        l.Size, l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Font, l.TextSize, l.TextColor3, l.TextStrokeTransparency, l.Text, l.Parent = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),1,Enum.Font.GothamBold,12,tint,.35,(kind=="gun" and "DROPPED GUN" or "THROWING KNIFE"),b
        objectEntries[instance] = {h,b}
    end
        local function refreshObjects(fullScan)
        if fullScan and (state.object.gun or state.object.knife) then for _, instance in ipairs(V.workspace:GetDescendants()) do trackObject(instance) end end
            for instance in pairs(objectEntries) do
            local kind = instance.Parent and objectType(instance)
            if not kind or not state.object[kind] then clearObject(instance) end
        end
    end
        local function setFilter(kind, filter, enabled)
        state.feature[kind][filter] = enabled == true
        state.revision, state.playersDirty = state.revision + 1, true
        safe("player refresh", refreshPlayers)
    end
    local objectAddedConnection, objectRemovingConnection
        local function updateObjectConnections()
        local enabled = state.object.gun or state.object.knife
            if enabled then
                if not objectAddedConnection then
                    objectAddedConnection = V.workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(instance)
                    if state.object.gun or state.object.knife then task.defer(trackObject, instance) end
                end)
            end
                if not objectRemovingConnection then
                    objectRemovingConnection = V.workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(instance)
                    if objectEntries[instance] then clearObject(instance) end
                end)
            end
        else
            if objectAddedConnection then objectAddedConnection:Disconnect(); objectAddedConnection = nil end
            if objectRemovingConnection then objectRemovingConnection:Disconnect(); objectRemovingConnection = nil end
        end
    end
        local function setObject(kind, enabled)
        state.object[kind] = enabled == true
        updateObjectConnections()
        safe("object refresh", function() refreshObjects(true) end)
    end
    local tracerElapsed = 0
        V.runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if tracerCount <= 0 then tracerElapsed = 0; return end
        tracerElapsed += dt
        if tracerElapsed < (1 / 30) then return end
        tracerElapsed = 0
        local camera = V.workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then return end
        local viewport, origin = camera.ViewportSize, Vector2.new(camera.ViewportSize.X*.5,camera.ViewportSize.Y)
            for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
            local line, root = entry.line, entry.root
                if line then
                    if root and root.Parent and root:IsDescendantOf(entry.character) then
                    local point, visible = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                    line.From, line.To, line.Color, line.Visible = origin, Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y), entry.tint, visible and point.Z > 0
                else line.Visible = false end
            end
        end
    end)
        local function watchCharacter(player, character)
        markPlayersDirty()
            task.defer(function()
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then humanoid.Died:Connect(markPlayersDirty) end
        end)
    end
        for _, player in ipairs(V.getPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then watchCharacter(player, player.Character) end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) watchCharacter(player, character) end)
    end
        V.players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        if V.isRoleRevealActive and V.isRoleRevealActive() then joinedLobby[player] = true end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) watchCharacter(player, character) end)
        markPlayersDirty()
    end)
        V.players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        joinedLobby[player] = nil
        clearPlayer(player)
    end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while V.isRunning() do
            local revealing = V.isRoleRevealActive and V.isRoleRevealActive() or false
            if revealing and not roleRevealActive then table.clear(joinedLobby); markPlayersDirty() end
            if revealing ~= roleRevealActive then markPlayersDirty() end
            roleRevealActive = revealing
            -- Event changes refresh immediately; this slow fallback covers unusual maps that do not signal character state changes.
            if state.playersDirty or anyPlayerVisual() then safe("player update", refreshPlayers) end
            if next(objectEntries) then safe("object cleanup", function() refreshObjects(false) end) end
            task.wait(1)
        end
        if objectAddedConnection then pcall(function() objectAddedConnection:Disconnect() end); objectAddedConnection = nil end
        if objectRemovingConnection then pcall(function() objectRemovingConnection:Disconnect() end); objectRemovingConnection = nil end
        for instance in pairs(objectEntries) do clearObject(instance) end
    end)
    local filters = {{"Everyone","everyone"},{"Murderer Only","murderer"},{"Sheriff Only","sheriff"},{"Hero Only","hero"},{"Dead Only","dead"}}
        for _, definition in ipairs({{"CHAM","cham"},{"ESP","esp"},{"OUTLINE","outline"},{"HIGHLIGHT","highlight"},{"TRACER","tracer"},{"ESP BOX","box"},{"ESP AVATAR","avatar"},{"ESP FIRE","fire"}}) do
        local title, kind = definition[1], definition[2]
        local section = V.tab:AddSection("VISUAL u{2022} "..title,"BY PLAYER")
            for _, filterDefinition in ipairs(filters) do
            local label, filter = filterDefinition[1], filterDefinition[2]
            section:AddToggle(label,function(enabled) safe("toggle",function() setFilter(kind,filter,enabled) end) end)
        end
    end
    local objects = V.tab:AddSection("VISUAL u{2022} BY OBJECT","Object ESP")
    objects:AddToggle("Dropped Gun",function(enabled) safe("object toggle",function() setObject("gun",enabled) end) end)
    objects:AddToggle("Throwing Knives",function(enabled) safe("object toggle",function() setObject("knife",enabled) end) end)

end

NoirGenv().__NoirMovementContext = {
tab = tab, players = Players, uis = UIS, runService = RunService, workspace = Workspace,
localPlayer = LocalPlayer, persistence = NoirPersistence, guiParent = guiParent, coreGui = CoreGui,
isPrimaryPress = isPrimaryPress, gradientStrokes = gradientStrokes,
}
-- [INLINED SATELLITE MODULE] __noirMovementSource
-- This code was originally embedded as a string and compiled
-- at runtime via loadstring(). It is now inlined as a do-end
-- block, which is semantically equivalent.
do
    -- Noclip and Fly run in an isolated module to avoid the mobile Luau register limit in the main loader.
    local M = NoirGenv().__NoirMovementContext
    if type(M) ~= "table" then for _ = 1, 40 do task.wait(0.1); M = NoirGenv().__NoirMovementContext; if type(M) == "table" then break end end end
    if type(M) ~= "table" or not M.tab or not M.persistence then return end
    local Players, UIS, RunService, Workspace = M.players, M.uis, M.runService, M.workspace
    local LocalPlayer, Persistence = M.localPlayer, M.persistence
    local state = {
    noclip = false, noclipOriginals = {},
    fly = false, flyVelocity = nil, flyGyro = nil, flyConnection = nil,
    flyHumanoid = nil, flyAutoRotate = true, flyPlatformStand = false,
    flyStateEnabled = {}, flyAnimate = nil, flyAnimateDisabled = false,
    flySpeed = 48,
    }
    -- Uses the supplied universal-fly method: PlatformStand plus BodyGyro/BodyVelocity
    -- on UpperTorso (R15) or Torso (R6), with Humanoid:TranslateBy movement.
    local FLY_STATES = {
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, Enum.HumanoidStateType.StrafingNoPhysics,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming,
    }
        local function applyNoclip()
        if not state.noclip then return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return end
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if state.noclipOriginals[part] == nil then state.noclipOriginals[part] = part.CanCollide end
                if part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
        local function restoreNoclip()
            for part, original in pairs(state.noclipOriginals) do
            if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = original end) end
        end
        table.clear(state.noclipOriginals)
    end
        local function setNoclip(enabled)
        state.noclip = enabled == true
        if state.noclip then applyNoclip() else restoreNoclip() end
    end
    RunService.Stepped:Connect(function() if state.noclip then applyNoclip() end end)
        local function restoreFlyCharacter()
        local humanoid = state.flyHumanoid
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
            humanoid.AutoRotate = state.flyAutoRotate
            humanoid.PlatformStand = state.flyPlatformStand
                for _, stateType in ipairs(FLY_STATES) do
                local wasEnabled = state.flyStateEnabled[stateType.Name]
                if wasEnabled ~= nil then pcall(function() humanoid:SetStateEnabled(stateType, wasEnabled) end) end
            end
                if not state.flyPlatformStand then
                pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
                    task.delay(.08, function()
                    if humanoid.Parent and not state.fly then pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end) end
                end)
            else
                pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            end
        end
        if state.flyAnimate and state.flyAnimate.Parent then state.flyAnimate.Disabled = state.flyAnimateDisabled end
        state.flyHumanoid, state.flyAnimate = nil, nil
        table.clear(state.flyStateEnabled)
    end
        local function stopFly()
        if state.flyConnection then state.flyConnection:Disconnect(); state.flyConnection = nil end
        if state.flyVelocity then state.flyVelocity:Destroy(); state.flyVelocity = nil end
        if state.flyGyro then state.flyGyro:Destroy(); state.flyGyro = nil end
        restoreFlyCharacter()
    end
        local function startFly()
        stopFly()
        if not state.fly then return end
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        -- The linked script handles R15 UpperTorso and R6 Torso.  HumanoidRootPart is used here
        -- for the constraints because it prevents the torso/root physics fight that causes shaking.
        local sourceTorso = character and (character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        if not (humanoid and root and (sourceTorso or root)) then return end
        -- Keep the source's BodyVelocity flight core, but leave Roblox's humanoid states and animation system intact.
        -- Disabling them (and forcing a BodyGyro at the camera angle) is what caused the visible body rocking.
        state.flyHumanoid, state.flyAutoRotate, state.flyPlatformStand = humanoid, humanoid.AutoRotate, humanoid.PlatformStand
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        -- PlatformStand is needed for a Humanoid avatar to physically pitch with the camera.
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
        pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
        -- Full 3D camera orientation: use the linked Fly's high-response gyro settings for quick camera following.
        local gyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        gyro.Name, gyro.P, gyro.D, gyro.MaxTorque, gyro.CFrame = "NoirFlyGyro", 9e4, 800, Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9), root.CFrame
        gyro.Parent = root
        local velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        velocity.Name, velocity.P, velocity.Velocity, velocity.MaxForce = "NoirFlyVelocity", 12000, Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        velocity.Parent = root
        state.flyVelocity, state.flyGyro = velocity, gyro
            state.flyConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not state.fly or not (character.Parent and humanoid.Parent and root.Parent and velocity.Parent and gyro.Parent) then return end
            local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not camera then return end
            -- Mobile joystick flight: push forward/back while aiming the camera up or down to rise/descend.
            -- MoveDirection supplies the joystick vector; projecting it on the camera's flat axes preserves its intent.
            local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
            local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
            gyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + look)
            local input = humanoid.MoveDirection
            local desiredVelocity = Vector3.zero
                if input.Magnitude > .001 then
                local forwardInput = flatLook.Magnitude > .001 and input:Dot(flatLook.Unit) or 0
                local sideInput = flatRight.Magnitude > .001 and input:Dot(flatRight.Unit) or 0
                local flightDirection = look * forwardInput + right * sideInput
                if flightDirection.Magnitude > .001 then desiredVelocity = flightDirection.Unit * state.flySpeed end
            end
            velocity.Velocity = desiredVelocity
        end)
    end
        local function setFly(enabled)
        state.fly = enabled == true
        if state.fly then startFly() else stopFly() end
    end
    local binds = {
    noclip = { text="Noclip", key="noclip_bind_v1", default=UDim2.new(.38,0,.88,0), size=.105, enabled=false, gui=nil, button=nil, connections={} },
    fly = { text="Fly", key="fly_bind_v1", default=UDim2.new(.52,0,.88,0), size=.105, enabled=false, gui=nil, button=nil, connections={} },
    }
        local function disconnect(bind)
        for _, connection in ipairs(bind.connections) do pcall(function() connection:Disconnect() end) end
        table.clear(bind.connections)
    end
        local function updateSize(bind)
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not (bind.button and camera) then return end
        local screen = camera.ViewportSize
        bind.button.Size = UDim2.new(bind.size * (screen.Y / math.max(screen.X,1)),0,bind.size,0)
    end
        local function updateText(bind, active)
        local label = bind.button and bind.button:FindFirstChild("Text")
        if label then label.Text = bind.text .. "\n" .. (active and "ON" or "OFF") end
    end
        local function removeBind(bind)
        disconnect(bind)
        if bind.gui then bind.gui:Destroy() end
        bind.gui, bind.button = nil, nil
            for _, parent in ipairs({M.guiParent, M.coreGui, LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")}) do
                if typeof(parent) == "Instance" then
                local old = parent:FindFirstChild("Noir" .. bind.text .. "BindButton")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
            end
        end
    end
        local function createBind(bind, isActive, setActive)
        if bind.button then return end
        removeBind(bind)
        local parent = M.guiParent
        if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
        local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        screenGui.Name, screenGui.ResetOnSpawn, screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset, screenGui.DisplayOrder = "Noir" .. bind.text .. "BindButton", false, true, 82
        screenGui.Parent = parent
        local button = Instance.new("ImageButton")
        button.Name, button.AnchorPoint = bind.text, Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        button.Position = Persistence.GetPosition(bind.key,bind.default)
        -- CYBER HUD v7 body
        button.BackgroundColor3, button.BackgroundTransparency, button.BorderSizePixel, button.Image, button.AutoButtonColor, button.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(6,18,25),.16,0,"",false,5
        button.Parent = screenGui
        local circle = Instance.new("UICorner"); circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0); circle.Parent = button
        local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint"); aspect.AspectRatio = 1; aspect.Parent = button
        -- CYBER HUD v7: Ð½ÐµÐ¾Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÐºÐ¾Ð»ÑÑÐ¾ + Ð³Ð°Ð»Ð¾ + ÑÐµÑÐ¸ÐºÐ»-ÑÐ¸ÐºÐ¸
        local gradient
        do
        local applied = false
            pcall(function()
            local cyber = NoirGenv and NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD or nil
                if cyber and type(cyber.apply) == "function" then
                local okFx, fx = pcall(cyber.apply, button, { round = true, tickMarks = true, autoRotate = false })
                if okFx and fx and fx.outer then gradient = fx.outer; applied = true end
            end
        end)
            if not applied then
            local outer = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            outer.Color, outer.Thickness, outer.Transparency, outer.ApplyStrokeMode, outer.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(38,240,228), 2.4, .08, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, button
            gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
            gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(10,60,66)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,Color3.fromRGB(38,240,228)),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(10,60,66))})
            gradient.Parent = outer
            local halo = Instance.new("UIStroke")
            halo.Color, halo.Transparency, halo.Thickness, halo.ApplyStrokeMode, halo.Parent = Color3.fromRGB(38,240,228), .88, 7, Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border, button
        end
    end
    local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name,label.AnchorPoint,label.Position,label.Size="Text",Vector2.new(.5,.5),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),UDim2.fromScale(.76,.76)
    label.BackgroundTransparency,label.TextColor3,label.TextSize,label.TextWrapped,label.Font,label.ZIndex=1,Color3.fromRGB(245,245,248),14,true,Enum.Font.Gotham,6
    label.Parent=button
    local dragging,moved,dragStart,startPosition,dragInput=false,false,nil,nil,nil
        bind.connections[#bind.connections+1]=button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if not M.isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
        dragging,moved,dragStart,startPosition=true,false,input.Position,button.Position
    end)
        bind.connections[#bind.connections+1]=button.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragInput=input end
    end)
        bind.connections[#bind.connections+1]=UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging or input~=dragInput then return end
        local delta=input.Position-dragStart
        if delta.Magnitude>7 then moved=true end
        button.Position=UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale,startPosition.X.Offset+delta.X,startPosition.Y.Scale,startPosition.Y.Offset+delta.Y)
    end)
        bind.connections[#bind.connections+1]=UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging or not M.isPrimaryPress(input) then return end
        dragging=false
        Persistence.SetPosition(bind.key,button.Position)
    end)
    bind.connections[#bind.connections+1]=button.Activated:Connect(function() if not moved then setActive(not isActive()) end end)
    -- v8: кольцо уже вращается через NoirCyberHUD._register, двойное вращение не нужно
    bind.gui,bind.button=screenGui,button
    updateSize(bind);updateText(bind,isActive())
    end
        local function setBind(bind, enabled, isActive, setActive)
        bind.enabled=enabled==true
        if bind.enabled then createBind(bind,isActive,setActive) else removeBind(bind) end
    end
    local function syncNoclipText() updateText(binds.noclip,state.noclip) end
    local function syncFlyText() updateText(binds.fly,state.fly) end
    local noclipSection=M.tab:AddSection("MAIN u{2022} NOCLIP","Walk through local collision")
    noclipSection:AddToggle("Noclip",function(enabled) setNoclip(enabled);syncNoclipText() end)
        noclipSection:AddToggle("Enable Noclip Bind Button",function(enabled)
        setBind(binds.noclip,enabled,function() return state.noclip end,function(active) setNoclip(active);syncNoclipText() end)
    end)
    noclipSection:AddSlider("Noclip Bind Button Size",5,25,binds.noclip.size*100,function(value) binds.noclip.size=(tonumber(value) or 10.5)/100;updateSize(binds.noclip) end)
    local flySection=M.tab:AddSection("MAIN u{2022} FLY","Camera-guided movement")
    flySection:AddToggle("Fly",function(enabled) setFly(enabled);syncFlyText() end)
        flySection:AddToggle("Enable Fly Bind Button",function(enabled)
        setBind(binds.fly,enabled,function() return state.fly end,function(active) setFly(active);syncFlyText() end)
    end)
    flySection:AddSlider("Fly Bind Button Size",5,25,binds.fly.size*100,function(value) binds.fly.size=(tonumber(value) or 10.5)/100;updateSize(binds.fly) end)
    flySection:AddSlider("Fly Speed",10,300,state.flySpeed,function(value) state.flySpeed=math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 48,10,300); NoirGenv().__NoirFlySpeed=state.flySpeed end)
    pcall(function() NoirGenv().__NoirFlySection=flySection; NoirGenv().__NoirSetFlySpeed=function(v) state.flySpeed=math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 48,10,300); NoirGenv().__NoirFlySpeed=state.flySpeed end end)
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(1)
        if state.noclip then table.clear(state.noclipOriginals);applyNoclip() end
        if state.fly then startFly() end
    end)

end

-- Speed Glitch satellite (isolated chunk, like Noclip/Fly). loadstring only
-- COMPILES; the returned function must be called (same as Noclip/Fly).
-- [INLINED SATELLITE MODULE] __noirSpeedGlitchSource
-- This code was originally embedded as a string and compiled
-- at runtime via loadstring(). It is now inlined as a do-end
-- block, which is semantically equivalent.
do
    -- Speed Glitch satellite module: ODH-style movement timing glitch with a
    -- floating Noir toggle button. Runs isolated (loadstring) like Noclip/Fly so
    -- the main chunk stays under the mobile Luau register cap.

        if type(M) ~= "table" or not M.tab or not M.persistence then
        warn("[Noir SpeedGlitch] context unavailable; section not created.")
        return
    end
    local Players, UIS, RunService, Workspace = M.players, M.uis, M.runService, M.workspace
    local LocalPlayer, Persistence = M.localPlayer, M.persistence
    local __NoirRealTS = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local function __NoirDeadTween()
        local p; p = setmetatable({}, { __index = function() return function() return p end end })
        return p
    end
        local TweenService = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k)
        if k ~= "Create" then return __NoirRealTS[k] end
            return function(_, inst, info, props)
            if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then return __NoirDeadTween() end
            local ok, tw = pcall(__NoirRealTS.Create, __NoirRealTS, inst, info, props)
            if not ok or typeof(tw) ~= "Instance" and type(tw) ~= "table" then return __NoirDeadTween() end
            return tw
        end
    end })
    local BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(18, 118, 130)
    local ACCENT2 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 224, 226)
    local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(168, 179, 184)
    local TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(236, 248, 252)
        local function New(class, props)
        local inst = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(props) do inst[key] = value end
        return inst
    end
        local function corner(inst, radius)
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 12)
        c.Parent = inst
        return c
    end
    do
    local previous
    pcall(function() previous = NoirGenv().__NoirSpeedGlitchRuntime end)
    if type(previous) == "table" and type(previous.Stop) == "function" then pcall(previous.Stop) end
    end
    local speed = {
    alive = true, uiEnabled = false, enabled = false, onlyWorkSideways = false,

        table.clear(list)
    end
        local function bindCharacter(character)
        disconnectList(speed.characterConnections)
        speed.character, speed.humanoid, speed.root, speed.isJumping = character, nil, nil, false
        if not character then return end
            task.spawn(function()

        local function updateButtonVisual()
        local button = speed.toggleButton

        local function toggleMovement(enabled)
        speed.enabled = enabled == true
        if speed.heartbeat then speed.heartbeat:Disconnect(); speed.heartbeat = nil end
            if speed.enabled then
                speed.heartbeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not speed.enabled or not speed.character or not speed.humanoid or not speed.root or not speed.isJumping then return end
                local moveDirection = speed.humanoid.MoveDirection
                if moveDirection.Magnitude <= 0 then return end

                    if speed.onlyWorkSideways then
                    local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
                    if not camera then return end
                    local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector
                    local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)
                    if flatRight.Magnitude <= 0 then return end
                    flatRight = flatRight.Unit
                    local sidewaysAmount = flatRight:Dot(moveDirection)
                    if math.abs(sidewaysAmount) < .35 then return end
                    directionToUse = flatRight * (sidewaysAmount > 0 and 1 or -1)
                else
                    directionToUse = moveDirection.Unit
                end
                speed.root.Velocity = directionToUse * speed.sideSpeed + Vector3.new(0, speed.root.Velocity.Y, 0)
            end)

        -- CYBER HUD v7: ÑÐ°ÐºÑÐ¸ÑÐµÑÐºÐ¸Ð¹ ÐºÐ²Ð°Ð´ÑÐ°Ñ ÑÐ¾ ÑÐºÐ¾Ð±ÐºÐ°Ð¼Ð¸ (ÐºÐ°Ðº Shoot Murder), Ð½Ðµ Ð² ÐºÑÑÐ¶ÐºÐµ
        corner(button, 14)
        local outline
        do
        local applied = false
            pcall(function()
            local cyber = NoirGenv and NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD or nil
                if cyber and type(cyber.apply) == "function" then
                local okFx, fx = pcall(cyber.apply, button, { round = false, radius = 14, brackets = true, bracketLen = 10, autoRotate = false })
                    if okFx and fx and fx.ring then
                    fx.ring.Name = "SpeedOutline"
                    fx.ring.Transparency = .12
                    outline = fx.ring
                    applied = true
                end

            if not applied then
            outline = New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Name = "SpeedOutline", Color = BORDER, Transparency = .12, Thickness = 2.4, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
            New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Name = "SpeedHalo", Color = ACCENT2, Transparency = .87, Thickness = 7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        end
    end
    local outlineGradient = New("UIGradient", { Parent = outline, Rotation = 35, Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, DIM), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.24, ACCENT2),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.55, DIM), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.78, ACCENT2), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, DIM),
    }) })
        if type(M.gradientStrokes) == "table" and type(M.gradientStrokes.fast) == "table" then
        table.insert(M.gradientStrokes.fast, outlineGradient)
    end
    -- click sound + hover/press animation, self-contained
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://3868133279"
    sound.Volume = .4
    sound.Parent = button
    local pressScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    pressScale.Parent = button
    local qOut = TweenInfo.new(.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        speed.uiConnections[#speed.uiConnections + 1] = button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, qOut, { BackgroundTransparency = .02 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(pressScale, qOut, { Scale = 1.07 }):Play()
    end)
        speed.uiConnections[#speed.uiConnections + 1] = button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(button, qOut, { BackgroundTransparency = .08 }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(pressScale, qOut, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    end)
        speed.uiConnections[#speed.uiConnections + 1] = button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
        TweenService:Create(pressScale, qOut, { Scale = .94 }):Play()
    end)
        speed.uiConnections[#speed.uiConnections + 1] = button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(pressScale, TweenInfo.new(.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1.07 }):Play()

    -- Lucide "zap" icon from the shared 48px atlases

    Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, .82, 0), Size = UDim2.new(.92, 0, 0, math.max(13, math.floor(speed.toggleSize * .18))),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = "GLITCH  //  OFF", TextColor3 = TEXT,
    TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(speed.toggleSize * .14), 8, 12), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextScaled = false, TextWrapped = true, ZIndex = 95 })
