        jk.timer, jk.hi = 0, false
        paintJerk()
    end
        local function buildJerkGui()
        if jk.gui and jk.gui.Parent then return end
        local parent = M.guiParent
        if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end
        local gui = New("ScreenGui", { Parent = parent, Name = "NoirJerkToggle", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 87 })
        local button = New("TextButton", { Parent = gui, Name = "Jerk", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = Persistence.GetPosition("noir_jerk_v1", UDim2.new(.86, 0, .5, 0)),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(jk.size, jk.size), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(4, 11, 16), BackgroundTransparency = .12,
        Text = "JERK", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextColor3 = TEXT, TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(jk.size / 6)), AutoButtonColor = false, ZIndex = 8 })
        -- CYBER HUD v7: ÐºÑÑÐ³Ð»Ð¾Ðµ Ð½ÐµÐ¾Ð½Ð¾Ð²Ð¾Ðµ ÐºÐ¾Ð»ÑÑÐ¾ Ñ ÑÐµÑÐ¸ÐºÐ»-ÑÐ¸ÐºÐ°Ð¼Ð¸
        corner(button, 999)
        local st
        do
        local applied = false
            pcall(function()
            local cyber = NoirGenv and NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD or nil
                if cyber and type(cyber.apply) == "function" then
                local okFx, fx = pcall(cyber.apply, button, { round = true, tickMarks = true, autoRotate = false })
                if okFx and fx and fx.ring then st = fx.ring; applied = true end
            end
        end)
            if not applied then
            st = strokeOf(button, Color3.fromRGB(38, 240, 228), .08, 2.4)
            New("UIStroke", { Parent = button, Color = ACCENT2, Transparency = .87, Thickness = 7, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border })
        end
    end
    jk.gui, jk.button, jk.stroke = gui, button, st
    paintJerk()
    local wasMoved = makeDraggable(button, "noir_jerk_v1", jk.conns)
        jk.conns[#jk.conns + 1] = button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if wasMoved() then return end
        toggleJerk(not jk.active)
    end)
    end
        local function startJerk()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return end
            if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            warn("[Noir Troll] Jerk R15 needs an R15 rig.")
            return
        end
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://698251653"
        local ok, track = pcall(function() return humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
        if not ok or not track then return end
        jk.track, jk.timer, jk.hi = track, 0, false
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play()
        jk.active = true
            jk.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            if not jk.active or not jk.track then return end
            if not jk.track.IsPlaying then pcall(function() jk.track:Play() end) end
            jk.timer = jk.timer + deltaTime
                if jk.timer >= jk.interval then
                jk.timer = 0
                jk.hi = not jk.hi
                pcall(function() jk.track.TimePosition = jk.hi and 0.65 or 0.6 end)
            end
        end)
    end
        toggleJerk = function(state)
        if state then startJerk() else stopJerk() end
        paintJerk()
    end
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if jk.active then toggleJerk(false) end
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddToggle("Show Jerk Button", function(on)
                if on == true then
                buildJerkGui()
                if jk.gui then jk.gui.Enabled = true end
            elseif jk.gui then
                jk.gui.Enabled = false
                if jk.active then toggleJerk(false) end
            end
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddSlider("Jerk Button Size", 40, 150, 64, function(v)
            jk.size = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 64, 40, 150)
                if jk.button then
                jk.button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(jk.size, jk.size)
                jk.button.TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(jk.size / 6))
            end
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
        section:AddToggle("Enable Jerk R15", function(on) toggleJerk(on == true) end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddSlider("Jerk Speed (higher = faster)", 1, 100, 10, function(v)
            local speed = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 10, 1, 100)
            jk.interval = 1 / speed
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
        section:AddKeybind("Jerk R15 Keybind", "J", function() toggleJerk(not jk.active) end)
    end)
    pcall(function() section:AddLabel("Requires an R15 rig. Reapplies if the track stops; turns off on respawn.") end)
    end
    -- ================================================================
    -- BANG (classic FE bang troll: looped animation while pinned to
    -- the target player's CFrame; based on the public bang scripts)
    -- ================================================================
    do
    local section = M.tab:AddSection("TROLL u{2022} BANG", "Classic bang troll: stick to a player with a looping animation")
    local bg = { target = nil, active = false, speed = 10, track = nil, conn = nil, phase = 0 }
        local function stopBang()
        bg.active = false
        if bg.conn then bg.conn:Disconnect(); bg.conn = nil end
        if bg.track then pcall(function() bg.track:Stop() end); bg.track = nil end
    end
        local function targetPlayer()
        if not bg.target or bg.target == "None" then return nil end
        return Players:FindFirstChild(bg.target)
    end
        local function startBang()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not (humanoid and root) then return false end
        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://148840371"
        local ok, track = pcall(function() return humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation) end)
        if not ok or not track then return false end
        bg.track = track
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play()
        track:AdjustSpeed(bg.speed)
        bg.active = true
            bg.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            if not bg.active then return end
            local victim = targetPlayer()
            local vchar = victim and victim.Character
            local vroot = vchar and vchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not (vroot and myRoot) then
                stopBang()
                return
            end
            -- Oscillate behind the target's back: +Z of the target's CFrame is
            -- behind it, so we ride 0.7..1.6 studs back and thrust in/out.
            bg.phase = bg.phase + deltaTime * bg.speed
            local wave = (math.sin(bg.phase * 2) + 1) / 2
            local depth = 0.7 + wave * 0.9
                pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = vroot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, depth)
            end)
                if bg.track and not bg.track.IsPlaying then
                pcall(function() bg.track:Play() end)
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if bg.active then stopBang() end
    end)
        local function playerNames()
        local names = { "None" }
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then names[#names + 1] = player.Name end
        end
        table.sort(names, function(a, b) if a == "None" then return true elseif b == "None" then return false end return string.lower(a) < string.lower(b) end)
        return names
    end
    local selector
        pcall(function()
        selector = section:AddDropdown("Bang Target", playerNames(), function(name) bg.target = name end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddButton("Refresh Player List", function()
            if selector and selector.Refresh then pcall(function() selector:Refresh(playerNames(), bg.target) end) end
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddToggle("Bang Player", function(on)
                if on == true then
                if not startBang() then warn("[Noir Troll] Bang: no character or no target selected.") end
            else
                stopBang()
            end
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddSlider("Bang Speed", 1, 20, 10, function(v)
            bg.speed = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 10, 1, 20)
            if bg.track then pcall(function() bg.track:AdjustSpeed(bg.speed) end) end
        end)
    end)
        pcall(function()
            section:AddKeybind("Bang Keybind", "G", function()
            if bg.active then stopBang() else startBang() end
        end)
    end)
    pcall(function() section:AddLabel("Pick a target, hit Refresh if the list is stale, then enable. Stops automatically if the target leaves or you respawn.") end)
    end

end

-- SNPWARE ports: standalone isolated chunk (own loadstring + own reporting)

local __noirSnpwareSource = nil  -- [INLINED] original string literal moved into do-end block below

    warn("[Noir SNPWARE] loadstring unavailable; ports not started.")
    return
end

-- at runtime via loadstring(). It is now inlined as a do-end

do
    -- ============================================================================

    local M = NoirGenv().__NoirMovementContext
        if type(M) ~= "table" or not M.tab then
        warn("[Noir SNPWARE] context unavailable; ports not started.")
        return
    end
    local Players = M.players or game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = M.uis or game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RunService = M.runService or game:GetService("RunService")
    local Workspace = M.workspace or game:GetService("Workspace")
    local LocalPlayer = M.localPlayer or Players.LocalPlayer

    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local tab = M.tab
    local BUILT, FAILED = {}, {}
        local function dummySection(name)
        local d = { Name = name }
        local function n() end
        d.AddToggle, d.AddSlider, d.AddButton, d.AddLabel, d.AddParagraph = n, n, n, n, n
        d.AddKeybind, d.AddTextBox, d.AddColorpicker, d.AddDropdown, d.AddPlayerDropdown = n, n, n, n, n
        return d
    end
        local function makeSection(name, desc)
        local ok, sec = pcall(function() return tab:AddSection(name, desc) end)
            if ok and type(sec) == "table" and type(sec.AddToggle) == "function" then
            table.insert(BUILT, name)
            return sec
        end
        table.insert(FAILED, name .. " (" .. tostring(sec) .. ")")
        warn("[Noir SNPWARE] section not created: " .. name .. " -> " .. tostring(sec))
        return dummySection(name)
    end
        local function report()
        -- console stays quiet on success; failures are still reported
            if #FAILED > 0 then
            warn("[Noir SNPWARE] failed sections: " .. table.concat(FAILED, ", "))
        end
            if type(shared.Notify) == "function" then
            pcall(shared.Notify, "SNPWARE: " .. #BUILT .. " sections loaded" .. (#FAILED > 0 and (" | " .. #FAILED .. " failed (console)") or ""), 5)
        end
    end
    -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- helpers
    -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function getChar()
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return c end
        return nil
    end
        local function getRoot()
        local c = getChar()
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
    end
        local function getHum()
        local c = getChar()
        return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
    end
        local function getRootOf(plr)
        local c = plr and plr.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
    end
        local function backpackOf(plr)
        return plr and plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or nil
    end
        local function alive(plr)
        local h = plr and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return h and h.Health > 0 or false
    end
        local function playerList()
        local out = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(out, p.Name) end
        end
        table.sort(out)
        if #out == 0 then out = { "No players" } end
        return out
    end
        local function findPlayer(name)
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name == name then return p end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function findToolIn(container, name)
        if not container then return nil end
        local v = container:FindFirstChild(name)
        if v and v:IsA("Tool") then return v end
            for _, c in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Tool") and c.Name == name then return c end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function findPlayerTool(plr, name)
        local c = plr and plr.Character
        local t = c and findToolIn(c, name)
        if t then return t end
        local bp = backpackOf(plr)
        t = bp and findToolIn(bp, name)
        if t then return t end
            if bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Toys") then
            t = findToolIn(bp.Toys, name)
            if t then return t end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function isMurderer(plr)
        if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
        return findPlayerTool(plr, "Knife") ~= nil
    end
        local function isSheriff(plr)
        if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return false end
        return findPlayerTool(plr, "Gun") ~= nil
    end
        local function findMurderer()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and alive(p) and isMurderer(p) then return p end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function findSheriffPlayer()
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and alive(p) and isSheriff(p) then return p end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function findNamedPart(keyword)
            for _, d in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model")) and string.find(string.lower(d.Name), keyword, 1, true) then
                local part = d:IsA("BasePart") and d or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if part then return part end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function wallBetween(a, b)
        if not a or not b then return false end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ignore = {}
        local c = getChar()
        if c then table.insert(ignore, c) end
        if Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters") then table.insert(ignore, Workspace.Characters) end
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
        return Workspace:Raycast(a, b - a, params) ~= nil
    end
        local function Notify(title, text, dur)
            if type(shared.Notify) == "function" then
            pcall(shared.Notify, tostring(text), dur or 3)
            return
        end
        if type(M.notify) == "function" then pcall(M.notify, tostring(text), dur or 3) return end
        warn("[Noir SNPWARE] " .. tostring(title) .. ": " .. tostring(text))
    end
    -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- knife combat (SNPWARE: equip Knife -> KnifeStabbed + HandleTouched)
    -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        local function equipKnife()
        local char, hum = getChar(), getHum()
        if not char or not hum then return nil end
        local knife = findToolIn(char, "Knife")
        if knife then return knife end
        local bp = backpackOf(LocalPlayer)
        knife = findToolIn(bp, "Knife")
        if not knife and bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Toys") then knife = findToolIn(bp.Toys, "Knife") end
            if knife then
            pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(knife) end)
            task.wait()
            return findToolIn(char, "Knife")
        end
        return nil
    end
        local function stabHrp(knife, targetHrp)
        if not knife or not targetHrp then return false end
        local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
        if not events then return false end
        local stabbed = events:FindFirstChild("KnifeStabbed")
        if stabbed then pcall(function() stabbed:FireServer() end) end
        local handle = knife:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
            pcall(firetouchinterest, targetHrp, handle, 1)
            pcall(firetouchinterest, targetHrp, handle, 0)
        end
        local touched = events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
            if touched then
            pcall(function() touched:FireServer(targetHrp) end)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
        local function killEveryoneOnce()
        local knife = equipKnife()
        if not knife then return false, "no knife" end
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer and alive(p) then
                local hrp = getRootOf(p)
                if hrp then stabHrp(knife, hrp) end
            end
        end
        return true
    end
        local function killSheriffOnce()
        local knife = equipKnife()
        if not knife then return false, "no knife" end
        local sheriff = findSheriffPlayer()
        if not sheriff then return false, "no sheriff" end
        local hrp = getRootOf(sheriff)
        if not hrp then return false, "no hrp" end
        stabHrp(knife, hrp)
        return true
    end
    -- ===========================================================================
    -- 2) MAP: teleports
    -- ===========================================================================
    local mapSection = makeSection("MAP u{2022} TELEPORT", "Teleport shortcuts ported from SNPWARE")
    local tpState = { distance = 3, target = "Murderer", player = "None", role = "None" }
        local function tpTo(vec)
        local root = getRoot()
        if not root or not vec then return false end
        pcall(function() root.CFrame = CFrame.new(vec) end)
        return true
    end
        local function tpPlayer(plr)
        local tr = getRootOf(plr)
        if not tr then return false end
        return tpTo(tr.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0, tpState.distance))
    end
        local function randomPlayer()
        local list = {}
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and alive(p) then table.insert(list, p) end
        end
        if #list == 0 then return nil end
        return list[math.random(1, #list)]
    end
        local function findDroppedGun()
            for _, d in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if (d:IsA("BasePart") or d:IsA("Model")) then
                local n = string.lower(d.Name)
                    if n == "gundrop" or n == "gun" or string.find(n, "gundrop", 1, true) then
                    local part = d:IsA("BasePart") and d or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if part then return part end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    mapSection:AddDropdown("Teleport Target", { "Murderer", "Sheriff", "Random Player" }, function(v) tpState.target = v end)

    end)
        mapSection:AddButton("Teleport to Secret", function()

    -- ===========================================================================

    local xraySection = makeSection("MAIN u{2022} XRAY", "Client-side xray ported from SNPWARE")
    local xrayState = { on = false, power = 0.55 }
    local xrayTouched = {}
        local function applyXray()
        local char = getChar()
            for _, d in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool") then
                    if not char or not d:IsDescendantOf(char) then
                    if xrayTouched[d] == nil then xrayTouched[d] = d.LocalTransparencyModifier end
                    d.LocalTransparencyModifier = xrayState.power
                end
            end
        end
    end

            for part, old in pairs(xrayTouched) do
            if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.LocalTransparencyModifier = old or 0 end) end
        end
        xrayTouched = {}
    end
        xraySection:AddToggle("Enable Xray", function(on)

    local hitboxSection = makeSection("MAIN u{2022} HITBOX EXPANDER", "Hitbox expander ported from SNPWARE")

        hitboxSection:AddToggle("Enable Hitbox Expander", function(on)

            if not on then

    hitboxSection:AddSlider("Hitbox Size", 1, 30, 6, function(v) hitboxState.size = v end)
    hitboxSection:AddSlider("Hitbox Transparency", 0, 100, 60, function(v) hitboxState.trans = v end)
    hitboxSection:AddLabel("Enlarges other players hitboxes locally.")
    local skyboxSection = makeSection("MAIN u{2022} CUSTOM SKYBOX", "Skybox presets and custom image ported from SNPWARE")
    local skyState = { preset = "Default", customId = "" }
        local function setSky(id)
        local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky")
        if not sky then sky = Instance.new("Sky") sky.Parent = Lighting end
            if id == nil or id == "" then
            sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxasset://sky/skyback.png"
            sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxasset://sky/skydn.png"
            sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxasset://sky/skyft.png"
            sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxasset://sky/skylf.png"
            sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxasset://sky/skyrt.png"
            sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxasset://sky/skyup.png"
        else
            sky.SkyboxBk, sky.SkyboxDn, sky.SkyboxFt = id, id, id
            sky.SkyboxLf, sky.SkyboxRt, sky.SkyboxUp = id, id, id
        end
    end
        skyboxSection:AddDropdown("Skybox Preset", { "Default", "Dusk", "Night", "Custom" }, function(v)
        skyState.preset = v
            if v == "Custom" then setSky(skyState.customId)
        else setSky(nil) pcall(function() Lighting.ClockTime = (v == "Dusk" and 18 or (v == "Night" and 0 or 14)) end) end
    end)
        skyboxSection:AddTextBox("Custom Skybox ID", function(text)
        skyState.customId = text
        if skyState.preset == "Custom" then setSky(text) end
    end)
    skyboxSection:AddSlider("Sky Time (hour)", 0, 24, 14, function(v) pcall(function() Lighting.ClockTime = v end) end)
    local bgSection = makeSection("MAIN u{2022} BACKGROUND", "Custom menu backdrop ported from SNPWARE")
    local bgState = { gui = nil, frame = nil, trans = 0.3 }
        local function destroyBg()
        if bgState.gui then pcall(function() bgState.gui:Destroy() end) end
        bgState.gui, bgState.frame = nil, nil
    end
        local function buildBg()
        if bgState.gui then return end
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "NoirSnpBackground"
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.DisplayOrder = -5
        pcall(function() g.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if not g.Parent then g.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end
        local f = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
        f.BackgroundTransparency = bgState.trans
        f.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
        f.Parent = g
        bgState.gui, bgState.frame = g, f
    end
    bgSection:AddToggle("Enable Custom Background", function(on) if on then buildBg() else destroyBg() end end)
    bgSection:AddTextBox("Background Image ID", function(text) buildBg() if bgState.frame then bgState.frame.Image = text end end)
        bgSection:AddSlider("Background Transparency", 0, 100, 30, function(v)
        bgState.trans = v / 100
        if bgState.frame then bgState.frame.BackgroundTransparency = bgState.trans end
    end)
    -- ===========================================================================
    -- 6) MISC: cursor rotate + size
    -- ===========================================================================
    local cursorSection = makeSection("MISC u{2022} CURSOR PLUS", "Cursor rotate and size ported from SNPWARE")
    local cursorState = { on = false, size = 42, rotSpeed = 90, image = "", gui = nil, img = nil, angle = 0 }
        local function destroyCursor()
        if cursorState.gui then pcall(function() cursorState.gui:Destroy() end) end
        cursorState.gui, cursorState.img = nil, nil
        pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true end)
    end
        local function buildCursor()
        if cursorState.gui then return end
        local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        g.Name = "NoirSnpCursor"
        g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        g.ResetOnSpawn = false
        g.DisplayOrder = 999
        pcall(function() g.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
        if not g.Parent then g.Parent = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end

        pcall(function() UIS.MouseIconEnabled = false end)

        cursorState.image = text
        if cursorState.img then cursorState.img.Image = text end
    end)

        cursorState.size = v
        if cursorState.img then cursorState.img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(v, v) end
    end)

        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
            local dt = task.wait(0.03)
                if cursorState.on and cursorState.img then
                local pos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                cursorState.img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
                cursorState.angle = (cursorState.angle + cursorState.rotSpeed * dt) % 360
                cursorState.img.Rotation = cursorState.angle
            end
        end
    end)
    -- ===========================================================================
    -- 7) BOMB JUMP: auto clutch firefly (real SNPWARE logic)
    -- ===========================================================================
    do
    local bjp = NoirGenv().__NoirBJPSection
    local section
        if type(bjp) == "table" and type(bjp.AddToggle) == "function" then
        section = bjp
    else
        section = makeSection("Bomb Jump+", "Auto clutch firefly ported from SNPWARE")
    end
    local fState = { on = false, wait = 3.1, busy = false, conn = nil }
        local function findFirefliesTool()
        local bp = backpackOf(LocalPlayer)
        local char = getChar()
        local tool = bp and findToolIn(bp, "Fireflies")
        if not tool and char then tool = findToolIn(char, "Fireflies") end
        if not tool and bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Toys") then tool = findToolIn(bp.Toys, "Fireflies") end
        return tool
    end
        local function fireflyOwn(part)
        local char = getChar()
        if not char then return false end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return false end
        return (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude < 400
    end
        local function listen(self)
        if self.conn then self.conn:Disconnect() self.conn = nil end
            self.conn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if self.busy or not fState.on then return end
            if not d:IsA("BasePart") or d.Name ~= "Firefly" then return end
            if not fireflyOwn(d) then return end
            self.busy = true
            if self.conn then self.conn:Disconnect() self.conn = nil end
                task.spawn(function()
                local char = getChar()
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = getHum()
                    if root and hum then
                        pcall(function()
                        root.CFrame = d.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, d.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
                    hum.JumpPower = 53
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    hum.JumpPower = 51
                end
                task.wait(fState.wait)
                self.busy = false
                if fState.on then listen(self) end
            end)
        end)
    end
        section:AddToggle("Auto Clutch Firefly", function(on)
        fState.on = on
            if on then
                task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(1)
                if not fState.on then return end
                    if not findFirefliesTool() then
                    Notify("Bomb Jump", "No Fireflies toy in backpack", 5)
                    fState.on = false
                    return
                end
                listen(fState)
                Notify("Bomb Jump", "Firefly clutch armed", 3)
            end)
        else
            if fState.conn then fState.conn:Disconnect() fState.conn = nil end
            fState.busy = false
        end
    end)
    section:AddSlider("Firefly Cooldown (s)", 0.2, 3.1, 3.1, function(v) fState.wait = v end)
        section:AddButton("Equip Fireflies Now", function()
        local tool = findFirefliesTool()
        local hum = getHum()
            if tool and hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(tool) end) Notify("Bomb Jump", "Fireflies equipped", 2)
        else Notify("Bomb Jump", "Fireflies not found", 3) end
    end)
    section:AddLabel("SNPWARE logic: watches for the Firefly part and teleports you above it, then jumps.")
    end
    -- ===========================================================================
    -- 8) EMOTES: "GAME EMOTES" real sub-tab on the Emotes page

    do
    local EMOTES = { "sit", "ninja", "dab", "zen", "floss", "headless", "zombie", "wave", "cheer", "laugh" }
    -- settings persistence (saved in the Noir UI folder, restored on next launch)
    local PersistenceCfg = M.persistence
        local function cfgNum(key, fallback)
            if PersistenceCfg and type(PersistenceCfg.GetValue) == "function" then
            local ok, v = pcall(function() return PersistenceCfg.GetValue("noir_emotes", key, fallback) end)
            if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
        end
        return fallback
    end
        local function cfgSave(key, value)
            if PersistenceCfg and type(PersistenceCfg.SetValue) == "function" then
            pcall(function() PersistenceCfg.SetValue("noir_emotes", key, value) end)
        end
    end
    local eState = { spam = false, speed = cfgNum("spam_speed", 3), token = 0, selected = "dab" }
        local function emoteRemote()
        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        local misc = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Misc")
        return misc and misc:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote") or nil
    end
        local function playEmote(name)
        if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return end
        local remote = emoteRemote()
            if remote then
            local ok = pcall(function() remote:Fire(name) end)
            if ok then return true end
        end
            pcall(function()
            local events = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
            local say = events and events:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
            if say then say:FireServer("/e " .. name, "All") end
        end)
        return false
    end
    local CARD = Color3.fromRGB(11, 21, 29)
    local BTN = Color3.fromRGB(9, 35, 40)
    local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(24, 224, 226)
    local TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(236, 248, 252)
    local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(168, 179, 184)
    local BORDER = Color3.fromRGB(15, 90, 96)
        local function cornerOf(inst, r)
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 12); c.Parent = inst; return c
    end
        local function panel(parent, title, subtitle)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")

        card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        card.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
        card.BackgroundTransparency = .25
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        card.Parent = parent
        cornerOf(card, 18)

        local tick = Instance.new("Frame")
        tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20); tick.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16)
        tick.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT; tick.BorderSizePixel = 0; tick.Parent = card
        cornerOf(tick, 2)
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1; t.Text = title; t.TextColor3 = TEXT; t.TextSize = 18; t.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 16); t.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 22); t.Parent = card
            if subtitle then
            local st = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            st.BackgroundTransparency = 1; st.Text = subtitle; st.TextColor3 = DIM; st.TextSize = 12; st.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            st.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; st.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44); st.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 18); st.Parent = card

        holder.Parent = card
        local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8); lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; lay.Parent = holder
        local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 14); pad.Parent = holder
        return holder

        local function button(parent, label, height)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height or 42)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = BTN; b.Text = label; b.TextColor3 = TEXT; b.TextSize = 15
        b.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; b.AutoButtonColor = true; b.Parent = parent
        cornerOf(b, 12)
        return b

    local tabs = NoirGenv().__NoirEmotesTabs
    -- ---- round on-screen bind buttons (same look as NOIR's BJ / grab gun buttons) ----
    local Persistence = M.persistence

    local emoteGui
    local emoteButtonSize = cfgNum("button_size", 58)
        local function cfgSaveBound()
        local list = {}
        for emote in pairs(emoteButtons) do list[#list + 1] = emote end
        table.sort(list)
        cfgSave("bound", list)
    end
        local function guiParentOf()
        local ok, hui = pcall(function() return gethui and gethui() end)
        if ok and typeof(hui) == "Instance" then return hui end
        return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end
        local function ensureGui()
        if emoteGui and emoteGui.Parent then return emoteGui end
        emoteGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        emoteGui.Name = "NoirEmoteButtons"
        emoteGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        emoteGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        emoteGui.DisplayOrder = 90
        emoteGui.Parent = guiParentOf()
        return emoteGui
    end
        local function savedPosition(emote, fallback)
            if Persistence and type(Persistence.GetPosition) == "function" then
            local ok, pos = pcall(function() return Persistence.GetPosition("noir_emote_" .. emote, fallback) end)
            if ok and typeof(pos) == "UDim2" then return pos end
        end
        return fallback
    end
        local function storePosition(emote, position)
            if Persistence and type(Persistence.SetPosition) == "function" then
            pcall(function() Persistence.SetPosition("noir_emote_" .. emote, position) end)
        end
    end
        local function removeEmoteButton(emote)
        local conns = emoteMaid[emote]
            if conns then
            for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
            emoteMaid[emote] = nil
        end
        local btn = emoteButtons[emote]
        if btn and btn.Parent then btn:Destroy() end
        emoteButtons[emote] = nil
        cfgSaveBound()
    end
        local function addEmoteButton(emote, index)
        if emoteButtons[emote] then return end
        local gui = ensureGui()
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Name = "Emote_" .. emote
        btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(emoteButtonSize, emoteButtonSize)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 10)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = .18
        btn.Text = string.upper(emote)
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 248, 252)
        btn.TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(emoteButtonSize / 5.6))
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextWrapped = true
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.ZIndex = 6
        btn.Parent = gui
        local circle = Instance.new("UICorner")
        circle.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        circle.Parent = btn
        local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")
        aspect.AspectRatio = 1
        aspect.Parent = btn
        -- same ring style as the NOIR BJ / grab gun buttons
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 224, 226)
        stroke.Thickness = 2
        stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        stroke.Parent = btn
        local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(5, 17, 23)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.22, Color3.fromRGB(24, 224, 226)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.48, Color3.fromRGB(9, 43, 48)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.72, Color3.fromRGB(121, 237, 238)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(5, 25, 30)),
        })
        gradient.Parent = stroke
        local inner = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        inner.Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 90, 96)
        inner.Transparency = .5
        inner.Thickness = 1
        inner.Parent = btn
        local innerGradient = gradient:Clone()
        innerGradient.Rotation = 180
        innerGradient.Parent = inner
        pcall(function() local cyber = (type(NoirGenv) == 'function' and NoirGenv().NoirCyberHUD or nil) if cyber and type(cyber.apply) == 'function' then btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 18, 25) btn.BackgroundTransparency = .16 cyber(btn, { round = true, tickMarks = true }) end end)
        local defaultPos = UDim2.new(0.16 + ((index - 1) % 5) * 0.09, 0, 0.84 - math.floor((index - 1) / 5) * 0.11, 0)
        btn.Position = savedPosition(emote, defaultPos)
        local conns = {}
        local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos, moved = false, nil, nil, nil, false
            conns[#conns + 1] = btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, moved, dragStart, startPos = true, false, input.Position, btn.Position
            end
        end)
            conns[#conns + 1] = btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput = input
            end
        end)
            conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging or input ~= dragInput then return end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if delta.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
                if moved then
                local view = gui.AbsoluteSize
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale + delta.X / math.max(view.X, 1), 0,
                startPos.Y.Scale + delta.Y / math.max(view.Y, 1), 0)
            end
        end)
            conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
                    if moved then
                    storePosition(emote, btn.Position)
                else
                    playEmote(emote)
                    Notify("Emotes", "Playing: " .. emote, 2)
                end
            end
        end)
        emoteMaid[emote] = conns
        emoteButtons[emote] = btn
        cfgSaveBound()
    end
        local function clearEmoteButtons()
        for emote in pairs(emoteButtons) do removeEmoteButton(emote) end
    end
        local function syncSize()
            for _, btn in pairs(emoteButtons) do
                if btn and btn.Parent then
                btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(emoteButtonSize, emoteButtonSize)
                btn.TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(emoteButtonSize / 5.6))
                local c = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
                if c then c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0) end
            end
        end
    end
    local bindRefreshers = {}
        if type(tabs) == "table" and tabs.Game then
        -- Every piece is built in its own pcall: a single bad property used to abort the whole
        -- section and leave GAME EMOTES empty.
        local holder = tabs.Game

            return panel(tabs.Game, "GAME EMOTES", "Tap an emote to play it. BIND puts a round button on screen (drag it anywhere).")
        end)
        if okHeader and headerOrErr then holder = headerOrErr end
        -- ---- spam row
            local function buildSpamRow(parent)
            local row = Instance.new("Frame")
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42); row.BackgroundTransparency = 1; row.Parent = parent
            local rl = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

            speedBox.PlaceholderText = "1-10"; speedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; speedBox.Parent = row

                    task.spawn(function()
                        while eState.spam and eState.token == token do
                        playEmote(EMOTES[math.random(1, #EMOTES)])
                        task.wait(1 / math.clamp(eState.speed, 1, 10))
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        -- ---- emote rows (2 per row). Plain frames: no UIGridLayout properties to get wrong.
        local rowsFrame
            local function buildRow(parent, order)
            local row = Instance.new("Frame")

            row.Parent = parent

                else
                    addEmoteButton(emoteName, index)
                end

            end)
            paint()
        end
        local okSpam = pcall(buildSpamRow, holder)
            local okList = pcall(function()
            rowsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

            rowsFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
            rowsFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            rowsFrame.Parent = holder
            local ll = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            ll.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8); ll.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; ll.Parent = rowsFrame
        end)
        if not okList or not rowsFrame then rowsFrame = holder end
        local builtCount = 0
        local rowsByIndex = {}
            for i, name in ipairs(EMOTES) do
            local emoteName = name
            local index = i
            local rowIndex = math.floor((i - 1) / 2) + 1
                pcall(function()
                local row = rowsByIndex[rowIndex]
                    if not row then
                    row = buildRow(rowsFrame, rowIndex)
                    row.Name = "EmoteRow" .. tostring(rowIndex)
                    rowsByIndex[rowIndex] = row
                end
                makeCell(row, emoteName, index, (i % 2) == 0)
                builtCount = builtCount + 1
            end)
        end
        -- restore bound emote buttons from saved settings (positions are restored too)
            pcall(function()
            local bound = {}
                if PersistenceCfg and type(PersistenceCfg.GetValue) == "function" then
                local ok, t = pcall(function() return PersistenceCfg.GetValue("noir_emotes", "bound", {}) end)
                if ok and type(t) == "table" then bound = t end
            end
            local restoredCount = 0
                for i, emoteName in ipairs(EMOTES) do
                    if type(table.find) == "function" and table.find(bound, emoteName) then
                    addEmoteButton(emoteName, i)
                    restoredCount = restoredCount + 1
                end
            end
                if restoredCount > 0 then
                for _, paint in pairs(bindRefreshers) do pcall(paint) end
            end
        end)
        -- visible diagnostics: if something still failed, it is written in the tab itself
            if builtCount < #EMOTES or not okSpam then
                pcall(function()
                local warnLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                warnLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                warnLabel.Text = "Emotes built: " .. tostring(builtCount) .. "/" .. tostring(#EMOTES)
                .. (okSpam and "" or " | spÐ°Ð¼ row failed")
                warnLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 90)
                warnLabel.TextSize = 11
                warnLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                warnLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
                warnLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                warnLabel.Parent = holder
            end)
        end
        -- ---- size / clear tools
            pcall(function()
            local tools = Instance.new("Frame")
            tools.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42); tools.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tools.Parent = holder
            local tl = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
            tl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal; tl.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
            tl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; tl.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center; tl.Parent = tools
            local sizeBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
            sizeBox.LayoutOrder = 1; sizeBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, -4, 1, 0)
            sizeBox.BackgroundColor3 = BTN; sizeBox.Text = tostring(emoteButtonSize); sizeBox.TextColor3 = TEXT
            sizeBox.TextSize = 13; sizeBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham; sizeBox.PlaceholderText = "size"
            sizeBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false; sizeBox.Parent = tools
            cornerOf(sizeBox, 12)
                sizeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                local n = tonumber(sizeBox.Text)
                if n then emoteButtonSize = math.clamp(math.floor(n + .5), 36, 96) syncSize() end
                sizeBox.Text = tostring(emoteButtonSize)
                cfgSave("button_size", emoteButtonSize)
            end)
            local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            clearBtn.LayoutOrder = 2; clearBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -4, 1, 0)
            clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = BTN; clearBtn.Text = "Clear All Emote Buttons"
            clearBtn.TextColor3 = TEXT; clearBtn.TextSize = 13; clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            clearBtn.AutoButtonColor = true; clearBtn.Parent = tools
            cornerOf(clearBtn, 12)
                clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                clearEmoteButtons()
                for _, paint in pairs(bindRefreshers) do pcall(paint) end
            end)
        end)
            pcall(function()
            local note = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            note.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            note.Text = "Round buttons stay on screen, drag them anywhere. Uses Remotes.Misc.PlayEmote, /e fallback."
            note.TextColor3 = DIM; note.TextSize = 12; note.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            note.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; note.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
            note.TextWrapped = true; note.Parent = holder
        end)
    else
        -- older Part1 without the tab bar: keep a normal Emotes section so nothing is lost
        local section = makeSection("EMOTES u{2022} GAME EMOTES", "MM2 emote launcher ported from SNPWARE")
            section:AddToggle("Spam Emotes", function(on)
            eState.spam = on
            eState.token = eState.token + 1
            local token = eState.token
            if not on then return end
                task.spawn(function()
                    while eState.spam and eState.token == token do
                    playEmote(EMOTES[math.random(1, #EMOTES)])
                    task.wait(1 / math.clamp(eState.speed, 1, 10))
                end
            end)
        end)
        section:AddSlider("Emote Spam Speed", 1, 10, 3, function(v) eState.speed = v end)
            for index, name in ipairs(EMOTES) do
            local emoteName = name
            local emoteIndex = index
                section:AddButton("Play " .. string.upper(string.sub(emoteName, 1, 1)) .. string.sub(emoteName, 2), function()
                playEmote(emoteName)
            end)
                section:AddButton("Bind " .. string.upper(emoteName) .. " Button", function()
                    if emoteButtons[emoteName] then
                    removeEmoteButton(emoteName)
                else
                    addEmoteButton(emoteName, emoteIndex)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    end
    report()

end

-- [INLINED SATELLITE MODULE] __noirSkinSource
-- This code was originally embedded as a string and compiled
-- at runtime via loadstring(). It is now inlined as a do-end
-- block, which is semantically equivalent.
do
    -- Noir MM2 • WEAPON SKINCHANGER (full engine, offline port)
    -- Полностью локальная косметика: скины, эффекты, позы, брошенные ножи,
    -- лобби-дисплей и страница Changer в игровом инвентаре. Сервер не затрагивается.
    local Core = NoirGenv().__NoirCore
        if type(Core) ~= "table" or not Core.LocalPlayer then
        return
    end
    -- forward declaration: engine install() calls the Noir menu through this upvalue
    local NoirSkinMenu
    local RunService = Core.RunService or game:GetService("RunService")
    local Players = Core.Players or game:GetService("Players")
    local LocalPlayer = Core.LocalPlayer
    local Workspace = Core.Workspace or game:GetService("Workspace")
    local ReplicatedStorage = Core.ReplicatedStorage or game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
    -- executor-independent codecs: some executors (Delta) fail HttpService:Base64Decode
    -- on large inputs, so every codec below carries a pure-Lua fallback.
    local JsonLib = {}
    do
    local B64D = {}
    local ALPHABET = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    for i = 1, #ALPHABET do B64D[string.byte(ALPHABET, i)] = i - 1 end
        function JsonLib.b64decode(data)
        local out = {}
        local n, acc, bits = 0, 0, 0
            for i = 1, #data do
            local v = B64D[string.byte(data, i)]
                if v then
                acc = acc * 64 + v
                bits = bits + 6
                    if bits >= 8 then
                    bits = bits - 8
                    n = n + 1
                    out[n] = string.char(math.floor((acc / 2 ^ bits) % 256))
                    acc = acc % 2 ^ bits
                end
            end
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end
    local ESCAPES = { [34] = '"', [92] = "\\", [47] = "/", [98] = "", [102] = "", [110] = "\n", [114] = "\r", [116] = "	" }
        local function parseWs(s, i)
        local c = string.byte(s, i)
            while c == 32 or c == 9 or c == 10 or c == 13 do
            i = i + 1
            c = string.byte(s, i)
        end
        return i
    end
        local function parseString(s, i)
        i = i + 1
        local buf = {}
        local n = 0
            while true do
            local c = string.byte(s, i)
            if not c then error("unterminated string", 0) end
            if c == 34 then return table.concat(buf), i + 1 end
                if c == 92 then
                local e = string.byte(s, i + 1)
                local simple = ESCAPES[e]
                    if simple then
                    n = n + 1; buf[n] = simple; i = i + 2
                elseif e == 117 then
                    local code = tonumber(string.sub(s, i + 2, i + 5), 16)
                    if not code then error("bad \\u escape", 0) end
                    i = i + 6
                        if code >= 0xD800 and code <= 0xDBFF and string.byte(s, i) == 92 and string.byte(s, i + 1) == 117 then
                        local low = tonumber(string.sub(s, i + 2, i + 5), 16)
                            if low and low >= 0xDC00 and low <= 0xDFFF then
                            code = 0x10000 + (code - 0xD800) * 0x400 + (low - 0xDC00)
                            i = i + 6
                        end
                    end
                    n = n + 1; buf[n] = utf8.char(code)
                else
                    error("bad escape \\" .. string.char(e or 63), 0)
                end
            else
                n = n + 1; buf[n] = string.sub(s, i, i); i = i + 1
            end
        end
    end
        local function parseNumber(s, i)
        local _, j = string.find(s, "^-?%d+%.?%d*[eE]?[+-]?%d*", i)
        if not j then error("bad number at " .. i, 0) end
        local num = tonumber(string.sub(s, i, j))
        if not num then error("bad number at " .. i, 0) end
        return num, j + 1
    end
    local parseValue
        parseValue = function(s, i)
        i = parseWs(s, i)
        local c = string.byte(s, i)
            if c == 123 then
            local obj = {}
            i = parseWs(s, i + 1)
            if string.byte(s, i) == 125 then return obj, i + 1 end
                while true do
                if string.byte(s, i) ~= 34 then error("expected key string at " .. i, 0) end
                local key
                key, i = parseString(s, i)
                i = parseWs(s, i)
                if string.byte(s, i) ~= 58 then error("expected ':' at " .. i, 0) end
                local val
                val, i = parseValue(s, i + 1)
                obj[key] = val
                i = parseWs(s, i)
                local d = string.byte(s, i)
                    if d == 44 then i = parseWs(s, i + 1)
                elseif d == 125 then return obj, i + 1
                else error("expected ',' or '}' at " .. i, 0) end
            end
        elseif c == 91 then
            local arr = {}
            i = parseWs(s, i + 1)
            if string.byte(s, i) == 93 then return arr, i + 1 end
            local n = 0
                while true do
                local val
                val, i = parseValue(s, i)
                n = n + 1
                arr[n] = val
                i = parseWs(s, i)
                local d = string.byte(s, i)
                    if d == 44 then i = parseWs(s, i + 1)
                elseif d == 93 then return arr, i + 1
                else error("expected ',' or ']' at " .. i, 0) end
            end
        elseif c == 34 then
            return parseString(s, i)
        elseif c == 116 and string.sub(s, i, i + 3) == "true" then
            return true, i + 4
        elseif c == 102 and string.sub(s, i, i + 4) == "false" then
            return false, i + 5
        elseif c == 110 and string.sub(s, i, i + 3) == "null" then
            return nil, i + 4
        else
            return parseNumber(s, i)
        end
    end
        function JsonLib.decode(s)
        if type(s) ~= "string" then error("expected string", 0) end
        local value, i = parseValue(s, 1)
        i = parseWs(s, i)
        if i <= #s then error("trailing characters at " .. i, 0) end
        return value
    end
        local function encodeStr(v)
            return '"' .. v:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(ch)
            local map = { ['"'] = '\\"', ['\\'] = '\\\\', [''] = '\\b', [''] = '\\f', ['\n'] = '\\n', ['\r'] = '\\r', ['	'] = '\\t' }
            return map[ch] or string.format("\\u%04x", string.byte(ch))
        end) .. '"'
    end
        local function encodeValue(v, out)
        local t = type(v)
            if t == "string" then
            out[#out + 1] = encodeStr(v)
        elseif t == "number" then
            if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then out[#out + 1] = "null" else out[#out + 1] = tostring(v) end
        elseif t == "boolean" then
            out[#out + 1] = tostring(v)
        elseif t == "nil" then
            out[#out + 1] = "null"
        elseif t == "table" then
            local count = 0
            for _ in pairs(v) do count = count + 1 end
                if count == #v then
                out[#out + 1] = "["
                    for i, item in ipairs(v) do
                    if i > 1 then out[#out + 1] = "," end
                    encodeValue(item, out)
                end
                out[#out + 1] = "]"
            else
                out[#out + 1] = "{"
                local first = true
                    for k, item in pairs(v) do
                    if not first then out[#out + 1] = "," end
                    first = false
                    out[#out + 1] = encodeStr(tostring(k)) .. ":"
                    encodeValue(item, out)
                end
                out[#out + 1] = "}"
            end
        else
            error("cannot encode " .. t, 0)
        end
    end
        function JsonLib.encode(v)
        local out = {}
        encodeValue(v, out)
        return table.concat(out)
    end
    end
        local function fallbackGuid()
        local bytes = {}
        for i = 1, 16 do bytes[i] = string.char(math.random(0, 255)) end
        local hex = table.concat(bytes):gsub(".", function(ch) return string.format("%02x", string.byte(ch)) end)
        return string.sub(hex, 1, 8) .. "-" .. string.sub(hex, 9, 12) .. "-" .. string.sub(hex, 13, 16)
        .. "-" .. string.sub(hex, 17, 20) .. "-" .. string.sub(hex, 21, 32)
    end
    -- resilient HttpService proxy: prefer the real service, fall back to pure Lua
    local SafeHttp = {}
    setmetatable(SafeHttp, { __index = HttpService })
        function SafeHttp:Base64Decode(data)
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:Base64Decode(data) end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" and #result > 0 then return result end
        return JsonLib.b64decode(data)
    end
        function SafeHttp:JSONEncode(value)
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(value) end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then return result end
        return JsonLib.encode(value)
    end
        function SafeHttp:JSONDecode(data)
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(data) end)
        if ok and result ~= nil then return result end
        return JsonLib.decode(data)
    end
        function SafeHttp:GenerateGUID(lowercase)
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return HttpService:GenerateGUID(lowercase == true) end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then return result end
        local guid = fallbackGuid()
        if lowercase == true then return guid end
        return string.upper(guid)
    end
    -- lifecycle: each launch takes a fresh token; loops of older launches stop on their next tick
    local __alive, __token = true, {}
        local function isAlive()
        local g = NoirGenv()
        return __alive and g.__NoirSkinsToken == __token
    end
    -- engine proxy environment (the ported code addresses globals through environment.*)
    local ENV = setmetatable({
    game = game,
    workspace = Workspace,
    task = task,
    os = os,
    Instance = Instance,
    Enum = Enum,
    Color3 = Color3,
    Vector2 = Vector2,
    Vector3 = Vector3,
    CFrame = CFrame,
    UDim = UDim,
    UDim2 = UDim2,
    NumberSequence = NumberSequence,
    NumberSequenceKeypoint = NumberSequenceKeypoint,
    NumberRange = NumberRange,
    ColorSequence = ColorSequence,
    ColorSequenceKeypoint = ColorSequenceKeypoint,
    getgenv = getgenv or function() return _G end,
    typeof = typeof or function(value) return type(value) end,
    require = require,
    readfile = readfile,
    writefile = writefile,
    isfile = isfile,
    isfolder = isfolder,
    makefolder = makefolder,
    getcustomasset = getcustomasset,
    getrenv = getrenv or getgenv,
    }, { __index = _G })
    -- offline skins database (embedded, base64): 380+ real MM2 skins with mesh/texture/effect specs
    local SKINS_DB_B64 = ""
    NoirGenv().__noirData = {
        take = function(key)
            if key == "skins_db" and type(SKINS_DB_B64) == "string" and #SKINS_DB_B64 > 1000 then
            local ok, decoded = pcall(function() return SafeHttp:Base64Decode(SKINS_DB_B64) end)
                if ok and type(decoded) == "string" and #decoded > 100 and string.sub(decoded, 1, 1) == "{" then

            end
                pcall(function()
                local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

    end,
    }
    NoirGenv().__NoirSkinsToken = __token
    -- engine context (same contract the original hub passed to WeaponSkins.install)
    local context = {
    environment = ENV,
    player = LocalPlayer,

    -- one-shot diagnostics: never printed; recorded for manual inspection only
    local __onceWarn = {}
        local function onceWarn(key, message)
        if __onceWarn[key] then return end
        __onceWarn[key] = true
            pcall(function()
            local globals = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
            globals.__NoirSkinsDiag = tostring(globals.__NoirSkinsDiag or "") .. tostring(message) .. "\n"
        end)
    end
    -- ===== SkinModel: builds 3D skin visuals from the database node trees =====
    -- (this block was missing from the port: every applyTool/applyDisplay call
    -- needs it, without it no skin mesh can ever be constructed)
    local SkinModel = {}
        function SkinModel.decode(environment, value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
        local kind = value[1]
        if kind == "V" then return environment.Vector3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
        if kind == "C" then return environment.Color3.new(value[2], value[3], value[4]) end
        if kind == "F" then return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(value, 2, 13)) end
        if kind == "NR" then return environment.NumberRange.new(value[2], value[3]) end
            if kind == "E" then
            local ok, item = pcall(function() return environment.Enum[value[2]][value[3]] end)
            return ok and item or nil
        end
            if kind == "CS" then
            local points = {}
                for index = 2, #value do
                local point = value[index]
                table.insert(points, environment.ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], environment.Color3.new(point[2], point[3], point[4])))
            end
            local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.ColorSequence.new, points)
            return ok and sequence or nil
        end
            if kind == "NS" then
            local points = {}
                for index = 2, #value do
                local point = value[index]
                table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2], point[3] or 0))
            end
            local ok, sequence = pcall(environment.NumberSequence.new, points)
            return ok and sequence or nil
        end
        return nil
    end
        function SkinModel.frame(environment, values)
        return environment.CFrame.new(table.unpack(values, 1, 12))
    end
        function SkinModel.mesh(state, meshId)
        if state.meshes[meshId] then return state.meshes[meshId]:Clone() end
        while state.loading[meshId] do state.context.environment.task.wait() end
        if state.meshes[meshId] then return state.meshes[meshId]:Clone() end
        state.loading[meshId] = true
        local environment = state.context.environment
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return state.context.insertService:CreateMeshPartAsync(meshId, environment.Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, environment.Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic)
        end)
        state.loading[meshId] = nil
        if not ok or not result then return nil end
        state.meshes[meshId] = result
        return result:Clone()
    end
        function SkinModel.node(state, data, root, references, unresolved, options)
        if options and options.skip and options.skip(data) then return nil end
        local context, environment = state.context, state.context.environment
        local object
            if data.c == "MeshPart" then
            object = SkinModel.mesh(state, data.p.MeshId or "")
            if not object then object = environment.Instance.new("Part"); object.Transparency = 1 end
        end
            if not object then
            local ok, created = pcall(environment.Instance.new, data.c)
            if not ok or not created then return nil end
            object = created
        end
        object.Name = data.n
            for property, value in data.p or {} do
            if property == "MeshId" and data.c == "MeshPart" then continue end
                if type(value) == "table" and value[1] == "R" then
                table.insert(unresolved, {object, property, value[2]})
                continue
            end
            local decoded = SkinModel.decode(environment, value)
            if decoded ~= nil then pcall(function() object[property] = decoded end) end
        end
        if data.i then references[data.i] = object end
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            object.Anchored, object.CanCollide, object.CanQuery, object.CanTouch, object.Massless = false, false, false, false, true
            pcall(function() object.AudioCanCollide = false end)
                if root and data.r then
                local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
                weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = "PW", root, object, SkinModel.frame(environment, data.r), object
            end
        end
        for key, value in data.a or {} do pcall(object.SetAttribute, object, key, SkinModel.decode(environment, value)) end
        for _, tag in data.t or {} do pcall(context.collection.AddTag, context.collection, object, tag) end
        local parentRoot = root or object
            for _, child in data.k or {} do
            local built = SkinModel.node(state, child, parentRoot, references, unresolved, options)
            if built then built.Parent = object end
        end
        return object
    end
        function SkinModel.build(state, data, options)
        local references, unresolved = {}, {}
        local root = SkinModel.node(state, data, nil, references, unresolved, options)
        if not root then return nil end
            for _, reference in unresolved do
            local target = references[reference[3]]
            if target then pcall(function() reference[1][reference[2]] = target end) end
        end
        return root
    end
        function SkinModel.hasChroma(data)
            for _, tag in data.t or {} do
            if tag == "ChromaPart" or tag == "ChromaDecal" or tag == "ChromaFire" then return true end
        end
        for _, child in data.k or {} do if SkinModel.hasChroma(child) then return true end end
        return false
    end
        function SkinModel.applyChroma(state, skin, model)
        if not skin.ch or SkinModel.hasChroma(skin.d) then return end
            for _, object in model:GetDescendants() do
            if object:IsA("Decal") and object.Name:lower():find("chroma") then pcall(state.context.collection.AddTag, state.context.collection, object, "ChromaDecal") end
            if object:IsA("Fire") then pcall(state.context.collection.AddTag, state.context.collection, object, "ChromaFire") end
        end
    end
    local SkinCatalog = {}
    local SKIN_RARITY_ORDER = {Noir = 0, Ancient = 1, Unique = 2, Godly = 3, Classic = 4, Legendary = 5, Rare = 6}
        function SkinCatalog.list(database)
        local result = {}
            for key, entry in database do
            local name = entry.nm or key
            table.insert(result, {key = key, name = name, short = entry.ch and name:gsub("^Chroma ", "") or name,
            chroma = entry.ch == true, type = entry.t, rarity = entry.r, img = entry.img})
        end
            table.sort(result, function(first, second)
            local firstRank = (SKIN_RARITY_ORDER[first.rarity] or 9) + (first.chroma and 0.5 or 0)
            local secondRank = (SKIN_RARITY_ORDER[second.rarity] or 9) + (second.chroma and 0.5 or 0)
            if firstRank ~= secondRank then return firstRank < secondRank end
            if first.type ~= second.type then return first.type < second.type end
            return first.name:lower() < second.name:lower()
        end)
        return result
    end
        function SkinCatalog.filter(items, kind, rarity, query)
        local result = {}
        query = (query or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower()
            for _, item in items do
            if kind ~= "All" and item.type ~= kind then continue end
            if rarity ~= "Any" and not (rarity == "Chroma" and item.chroma) and not (item.rarity == rarity and not item.chroma) then continue end
            if query ~= "" and not (tostring(item.name) .. " " .. tostring(item.key)):lower():find(query, 1, true) then continue end
            table.insert(result, item)
        end
        return result
    end

    local NOIR_EFFECTS = {"ParticleEmitter", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles", "Light", "Beam", "Trail", "Highlight"}
    local NOIR_REMOVED = {"LuaSourceContainer", "Sound", "LayerCollector", "Camera", "Animation", "RemoteEvent", "RemoteFunction", "BindableEvent", "ValueBase", "ClickDetector", "ProximityPrompt", "TouchTransmitter", "Humanoid", "SoundEffect", "Configuration"}
        function NoirSkin.isAny(object, classes)
        for _, class in classes do if object:IsA(class) then return true end end
        return false
    end
        function NoirSkin.icon(environment, spec)
        local image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&w=150&h=150&id=" .. spec.asset
            pcall(function()
            if type(environment.writefile) ~= "function" or type(environment.getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return end
            local path = "Noir/pskin_" .. spec.icon .. "_v1.png"
            if type(environment.isfolder) == "function" and not environment.isfolder("Noir") then environment.makefolder("Noir") end
                if type(environment.isfile) ~= "function" or not environment.isfile(path) then
                local data = rawget(environment.getgenv(), "__noirData")
                local encoded = data and data.take and data.take("pskin_" .. spec.icon)
                if type(encoded) == "string" and #encoded > 64 then environment.writefile(path, JsonLib.b64decode(encoded)) end
            end
            if type(environment.isfile) == "function" and not environment.isfile(path) then return end
            local asset = environment.getcustomasset(path)
            if type(asset) == "string" and #asset > 0 then image = asset end
        end)
        return image
    end
        local function deepCopy(value)
        if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end
        local copy = {}
        for key, item in value do copy[key] = deepCopy(item) end
        return copy
    end
        function NoirSkin.register(state, database, sync)
        local environment = state.context.environment
        -- game-facing entries: deep-clone a real weapon of the same type so every
        -- field the game's own modules read (crafting grid, rarity sort, trade
        -- checks) stays a valid value; only display fields are overridden.
        local templates = {}
            for _, entry in sync.Weapons do
                if type(entry) == "table" and (entry.ItemType == "Knife" or entry.ItemType == "Gun")
                and not entry.EvoBaseID and not templates[entry.ItemType] then
                templates[entry.ItemType] = entry
            end
        end
        local byKey, items = {}, {}
            for _, original in NOIR_SKINS do
            local spec = table.clone(original)
            spec.img = NoirSkin.icon(environment, spec)
            byKey[spec.key] = spec
            table.insert(items, spec)
            local grip = {table.unpack(spec.g)}
            for _, value in {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1} do table.insert(grip, value) end
            database[spec.key] = {t = spec.t, r = "Noir", nm = spec.nm, img = spec.img, src = "noir", d = {c = "Folder", n = "NoirCX", p = {}, k = {}}, g = grip, a1 = spec.a1, hold = spec.hold, cx = spec}
            local entry = templates[spec.t] and deepCopy(templates[spec.t]) or {}
            entry.ItemName, entry.ItemType, entry.Image = spec.nm, spec.t, spec.img
            entry.Year, entry.ItemID, entry.NoirCustom = 2026, spec.asset, true
            sync.Weapons[spec.key] = entry
        end
        state.cx = {context = state.context, templates = {}, loading = {}, ITEMS = items, byKey = byKey}
        local globals = environment.getgenv()
        globals.__noirCX = state.cx
            pcall(function()
            local cache = type(environment.getrenv) == "function" and environment.getrenv()._G.Cache or _G.Cache
            if type(cache) ~= "table" then return end
            for _, spec in items do cache[spec.img] = spec.img end
        end)
    end
        function NoirSkin.template(state, asset)
        if state.templates[asset] ~= nil then return state.templates[asset] or nil end
        local environment = state.context.environment
        while state.loading[asset] do environment.task.wait() end
        if state.templates[asset] ~= nil then return state.templates[asset] or nil end
        state.loading[asset] = true
        local result
        local ok, objects = pcall(function() return environment.game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. asset) end)
            if ok and type(objects) == "table" and #objects > 0 then
            result = environment.Instance.new("Folder")
                for _, root in objects do
                    for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
                    if object:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then pcall(function() object.Disabled = true end) end
                end
                    for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
                    if NoirSkin.isAny(object, NOIR_REMOVED) then pcall(function() object:Destroy() end) end
                end
                if root:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then root:Destroy() else root.Parent = result end
            end
        end
        state.templates[asset], state.loading[asset] = result or false, nil
        return result
    end
        function NoirSkin.scaleSequence(environment, sequence, scale)
        local points = {}
        for _, point in sequence.Keypoints do table.insert(points, environment.NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point.Time, point.Value * scale, point.Envelope * scale)) end
        return environment.NumberSequence.new(points)
    end
        function NoirSkin.scaleEffect(environment, object, scale)
            pcall(function()
                if object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                object.Size = NoirSkin.scaleSequence(environment, object.Size, scale)
                object.Speed = environment.NumberRange.new(object.Speed.Min * scale, object.Speed.Max * scale)
                object.Acceleration *= scale
                return
            end
                if object:IsA("Beam") then
                object.Width0, object.Width1 = object.Width0 * scale, object.Width1 * scale
                object.CurveSize0, object.CurveSize1 = object.CurveSize0 * scale, object.CurveSize1 * scale
                return
            end
            if object:IsA("Trail") then object.WidthScale = NoirSkin.scaleSequence(environment, object.WidthScale, 1); return end
            if object:IsA("Light") then object.Range *= math.max(scale, 0.5); return end
            if object:IsA("Fire") then object.Size *= scale end
        end)
    end
        function NoirSkin.build(state, skin)
        local spec = skin.cx
        local template = spec and NoirSkin.template(state, spec.asset)
        if not template then return nil end
        local environment, scale = state.context.environment, spec.k
        local origin = SkinModel.frame(environment, spec.X)
        local root = environment.Instance.new("Part")
        root.Name, root.Size, root.Transparency = "NoirCX", environment.Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), 1
        root.CanCollide, root.CanQuery, root.CanTouch, root.Massless, root.CastShadow = false, false, false, true, false
        local mesh = environment.Instance.new("BlockMesh")
        mesh.Scale, mesh.Parent = environment.Vector3.zero, root
        local copy = template:Clone()
        local parts = {}
        for _, object in copy:GetDescendants() do if object:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(parts, object) end end
            for _, part in parts do
            local visible = part.Transparency < 0.999 and math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z) <= 30
                for _, child in part:GetChildren() do
                    if child:IsA("DataModelMesh") and not (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and child.MeshType == environment.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh) then
                    local size = child.Scale
                    if math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) > 20 then visible = false end
                end
            end
                if not visible then
                for _, object in part:GetDescendants() do if NoirSkin.isAny(object, NOIR_EFFECTS) then visible = true; break end end
            end
            if not visible then continue end
            local relative = origin:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
                for _, child in part:GetChildren() do
                if NoirSkin.isAny(child, {"JointInstance", "WeldConstraint", "NoCollisionConstraint", "RigidConstraint"}) then child:Destroy(); continue end
                    if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                    if child.MeshType == environment.Enum.MeshType.FileMesh then child.Scale *= scale end
                    child.Offset *= scale
                    continue
                end
                if child:IsA("BlockMesh") or child:IsA("CylinderMesh") then child.Offset *= scale; continue end
                if child:IsA("Attachment") then child.Position *= scale end
            end
            part.Anchored, part.CanCollide, part.CanQuery, part.CanTouch, part.Massless, part.CastShadow = false, false, false, false, true, false
            pcall(function() part.AudioCanCollide = false end)
            part.Size *= scale
            local weld = environment.Instance.new("Weld")
            weld.Name, weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.C0, weld.Parent = "PW", root, part, environment.CFrame.new(relative.Position * scale) * relative.Rotation, part
            part.Parent = root
        end
        copy:Destroy()
            for _, object in root:GetDescendants() do
            if NoirSkin.isAny(object, NOIR_EFFECTS) then NoirSkin.scaleEffect(environment, object, scale) end
            if spec.glowOnly and NoirSkin.isAny(object, {"ParticleEmitter", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles"}) then object:Destroy(); continue end
                if spec.burst and object:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
